title_en: PRISM: Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model
title_zh: PRISM：并行残差迭代序列模型

sentences.en: Generative sequence modeling faces a fundamental tension between the expressivity of Transformers and the efficiency of linear sequence models.
sentences.zh: 生成式序列建模面临Transformer表达力与线性序列模型效率之间的基本张力。

sentences.en: Existing efficient architectures are theoretically bounded by shallow, single-step linear updates, while powerful iterative methods like Test-Time Training (TTT) break hardware parallelism due to two dimensions of serial dependency: token-level state reliance and step-level iteration loops.
sentences.zh: 现有的高效架构在理论上受限于浅层、单步线性更新，而测试时训练（TTT）等强大的迭代方法因两个维度的串行依赖而打破硬件并行性：词元级状态依赖与步级迭代循环。

sentences.en: We propose PRISM (Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model) to resolve this tension.
sentences.zh: 我们提出PRISM（并行残差迭代序列模型）来解决这一张力。

sentences.en: PRISM explicitly reconstructs the expressive gate × residual × direction iteration pattern of TTT in a parallelizable form.
sentences.zh: PRISM以可并行化的形式显式重构TTT的表达性门×残差×方向迭代模式。

sentences.en: We employ a Write-Forget Decoupling strategy that isolates non-linearity within the injection operator.
sentences.zh: 我们采用写-忘解耦策略，将非线性隔离在注入算子内部。

sentences.en: To bypass the serial dependency of explicit solvers, PRISM utilizes a two-stage proxy architecture: a short-convolution anchors the initial residual using local history energy, while a learned predictor estimates the refinement updates directly from the input.
sentences.zh: 为绕过显式求解器的串行依赖，PRISM利用一个两阶段代理架构：短卷积用局部历史能量锚定初始残差，而一个习得的预测器直接从输入估计精化更新。

sentences.en: This design distills structural patterns associated with iterative correction into a parallelizable feedforward operator.
sentences.zh: 这一设计将迭代校正相关的结构模式蒸馏为可并行化的前馈算子。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that this formulation achieves Rank-$L$ accumulation, structurally expanding the update manifold beyond the single-step Rank-$1$ bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明这一表述实现秩-$L$累加，在结构上超越单步秩-$1$瓶颈扩展更新流形。

sentences.en: Empirically, it achieves comparable performance to explicit optimization methods while achieving 174x higher throughput.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，它实现与显式优化方法相当的性能，同时实现174倍的吞吐量。

sentences.en: Codes are available in \url{https://github.com/gpr-prism/prism/}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/gpr-prism/prism/} 获取。

title_en: PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making.
title_zh: PRISM：面向序贯决策的感知推理交错

sentences.en: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 将基于LLM的具身智能体从纯文本环境扩展到复杂多模态设定仍是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: Recent work identifies a perception–reasoning–decision gap in standalone Vision–Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information.
sentences.zh: 近期工作识别出独立视觉-语言模型（VLM）中感知-推理-决策的差距，它们往往忽视任务关键信息。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question–answer (DQA) pipeline.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入PRISM，一个通过动态问答（DQA）流程将感知（VLM）与决策（LLM）紧密耦合的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of passively accepting the VLM’s description, the LLM critiques it, probes the VLM with goal-oriented questions, and synthesizes a compact image description.
sentences.zh: LLM不是被动地接受VLM的描述，而是批判它、用目标导向的问题探究VLM，并综合出一份紧凑的图像描述。

sentences.en: This closed-loop interaction yields a sharp, task-driven understanding of the scene.
sentences.zh: 这种闭环交互产生对场景的锐利、任务驱动的理解。

sentences.en: We evaluate PRISM on the ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在ALFWorld与Room-to-Room（R2R）基准上评估PRISM。

sentences.en: We show that: (1) PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models, (2) our Interactive goal-oriented perception pipeline yields systematic and substantial gains, and (3) PRISM is fully automatic, eliminating the need for handcrafted questions or answers.
sentences.zh: 我们表明：（1）PRISM显著优于最先进的基于图像的模型，（2）我们的交互式目标导向感知流程带来系统而显著的增益，（3）PRISM完全自动化，消除了对人工设计问题或答案的需求。

title_en: Prism: Spectral-Aware Block-Sparse Attention
title_zh: Prism：谱感知的块稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Block-sparse attention is promising for accelerating long-context LLM pre-filling, yet identifying relevant blocks efficiently remains a bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 块稀疏注意力对于加速长上下文LLM预填充很有前景，但高效识别相关块仍然是一个瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing methods typically employ coarse-grained attention as a proxy for block importance estimation, but often resort to expensive token-level searching or scoring, resulting in significant selection overhead.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常采用粗粒度的注意力作为块重要性估计的代理，但往往诉诸昂贵的词元级搜索或评分，导致显著的选赏开销。

sentences.en: In this work, we trace the inaccuracy of standard coarse-grained attention via mean pooling to a theoretical root cause: the interaction between mean pooling and Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将标准粗粒度注意力（经由均值池化）的不准确性追溯到理论根因：均值池化与旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: We prove that mean pooling acts as a low-pass filter that induces destructive interference in high-frequency dimensions, effectively creating a "blind spot" for local positional information (e.g., slash patterns).
sentences.zh: 我们证明均值池化充当一个低通滤波器，在高频维度诱导破坏性干扰，有效制造局部位置信息（如斜线模式）的一个“盲点”。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Prism, a training-free spectral-aware approach that decomposes block selection into high-frequency and low-frequency branches.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入Prism，一种无需训练的谱感知方法，将块选择分解为高频与低频分支。

sentences.en: By applying energy-based temperature calibration, Prism restores the attenuated positional signals directly from pooled representations, enabling block importance estimation using purely block-level operations, thereby improving efficiency.
sentences.zh: 通过应用基于能量的温度校准，Prism直接从池化表示恢复衰减的位置信号，使块重要性估计能够仅使用块级操作，从而改进效率。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations confirm that Prism maintains accuracy parity with full attention while delivering up to $\mathbf{5.1\times}$ speedup.
sentences.zh: 大量评估证实，Prism与完全注意力保持准确性持平，同时实现多达$\mathbf{5.1\times}$的加速。

sentences.en: Code available at https://github.com/xinghaow99/prism.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/xinghaow99/prism 获取。

title_en: PRISM: Synergizing Vision Foundation Models via Self-organized Expert Specialization
title_zh: PRISM：通过自组织专家专门化协同视觉基础模型

sentences.en: Unifying the complementary strengths of diverse Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) into a single efficient model is highly desirable but challenged by the negative transfer inherent in monolithic distillation.
sentences.zh: 将多样视觉基础模型（VFM）的互补优势统一到单个高效模型中是高度可取的，但受到整体式蒸馏固有负迁移的挑战。

sentences.en: To address these feature conflicts, we introduce \textbf{PRISM}, a novel dual-stream Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that synergizes VFMs via modular specialization.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些特征冲突，我们引入\textbf{PRISM}，一个新颖的双流专家混合（MoE）框架，通过模块化专门化协同VFM。

sentences.en: We propose a two-stage paradigm: (1) expertise deconstruction, where a teacher-conditional router guides experts to specialize in distinct representational subspaces to mitigate interference, followed by (2) dynamic recomposition, where the router learns to assemble these experts into tailored computational pathways for downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个两阶段范式：（1）专长解构，其中教师条件路由引导专家在截然不同的表示子空间中专门化以减轻干扰，随后（2）动态重组，其中路由学习将这些专家组装成面向下游任务的定制计算路径。

sentences.en: Experiments on PASCAL-Context and NYUD-v2 show that \textbf{PRISM} establishes a new state of the art, validating that sparse, emergent specialization is a scalable approach for integrating diverse visual knowledge.
sentences.zh: 在PASCAL-Context与NYUD-v2上的实验表明，\textbf{PRISM}建立了新的最先进水平，验证了稀疏、涌现的专门化是整合多样视觉知识的可扩展方法。

title_en: PRISM: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Intrinsic Statistical Modeling
title_zh: PRISM：基于内在统计建模的无需训练视频异常检测

sentences.en: While recent training-free video anomaly detection (VAD) methods offer advantages such as interpretability and ease of deployment, they often suffer from computational inefficiency due to complex memory retrieval mechanisms or high-latency visual-language models (VLMs).
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的无需训练视频异常检测（VAD）方法提供可解释性与易于部署等优势，但它们往往因复杂的记忆检索机制或高延迟视觉-语言模型（VLM）而遭受计算效率低下。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose PRISM (Parameter-less Recognition Based on Intrinsic Statistical Modeling), a novel framework for efficient open-set anomaly detection with minimal computational cost.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出PRISM（基于内在统计建模的无参数识别），一个以最小计算成本进行高效开放集异常检测的新框架。

sentences.en: Built on a pre-trained multimodal embedding model, PRISM introduces differential amplification and whitening mechanisms to statistically suppress common-mode background noise in the embedding space, thereby improving the signal-to-noise ratio of anomalous events.
sentences.zh: PRISM建立在预训练多模态嵌入模型之上，引入差分放大与白化机制，在嵌入空间中统计性地抑制共模背景噪声，从而提高异常事件的信噪比。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on three widely datasets demonstrate that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods while maintaining real-time inference capability.
sentences.zh: 在三个广泛数据集上的大量实验表明，PRISM在无需训练方法中达到最先进表现，同时保持实时推理能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our statistical analysis offers a complementary perspective on why training-free methods may suffer from lower Average Precision (AP) on complex datasets such as XD-Violence.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的统计分析为为何无需训练方法在XD-Violence等复杂数据集上可能遭受较低平均精度（AP）提供了一个补充视角。

sentences.en: Code is released at https://github.com/ytC2026/ICML2026-PRISM.
sentences.zh: 代码发布于 https://github.com/ytC2026/ICML2026-PRISM。

title_en: PrivAct: Internalizing Contextual Privacy Preservation via Multi-Agent Preference Training
title_zh: PrivAct：通过多智能体偏好训练内化情境隐私保护

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in personalized tasks involving sensitive, context-dependent information, where privacy violations may arise in agents' action due to the implicitness of contextual privacy.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益被部署在涉及敏感、情境依赖信息的个性化任务中，其中由于情境隐私的隐含性，隐私侵犯可能出现在智能体的行动中。

sentences.en: Existing approaches rely on *external*, inference-time interventions which are brittle, scenario-specific, and may expand the privacy attack surface.
sentences.zh: 现有方法依赖*外部*的推理时干预，它们脆弱、场景特定，并可能扩大隐私攻击面。

sentences.en: We propose **PrivAct**, a contextual privacy-aware multi-agent learning framework that *internalizes* contextual privacy preservation directly into models' generation behavior for privacy-compliant agentic actions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**PrivAct**，一个情境隐私感知的多智能体学习框架，将情境隐私保护*内化*到模型的生成行为中，以实现隐私合规的智能体行动。

sentences.en: By embedding privacy preferences into each agent, PrivAct enhances system-wide contextual integrity while achieving a more favorable privacy-helpfulness tradeoff.
sentences.zh: 通过将隐私偏好嵌入每个智能体，PrivAct增强系统范围的情境完整性，同时实现更有利的隐私-帮助权衡。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in contextual privacy preservation, reducing leakage rates by up to 12.32\% while maintaining comparable helpfulness, as well as zero-shot generalization and robustness across diverse multi-agent topologies.
sentences.zh: 跨多个LLM骨干与基准的实验表明，在情境隐私保护方面的持续改进，泄漏率最高降低12.32\%，同时保持相当的帮助性，并且跨多样多智能体拓扑具有零样本泛化与鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/chengyh23/PrivAct.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/chengyh23/PrivAct 获取。

title_en: Privacy Amplification in Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Optimization with Hidden States
title_zh: 带隐藏状态的差分私有零阶优化中的隐私放大

sentences.en: Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a promising approach for fine-tuning large language models on domain-specific data, particularly under differential privacy (DP) and memory constraints.
sentences.zh: 零阶优化已成为在领域特定数据上微调大型语言模型的有前景方法，尤其是在差分隐私（DP）与内存约束下。

sentences.en: While first-order methods have been extensively studied from a privacy perspective, the privacy analysis and algorithmic design for zeroth-order methods remain significantly underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然一阶方法已从隐私角度被广泛研究，但零阶方法的隐私分析与算法设计仍显著未被充分探索。

sentences.en: A critical open question concerns hidden-state DP analysis: although convergent privacy bounds are known for first-order methods, it has remained unclear whether similar guarantees can be established for zeroth-order methods.
sentences.zh: 一个关键的开放问题涉及隐藏状态DP分析：虽然一阶方法的收敛型隐私界已知，但能否为零阶方法确立类似的保证仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide an affirmative answer by proving a convergent DP bound for zeroth-order optimization.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过证明零阶优化的收敛型DP界给出肯定回答。

sentences.en: Our analysis generalizes the celebrated privacy amplification-by-iteration framework to the setting of smooth loss functions in zeroth-order optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析将著名的逐迭代隐私放大框架推广到零阶优化中光滑损失函数的设定。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it induces better DP zeroth-order algorithmic designs that are previously unknown to the literature.
sentences.zh: 此外，它诱导出文献中此前未知的更好DP零阶算法设计。

title_en: Privacy-Aware Data Integration for Enhanced Quantile Inference under Heterogeneity
title_zh: 异构性下增强分位数推断的隐私感知数据整合

sentences.en: Quantile estimation and inference play essential roles in diverse scientific and industrial applications, and their accuracy can often be enhanced by integrating auxiliary data from multiple sites.
sentences.zh: 分位数估计与推断在多样科学与工业应用中起着重要作用，其准确性往往可以通过整合来自多个站点的辅助数据来增强。

sentences.en: However, developing efficient aggregation methods for quantile inference under potential privacy constraints, particularly with heterogeneous datasets, remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，在潜在隐私约束下（尤其是异构数据集上）开发高效的分位数推断聚合方法仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a systematic framework for quantile estimation and inference under potential local differential privacy (LDP).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出一个在潜在局部差分隐私（LDP）下进行分位数估计与推断的系统性框架。

sentences.en: The key idea is to construct weighted estimators by adaptively aggregating quantile estimates from target and source sites.
sentences.zh: 关键思想是通过自适应聚合来自目标与来源站点的分位数估计来构造加权估计器。

sentences.en: The adaptive weights are determined by minimizing the asymptotic variance, incorporating an additional $\ell_2$ penalty to account for parameter shift.
sentences.zh: 自适应权重通过最小化渐近方差来确定，并纳入额外的 $\ell_2$ 惩罚以考虑参数偏移。

sentences.en: A parallel stochastic gradient descent algorithm under LDP constraints is developed for weight estimation and valid inference.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一个在LDP约束下的并行随机梯度下降算法，用于权重估计与有效推断。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce a conservative weighted estimator to ensure robust inference across diverse heterogeneous scenarios.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个保守的加权估计器，以确保跨多样异构场景的稳健推断。

sentences.en: Rigorous theoretical analysis establishes the consistency, normality, and effectiveness of the proposed methods.
sentences.zh: 严谨的理论分析确立了所提出方法的一致性、正态性与有效性。

sentences.en: Extensive numerical studies and real data application corroborate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 大量的数值研究与真实数据应用印证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Privacy-Aware Video Anomaly Detection through Orthogonal Subspace Projection
title_zh: 通过正交子空间投影进行隐私感知的视频异常检测

sentences.en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) systems often prioritize accuracy while overlooking privacy concerns, limiting their suitability for real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 视频异常检测（VAD）系统往往优先考虑准确性而忽视隐私关切，限制了它们对真实世界部署的适用性。

sentences.en: We propose the Orthogonal Projection Layer (OPL), a lightweight module that removes task-irrelevant variations to produce representations focused on anomaly-relevant cues.
sentences.zh: 我们提出正交投影层（OPL），一个移除任务无关变化以产生聚焦于异常相关线索的表示的轻量级模块。

sentences.en: To address privacy risks in human-centered scenarios, we introduce Guided OPL (G-OPL), which suppresses facial attributes using weak supervision from face-presence signals while preserving non-identifying features such as pose and motion.
sentences.zh: 为应对以人为中心场景中的隐私风险，我们引入引导式OPL（G-OPL），它使用来自人脸存在信号的弱监督抑制面部属性，同时保留姿势与运动等非识别特征。

sentences.en: A cosine alignment objective enforces consistent capture and removal of facial information without identity labels or adversarial training.
sentences.zh: 一个余弦对齐目标在无需身份标签或对抗训练的情况下强制一致地捕获与移除面部信息。

sentences.en: We further present a privacy-aware evaluation framework that jointly assesses detection performance and privacy preservation, and enables analysis of how sensitive information is filtered.
sentences.zh: 我们还呈献一个隐私感知的评估框架，它联合评估检测性能与隐私保护，并支持分析敏感信息如何被过滤。

sentences.en: Experiments show that embedding privacy constraints into model design reduces sensitive information while maintaining or improving detection accuracy, supporting projection-based architectures as a principled approach for privacy-aware VAD.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，将隐私约束嵌入模型设计减少敏感信息，同时维持或改进检测准确性，支持基于投影的架构作为隐私感知VAD的原则性方法。

title_en: Privacy-Aware Video Anomaly Detection: Guided Orthogonal Projection and a Comprehensive Evaluation Framework
title_zh: 隐私感知的视频异常检测：引导式正交投影与综合评估框架

sentences.en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is critical for surveillance systems, but current methods prioritize accuracy while ignoring the ethical risks of encoding sensitive biometric information.
sentences.zh: 视频异常检测（VAD）对监控系统至关重要，但当前方法优先考虑准确性，而忽视了编码敏感生物识别信息的伦理风险。

sentences.en: This neglect poses significant privacy concerns for real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 这种忽视对真实世界部署构成显著隐私关切。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce the Guided Orthogonal Projection Layer (G-OPL), a lightweight module designed to geometrically decouple and suppress sensitive attributes from latent features to produce representations focused on anomaly-relevant cues.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入引导式正交投影层（G-OPL），一个轻量级模块，旨在从几何上解耦并抑制潜在特征中的敏感属性，以产生聚焦于异常相关线索的表示。

sentences.en: We specifically target facial information as the primary sensitive attribute.
sentences.zh: 我们专门将面部信息作为主要敏感属性。

sentences.en: Unlike gait or body pose, faces act as unique biometric identifiers that are tightly regulated and pose immediate risks of misuse, yet are rarely necessary for identifying abnormal behaviors.
sentences.zh: 与步态或身体姿势不同，面部充当受严格监管且存在即时滥用风险、但对识别异常行为却很少必要的独特生物识别标识。

sentences.en: To achieve this, G-OPL utilizes a stable, QR-decomposition-based orthogonal projection mechanism guided by weak supervision (e.g., face presence) to actively filter privacy-sensitive subspaces while preserving task-relevant anomalies. we further propose a novel privacy-aware evaluation framework to rigorously quantify the trade-off between model utility and ethical alignment.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，G-OPL利用一个基于QR分解的、由弱监督（如人脸存在）引导的稳定正交投影机制，主动过滤隐私敏感子空间，同时保留任务相关的异常。我们进一步提出一个新颖的隐私感知评估框架，以严格量化模型效用与伦理对齐之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Our analysis uncovers how projection layers filter sensitive information, why this improves transparency, and under what conditions ethical design also enhances robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示了投影层如何过滤敏感信息、为何这改善透明性，以及在何种条件下伦理设计也增强鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively minimizes privacy risks without compromising anomaly detection performance, offering a principled path toward trustworthy video analysis.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在不损害异常检测性能的情况下有效最小化隐私风险，为可信视频分析提供一条原则性路径。

title_en: Privasis: Synthesizing the Largest "Public" Private Dataset from Scratch
title_zh: Privasis：从头合成最大的“公共”私有数据集

sentences.en: Research involving privacy-sensitive data has always been constrained by data scarcity, standing in sharp contrast to other areas that have benefited from data scaling.
sentences.zh: 涉及隐私敏感数据的研究一直受到数据稀缺的制约，与其他受益于数据规模化的领域形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: To quench this thirst, we present Privasis (i.e., privacy oasis), the first million-scale fully synthetic dataset entirely built from scratch—an expansive reservoir of texts with rich and diverse private information—designed to broaden and accelerate research in areas where processing sensitive social data is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一渴求，我们呈献Privasis（即隐私绿洲），第一个完全从头构建的百万级全合成数据集——一个包含丰富多样私人信息的广阔文本储备——旨在拓宽并加速处理敏感社会数据不可避免领域的研究。

sentences.en: Compared to existing datasets, Privasis, comprising 1.4 million records, offers orders-of-magnitude larger scale with quality, and far greater diversity across various document types, including medical records, legal documents, financial records, calendars, emails, meeting transcripts, and text-messages with a total of 55.1 million annotated attributes such as ethnicity, date of birth, workplace, etc. We leverage Privasis to construct a parallel corpus for text sanitization with our pipeline that recursively decomposes texts and applies targeted sanitization.
sentences.zh: 与现有数据集相比，包含140万条记录的Privasis在规模上高出数个数量级且质量优良，并跨各种文档类型（包括医疗记录、法律文件、财务记录、日历、电子邮件、会议记录与短信）提供远为广泛的多样性，总计5510万个标注属性，如族裔、出生日期、工作地点等。我们利用Privasis借助我们的流程构建用于文本净化的平行语料，该流程递归地分解文本并应用针对性的净化。

sentences.en: Our compact sanitization models ($\leq$ 4B) trained on this dataset outperform state-of-the-art large language models, such as GPT-5 and Qwen-3 235B.
sentences.zh: 在此数据集上训练的紧凑净化模型（$\leq$ 4B）优于最先进的大型语言模型，如GPT-5与Qwen-3 235B。

title_en: Private and Stable Test-time Adaptation with Differential Privacy
title_zh: 带差分隐私的私有且稳定的测试时适配

sentences.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can reduce error on new and different data by updating the model on these inputs during inference.
sentences.zh: 测试时适配（TTA）可以通过在推理期间对这些输入更新模型来减少在新且不同数据上的误差。

sentences.en: However, these updates raise the issue of privacy w.r.t. the testing data, because the model parameters now depend on all past inputs.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些更新引发关于测试数据的隐私问题，因为模型参数现在依赖于所有过去的输入。

sentences.en: To control this privacy risk, we cast multiple popular TTA methods (Tent, EATA, SAR, DeYO, and COME) into differential privacy (DP) forms that apply per-sample gradient clipping and Gaussian noise for all updates.
sentences.zh: 为控制这一隐私风险，我们将多种流行的TTA方法（Tent、EATA、SAR、DeYO与COME）转化为对所有更新应用逐样本梯度裁剪与高斯噪声的差分隐私（DP）形式。

sentences.en: On ImageNet-C, our DP-TTA methods provide adequate privacy at small cost to accuracy, and in the low-privacy regime the clipping mechanism of DP can even improve the accuracy and stability of adaptation in the continual setting.
sentences.zh: 在ImageNet-C上，我们的DP-TTA方法以较小的准确率代价提供充分的隐私，而在低隐私区制下，DP的裁剪机制甚至在持续设定中提升适配的准确率与稳定性。

sentences.en: These improvements to privacy and accuracy come at only modest computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 这些对隐私与准确率的改进只伴随适度的计算开销。

sentences.en: These first results on private TTA raise awareness of the issue, inform the development of more private test-time updates, and identify per-sample clipping as an effective technique for improving the accuracy and stability of adaptation.
sentences.zh: 这些关于私有TTA的首批结果提高了对这一问题的认识，为更私密的测试时更新之开发提供信息，并识别出逐样本裁剪作为改善适配准确率与稳定性的有效技术。

title_en: Private Learning with Public Feature Conditioning
title_zh: 带公共特征条件化的私有学习

sentences.en: We study differentially private (DP) regression in settings where each data sample includes public, non-sensitive features—common in applications like recommendation or advertising systems.
sentences.zh: 我们研究每个数据样本都包含公共、非敏感特征的设定中的差分私有（DP）回归——这在推荐或广告系统等应用中很常见。

sentences.en: While such label DP or DP with semi-sensitive features settings have been primarily explored in the context of classification, effective approaches for regression remain underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然此类标签DP或带半敏感特征设定的DP主要已在分类情境中被探索，但回归的有效方法仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: We introduce $\textsf{Cond-DP}$, a conditioned variant of $\textsf{DPSGD}$ that leverages the structure of public feature matrices to improve optimization under privacy constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们引入$\textsf{Cond-DP}$，$\textsf{DPSGD}$的一个条件化变体，它利用公共特征矩阵的结构在隐私约束下改进优化。

sentences.en: Motivated by the observation that these public features often exhibit rapidly decaying spectra, $\textsf{Cond-DP}$ incorporates a data-driven conditioning matrix to reshape the optimization landscape and accelerate convergence.
sentences.zh: 受公共特征往往展现出快速衰减谱这一观察驱动，$\textsf{Cond-DP}$纳入一个数据驱动的条件化矩阵，以重塑优化格局并加速收敛。

sentences.en: We provide convergence guarantees for convex, strongly convex and non-convex settings, and recover standard $\textsf{DPSGD}$ as a special case when the conditioning matrix is the identity.
sentences.zh: 我们为凸、强凸与非凸设定提供收敛保证，并在条件化矩阵为单位阵时恢复标准$\textsf{DPSGD}$作为特例。

sentences.en: We show how to construct an effective conditioning matrix for $\textsf{Cond-DP}$ directly from public features, enabling faster convergence than $\textsf{DPSGD}$ in private linear regression, without incurring additional privacy cost.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了如何直接从公共特征为$\textsf{Cond-DP}$构造有效的条件化矩阵，使私有线性回归的收敛快于$\textsf{DPSGD}$，而无需付出额外隐私成本。

sentences.en: Empirically, $\textsf{Cond-DP}$ with this conditioning matrix consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across a wide range of datasets and model architectures under label DP, demonstrating strong and robust performance in practice.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，带此条件化矩阵的$\textsf{Cond-DP}$在标签DP下跨广泛的数据集与模型架构持续优于最先进基线，在实践中展现强大且稳健的表现。

title_en: Privately Fine-Tuned LLMs Preserve Temporal Dynamics in Tabular Data
title_zh: 私有微调的LLM保留表格式数据中的时间动态

sentences.en: Research on differentially private synthetic tabular data has largely focused on independent and identically distributed rows where each record corresponds to a unique individual.
sentences.zh: 关于差分私有合成表格数据的研究在很大程度上聚焦于独立同分布的行，其中每条记录对应于一个独特的个体。

sentences.en: This perspective neglects the temporal complexity in longitudinal datasets, such as electronic health records, where a user contributes an entire (sub) table of sequential events.
sentences.zh: 这一视角忽视了纵向数据集（如电子健康记录）中的时间复杂性，在那些数据集中一个用户贡献整个（子）顺序事件表。

sentences.en: While practitioners might attempt to model such data by flattening user histories into high-dimensional vectors for use with standard marginal-based mechanisms, we demonstrate that this strategy is insufficient.
sentences.zh: 虽然从业者可能尝试通过将用户历史展平为高维向量以用于标准的基于边际的机制来建模此类数据，但我们证明这一策略是不充分的。

sentences.en: Flattening fails to preserve temporal coherence even when it maintains valid marginal distributions.
sentences.zh: 即使展平维持有效的边际分布，它也无法保留时间连贯性。

sentences.en: We introduce PATH, a novel generative framework that treats the full table as the unit of synthesis and leverages the autoregressive capabilities of privately fine-tuned large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入PATH，一个新颖的生成框架，将完整表作为合成单元，并利用私有微调的大型语言模型的自回归能力。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations show that PATH effectively captures long-range dependencies that traditional methods miss.
sentences.zh: 大量评估表明，PATH有效捕捉传统方法遗漏的长程依赖。

sentences.en: Empirically, our method reduces the distributional distance to real trajectories by over 60% and reduces state transition errors by nearly 50% compared to leading marginal mechanisms while achieving similar marginal fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，与领先的边际机制相比，我们的方法将到真实轨迹的分布距离降低超过60%，并将状态转移误差降低近50%，同时实现相似的边际保真度。

title_en: PrivCode++: Latent-Conditioned Differentially Private Code Generation for Comprehensive Guarantees
title_zh: PrivCode++：面向全面保证的潜在条件化差分私有代码生成

sentences.en: Large language models fine-tuned on instruction–code pairs may memorize and subsequently leak sensitive training data.
sentences.zh: 在指令-代码对上微调的大型语言模型可能记忆并随后泄露敏感的训练数据。

sentences.en: Existing differentially private (DP) code generation methods primarily protect code snippets while assuming prompts are public, which fails in realistic scenarios where prompts may also contain sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 现有的差分私有（DP）代码生成方法主要保护代码片段，同时假设提示是公共的，这在提示也可能包含敏感信息的现实场景中失效。

sentences.en: When prompts cannot be explicitly learned or used during generation, code synthesis suffers from severe utility degradation as well as reduced diversity and fidelity.
sentences.zh: 当生成期间无法显式学习或使用提示时，代码合成遭受严重的效用退化以及降低的多样性与保真度。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose PrivCode++, the first work to explore DP code generation where both prompts and code snippets are considered sensitive in LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出PrivCode++，第一个在LLM微调中将提示与代码片段都视为敏感来探索DP代码生成的工作。

sentences.en: PrivCode++ introduces a two-stage DP framework with a Privacy-Free Latent Conditioning module, enabling effective DP fine-tuning and data synthesis without direct access to sensitive prompts or code.
sentences.zh: PrivCode++引入一个带隐私无关潜在条件化模块的两阶段DP框架，使有效的DP微调与数据合成无需直接访问敏感提示或代码。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that PrivCode++ achieves substantially higher utility than baselines, remains competitive with the method with relaxing privacy assumptions, and provides stronger privacy guarantees.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，PrivCode++取得较基线大幅更高的效用，在放宽隐私假设的情况下仍与方法保持竞争力，并提供更强的隐私保证。

title_en: PrivGate: Steering Contextual Integrity in LLMs via Latent Space Geometry
title_zh: PrivGate：通过潜在空间几何引导LLM中的情境完整性

sentences.en: Securing Contextual Integrity (CI) is critical for privacy-preserving Large Language Model (LLM) agent execution.
sentences.zh: 保障情境完整性（CI）对于隐私保护的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体执行至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing agents struggle to balance the agility of direct generation against the prohibitive latency of CI-constrained thinking.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有智能体难以在直接生成的敏捷性与CI约束思考的过高延迟之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose PrivGate, a framework that selectively invokes explicit reasoning based on internal privacy signals.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出PrivGate，一个基于内部隐私信号选择性地调用显式推理的框架。

sentences.en: Our approach is grounded in the discovery of a privacy manifold, where models linearly encode privacy sensitivity within their residual streams, even during non-compliant generation.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法扎根于一个隐私流形的发现，即模型在其残差流中线性编码隐私敏感性，即使在不合规生成期间也是如此。

sentences.en: Leveraging this structure, PrivGate employs Latent Gating, a training-free mechanism that requires no fine-tuning of the base LLM and triggers explicit reasoning only when high latent risk is detected, thereby optimizing the efficiency-privacy trade-off by minimizing unnecessary compute.
sentences.zh: 利用这一结构，PrivGate采用潜在门控（Latent Gating），一种无需训练且无需对基础LLM进行微调的机制，只在检测到高潜在风险时触发显式推理，从而通过最小化不必要的计算优化效率-隐私权衡。

sentences.en: On the contextual PrivacyLens benchmark, PrivGate maintains consistently high performance in out-of-distribution risk identification, validating the generalizability of the discovered manifold.
sentences.zh: 在情境PrivacyLens基准上，PrivGate在分布外风险识别中保持持续的高性能，验证了所发现流形的泛化性。

sentences.en: End-to-end evaluations show that PrivGate achieves a 62.6% average relative reduction in privacy leakage with 15.9% token overhead, offering a practical pathway to reconcile rigorous CI requirements with the performance demands of LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 端到端评估表明，PrivGate以15.9%的词元开销实现隐私泄漏62.6%的平均相对降低，为调和严格CI要求与LLM智能体性能需求提供了实用路径。

title_en: Privileged Information Distillation for Language Models
title_zh: 语言模型的特权信息蒸馏

sentences.en: Training-time privileged information (PI) can enable language models to succeed on tasks they would otherwise fail, making it a powerful tool for reinforcement learning in hard, long-horizon settings.
sentences.zh: 训练时的特权信息（PI）能够使语言模型在它们否则会失败的任务上取得成功，使其成为困难长跨度设定中强化学习的强大工具。

sentences.en: However, transferring capabilities learned with PI to policies that must act without it at inference time remains a fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，将在PI帮助下习得的能力迁移到推理时必须在无PI情况下行动的策略，仍是一个根本挑战。

sentences.en: We study this problem in the context of distilling frontier models for multi-turn agentic environments, where closed-source systems typically hide their internal reasoning and expose only action trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们在蒸馏多轮智能体环境前沿模型的背景下研究这一问题，在这些环境中闭源系统通常隐藏内部推理，只暴露动作轨迹。

sentences.en: This breaks standard distillation pipelines, since successful behavior is observable but the reasoning process is not.
sentences.zh: 这打破了标准的蒸馏流程，因为成功行为是可观察的，但推理过程不可观察。

sentences.en: We introduce π-Distill, a joint teacher–student framework that trains a PI-conditioned teacher and an unconditioned student simultaneously within a single shared-parameter model, enabling the teacher to learn how to use PI while mitigating distribution shift during transfer.
sentences.zh: 我们引入π-Distill，一个联合师生框架，在单个共享参数模型中同时训练一个PI条件的教师与一个无条件的学生，使教师能学习如何利用PI，同时缓解迁移期间的分布偏移。

sentences.en: We show that π-Distill effectively distills frontier agents using action-only privileged information, matching or outperforming industry-standard pipelines that assume access to full Chain-of-Thought supervision across multiple agentic benchmarks, models, and forms of PI.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，π-Distill使用仅动作的特权信息有效蒸馏前沿智能体，在多个智能体基准、模型与PI形式上匹配或超越假设可访问完整思维链监督的行业标准流程。

sentences.en: We complement our results with extensive analysis that characterize what factors enable effective learning with PI.
sentences.zh: 我们辅以大量分析来刻画使PI有效学习的因素。

title_en: PRM-PBE: Process Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning in Programming-by-Example
title_zh: PRM-PBE：用于示例编程强化学习的过程奖励模型

sentences.en: Programming-by-Example (PBE), as a typical few-shot inductive reasoning paradigm, aims to synthesize corresponding algorithms from a set of input-output examples.
sentences.zh: 示例编程（PBE）作为一种典型的少样本归纳推理范式，旨在从一组输入输出示例中合成相应的算法。

sentences.en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong program synthesis potential, they still remain ineffective when handling complex PBE tasks.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）已展现出强大的程序合成潜力，但它们在处理复杂PBE任务时仍然低效。

sentences.en: Specifically, LLMs often struggle to accurately grasp the underlying intent of examples, resulting in synthesized programs that either partially satisfy the examples or completely deviate from the target.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LLM往往难以准确把握示例的底层意图，导致合成的程序要么部分满足示例，要么完全偏离目标。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce a process-supervised reinforcement learning method that provides fine-grained feedback during the synthesis process, improving the ability of LLMs to capture the intended behavior of provided examples.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们引入一种过程监督的强化学习方法，在合成过程中提供细粒度反馈，提高LLM捕捉所给示例预期行为的能力。

sentences.en: Firstly, we develop a reasoning tree construction method that is used to build a PBE process supervision dataset.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们开发一种推理树构建方法，用于构建PBE过程监督数据集。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we train a process reward model through preference learning to evaluate the effectiveness of reasoning steps.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们通过偏好学习训练一个过程奖励模型，以评估推理步骤的有效性。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce a curriculum learning strategy based on the difficulty of PBE tasks, using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to optimize the model.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入一个基于PBE任务难度的课程学习策略，使用近端策略优化（PPO）优化模型。

sentences.en: Experimental results on representative PBE benchmarks show that our approach achieves an average pass rate of 56.61\%, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline by 8.73\%.
sentences.zh: 在代表性PBE基准上的实验结果表明，我们的方法取得56.61\%的平均通过率，显著优于最先进基线8.73\%。

title_en: Proact-VL: A Proactive VideoLLM for Real-Time AI Companions
title_zh: Proact-VL：面向实时AI伴侣的主动视频LLM

sentences.en: Proactive and real-time interactive experiences are essential for human-like AI companions, yet face three key challenges: (1) achieving low-latency inference under continuous streaming inputs, (2) autonomously deciding when to respond, and (3) controlling both quality and quantity of generated content to meet real-time constraints.
sentences.zh: 主动且实时的交互体验对于类人AI伴侣至关重要，但面临三个关键挑战：（1）在持续流式输入下实现低延迟推理，（2）自主决定何时响应，以及（3）控制生成内容的数量与质量以满足实时约束。

sentences.en: In this work, we instantiate AI companions through two gaming scenarios—commentator and guide—selected for their suitability for automatic evaluation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过两个游戏场景——评论员与向导——实例化AI伴侣，它们因其适合自动评估而被选中。

sentences.en: We introduce the Live Gaming Benchmark, a large-scale dataset with three representative scenarios: solo commentary, co-commentary, and user guidance, and present Proact-VL, a general framework that shapes multimodal language models into proactive, real-time interactive agents capable of human-like environment perception and interaction.
sentences.zh: 我们引入Live Gaming基准，一个包含三个代表性场景的大规模数据集：单人评论、双人评论与用户引导，并呈献Proact-VL，一个将多模态语言模型塑造为能够类人环境感知与交互的主动、实时交互智能体的通用框架。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show Proact-VL achieves superior response latency and quality while maintaining strong video understanding capabilities, demonstrating its practicality for real-time interactive applications.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，Proact-VL实现优越的响应延迟与质量，同时保持强大的视频理解能力，证明其对实时交互应用的实用性。

title_en: ProAct: A Benchmark and Multimodal Framework for Structure-Aware Proactive Response
title_zh: ProAct：面向结构感知主动响应的基准与多模态框架

sentences.en: While passive agents merely follow instructions, proactive agents align with higher-level objectives, such as assistance and safety by continuously monitoring the environment to determine when and how to act.
sentences.zh: 虽然被动智能体只是遵循指令，但主动智能体通过持续监控环境以确定何时以及如何行动，与协助与安全等更高级目标对齐。

sentences.en: However, developing proactive agents is hindered by the lack of specialized resources.
sentences.zh: 然而，开发主动智能体受到缺乏专门资源的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce **ProAct-75**, a benchmark designed to train and evaluate proactive agents across diverse domains, including assistance, maintenance, and safety monitoring.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入**ProAct-75**，一个旨在跨协助、维护与安全监控等多样领域训练与评估主动智能体的基准。

sentences.en: Spanning 75 tasks, our dataset features 91,581 step-level annotations enriched with explicit task graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们的数据集横跨75个任务，包含91,581条步级标注，并辅以显式的任务图。

sentences.en: These graphs encode step dependencies and parallel execution possibilities, providing the structural grounding necessary for complex decision-making.
sentences.zh: 这些图编码步骤依赖与并行执行可能性，为复杂决策提供必要的结构根基。

sentences.en: Building on this benchmark, we propose **ProAct-Helper**, a reference baseline powered by a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) that grounds decision-making in state detection, and leveraging task graphs to enable entropy-driven heuristic search for action selection, allowing agents to execute parallel threads independently rather than mirroring the human's next step.
sentences.zh: 在此基准基础上，我们提出**ProAct-Helper**，一个由多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）驱动、将决策扎根于状态检测的参考基线，并利用任务图实现熵驱动启发式搜索进行动作选择，使智能体能独立并行执行线程，而非镜像人类下一步。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProAct-Helper outperforms strong closed-source models, improving trigger detection mF1 by 6.21\%, saving 0.25 more steps in online one-step decision, and increasing the rate of parallel actions by 15.58\%.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，ProAct-Helper优于强闭源模型，将触发检测mF1提升6.21\%，在在线一步决策中节省0.25步更多，并将并行动作率提高15.58\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/ZhuXMMM/ProAct.git
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ZhuXMMM/ProAct.git 获取。

title_en: Proactive Defense Benchmark against Deepfake Generation
title_zh: 针对深度伪造生成的主动防御基准

sentences.en: Despite the proliferation of proactive defenses against deepfakes, the lack of a unified evaluation protocol precludes fair comparison and masks critical vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 尽管针对深度伪造的主动防御激增，但缺乏统一评估协议阻碍了公平比较并掩盖了关键漏洞。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present the first comprehensive benchmark that systematically assesses disruption, robustness, and transferability encompassing pixel, perceptual, and identity metrics.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们呈献第一个系统性评估破坏性、鲁棒性与可迁移性并涵盖像素、感知与身份指标的综合基准。

sentences.en: Our extensive analysis reveals that fidelity and identity metrics capture orthogonal performance axes, often leading to conflicting interpretations when relied upon individually.
sentences.zh: 我们的大量分析揭示，保真度与身份指标捕捉正交的性能轴，单独依赖时往往导致相互冲突的解读。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we identify a fundamental trade-off where peak white-box performance signals overfitting, and we introduce a calibrated evaluation to correct generator-induced identity bias.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们识别出一个根本权衡，即峰值白箱表现发出过拟合信号，并引入一个校准评估来纠正生成器诱导的身份偏差。

sentences.en: By exposing these blind spots, we establish a rigorous standard to guide the development of genuinely generalizable protections.
sentences.zh: 通过暴露这些盲点，我们建立一个严谨的标准，以指导真正可泛化保护的发展。

title_en: ProactiveLLM: Learning Active Interaction for Streaming Large Language Models
title_zh: ProactiveLLM：面向流式大型语言模型的主动交互学习

sentences.en: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) follow a *read-then-generate* paradigm, causing unnecessary latency and computation.
sentences.zh: 标准大型语言模型（LLM）遵循*先读然后生成*范式，导致不必要的延迟与计算。

sentences.en: Streaming LLMs alleviate this issue by generating while receiving inputs, but still struggle to decide when to interact with the stream.
sentences.zh: 流式LLM通过在接收输入的同时生成来缓解这一问题，但仍难决定何时与流交互。

sentences.en: Existing methods either hard-code interaction timing or rely on costly external alignment signals, such as timing labels, reasoning trajectories, or stronger teachers.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么硬编码交互时机，要么依赖昂贵的外部对齐信号，如时序标签、推理轨迹或更强的教师。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose **ProactiveLLM**, which achieves active interaction by leveraging the model's endogenous states to guide interaction decisions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出**ProactiveLLM**，它通过利用模型的内生状态来引导交互决策，实现主动交互。

sentences.en: The model first learns to perceive semantic sufficiency from partial inputs through two complementary training mechanisms: *mask-based streaming modeling* and *synchronized privileged self-distillation (SPSD)*.
sentences.zh: 该模型首先通过两种互补训练机制学会从部分输入中感知语义充分性：*基于掩码的流式建模*与*同步特权自蒸馏（SPSD）*。

sentences.en: The former applies monotonic random masking to the input during training, simulating progressively revealed streaming inputs and enabling the model to learn local semantic dependencies from partial-input views.
sentences.zh: 前者在训练期间对输入应用单调随机掩码，模拟逐步揭示的流式输入，使模型能够从部分输入视角学习局部语义依赖。

sentences.en: The latter aligns the partial-context student view with a full-context teacher view generated by the same evolving model, allowing privileged full-context evidence to guide the student's understanding under incomplete observations.
sentences.zh: 后者将部分上下文的学生视角与同一演化模型生成的全上下文教师视角对齐，使特权的全上下文证据在不完整观测下引导学生的理解。

sentences.en: Together, these mechanisms induce endogenous sufficiency cues *without requiring external teachers or annotations*, providing a versatile foundation for the plug-and-play integration of diverse decision heads.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些机制诱导内生的充分性线索，*无需外部教师或标注*，为各种决策头的即插即用整合提供了通用基础。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation across text and speech streaming tasks confirms that ProactiveLLM significantly reduces interaction latency while maintaining quality, validating its capacity for dynamic and active interaction.
sentences.zh: 跨文本与语音流式任务的大量评估证实，ProactiveLLM在保持质量的同时显著降低交互延迟，验证了其动态主动交互的能力。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/StreamingLLM/tree/main/ProactiveLLM.
sentences.zh: 代码公开可在 https://github.com/EIT-NLP/StreamingLLM/tree/main/ProactiveLLM 获取。

title_en: Probabilistic Bisection Algorithm Provably Achieves Exponential Convergence
title_zh: 概率二分算法可证明地实现指数收敛

sentences.en: The probabilistic bisection algorithm (PBA) extends the classical binary search to settings with noisy responses, and is a foundational algorithm commonly used in basic problems such as root-finding.
sentences.zh: 概率二分算法(probabilistic bisection algorithm, PBA)将经典二分搜索扩展到带有噪声响应的场景中，是一种基础算法，常用于求根等基础问题。

sentences.en: Despite its strong empirical success, its theoretical property, particularly the convergence rate, remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 尽管它在经验上取得了巨大成功，但其理论性质，特别是收敛速度，仍然不清楚。

sentences.en: This paper establishes that PBA converges at a geometric rate, providing a rigorous justification for its empirical efficiency.
sentences.zh: 本文证明PBA以几何速率收敛，为其经验上的高效性提供了严格的证明。

sentences.en: Notably, this rate is optimal in the sense that it matches the performance of classical binary search under noiseless responses.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这一速率在匹配无噪声响应下经典二分搜索性能的意义上是最优的。

sentences.en: The core of our analysis lies in directly characterizing the dynamics of PBA queries, which had not been examined in the prior literature.
sentences.zh: 我们分析的核心在于直接刻画PBA查询的动态，这一点在先前文献中尚未被研究。

sentences.en: We show that the queries oscillate around the truth but steadily draw closer, thus leading to an estimator that rapidly concentrates on the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，查询围绕真实值振荡，但会稳步向其靠近，从而得到一个能快速集中于真实值的估计器。

sentences.en: Beyond resolving the long-standing question of PBA’s convergence, our developed techniques offer new tools for analyzing PBA's dynamics, which may be of independent interest.
sentences.zh: 除了解决PBA收敛这一长期存在的问题外，我们开发的技术为分析PBA的动态提供了新工具，可能具有独立的研究价值。

title_en: Probabilistic Modeling of Latent Agentic Substructures in Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: 深度神经网络中潜在智能子结构的概率建模

sentences.en: We develop a theory of intelligent agency grounded in probabilistic modeling for neural models.
sentences.zh: 我们基于概率建模为神经模型发展了一套智能代理理论。

sentences.en: Agents are represented as outcome distributions with epistemic utility given by log score, and compositions are defined through weighted logarithmic pooling that strictly improves every member's welfare.
sentences.zh: 代理被表示为以对数分数作为认知效用的结果分布，并通过加权对数池化进行组合，这能严格改善每个成员的福利。

sentences.en: We prove that strict unanimity is impossible under linear pooling or in binary outcome spaces, but possible with three or more outcomes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在线性池化或二元结果空间中不可能实现严格一致，但在三种或更多结果下则是可能的。

sentences.en: Our framework admits recursive structure via cloning invariance, continuity, and openness, while tilt-based analysis rules out trivial duplication.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架通过克隆不变性、连续性和开放性支持递归结构，而基于倾斜的分析排除了平凡的重复。

sentences.en: Finally, we formalize an agentic alignment phenomenon in LLMs using our theory: eliciting a benevolent persona ("Luigi'') induces an antagonistic counterpart ("Waluigi''), while a manifest-then-suppress Waluigi strategy yields strictly larger first-order misalignment reduction than pure Luigi reinforcement alone.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们用我们的理论形式化描述了大型语言模型(LLM)中的智能代理对齐现象：引发一个仁慈的角色（“Luigi”）会催生一个对抗性的对应角色（“Waluigi”），而先显现后抑制的Waluigi策略比单纯的Luigi强化单独作用产生严格更大的首阶错位减轻。

sentences.en: These results clarify how developing a principled mathematical framework for how subagents can coalesce into coherent higher-level entities provides novel implications for alignment in agentic AI systems.
sentences.zh: 这些结果阐明了：开发一个原则性的数学框架来说明子代理如何能够合并为连贯的更高层次实体，为智能代理AI系统的对齐提供了新颖的启示。

title_en: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 多任务强化学习的概率性能保证

sentences.en: Multi-task reinforcement learning trains generalist policies that can execute multiple tasks.
sentences.zh: 多任务强化学习训练能够执行多个任务的通用策略。

sentences.en: While recent years have seen significant progress, existing approaches rarely provide formal performance guarantees, which are indispensable when deploying policies in safety-critical settings.
sentences.zh: 尽管近年来取得了显著进展，但现有方法很少提供正式的性能保证，而在安全关键场景中部署策略时，这些保证是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: We present an approach for computing high-confidence guarantees on the performance of a multi-task policy on tasks not seen during training.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种方法，用于对多任务策略在训练中未遇到的任务上的性能计算高置信度保证。

sentences.en: Concretely, we introduce a new generalisation bound that composes (i) per-task lower confidence bounds from finitely many rollouts with (ii) task-level generalisation from finitely many sampled tasks, yielding a high-confidence guarantee for new tasks drawn from the same arbitrary and unknown distribution.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入一个新的泛化界，它将有限次 rollout 得到的每任务下置信界与有限个采样任务得到的任务级泛化相结合，从而为从同一任意未知分布中抽取的新任务提供高置信度保证。

sentences.en: Across state-of-the-art multi-task RL methods, we show that the guarantees are theoretically sound and informative at realistic sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 在多种最先进的多任务强化学习方法中，我们表明这些保证在理论上健全，并且在现实样本规模下具有信息量。

title_en: Probabilistic Pretraining for Improved Neural Regression
title_zh: 用于改进神经回归的概率预训练

sentences.en: While transfer learning has revolutionized computer vision and natural language processing, its application to probabilistic regression remains underexplored, particularly for tabular data.
sentences.zh: 虽然迁移学习已经彻底改变了计算机视觉和自然语言处理，但它在概率回归中的应用仍未被充分探索，尤其是在表格数据上。

sentences.en: We introduce NIAQUE (Neural Interpretable Any-Quantile Estimation), a novel permutation-invariant architecture that enables effective transfer learning across diverse regression tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出NIAQUE(神经可解释任意分位数估计)，一种新颖的置换不变架构，能够在多种回归任务之间实现有效的迁移学习。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on 101 datasets, we demonstrate that pre-training NIAQUE on multiple datasets and fine-tuning on target datasets consistently outperforms both traditional tree-based models and transformer-based neural baseline.
sentences.zh: 通过在101个数据集上的大量实验，我们表明，先在多个数据集上预训练NIAQUE，再在目标数据集上微调，其性能始终优于传统的基于树的方法和基于transformer的神经基线。

sentences.en: On real-world Kaggle competitions, NIAQUE achieves competitive performance against heavily hand-crafted and feature-engineered solutions and outperforms strong baselines such as TabPFN and TabDPT, while maintaining interpretability through its probabilistic framework.
sentences.zh: 在真实的Kaggle竞赛中，NIAQUE取得了与大量手工构造和特征工程解决方案相当的性能，并超越了TabPFN和TabDPT等强基线，同时通过其概率框架保持了可解释性。

sentences.en: Our results establish NIAQUE as a robust and scalable approach for tabular regression, effectively bridging the gap between traditional methods and modern transfer learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果确立了NIAQUE作为表格回归的一种稳健且可扩展的方法，有效弥合了传统方法与现代迁移学习之间的差距。

title_en: Probabilistic Retrofitting of Learned Simulators
title_zh: 学习得到的模拟器的概率改造

sentences.en: Dominant approaches for modelling Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) rely on deterministic predictions, yet many physical systems of interest are inherently chaotic and uncertain.
sentences.zh: 对偏微分方程(PDE)进行建模的主流方法依赖确定性预测，然而许多受关注的物理系统本质上是混沌且不确定的。

sentences.en: While training probabilistic models from scratch is possible, it is computationally expensive and fails to leverage the significant resources already invested in high-performing deterministic backbones.
sentences.zh: 虽然从零开始训练概率模型是可行的，但计算开销大，并且无法利用已投入在高性能确定性骨干网络上的大量资源。

sentences.en: In this work, we adopt a training-efficient strategy to transform pre-trained deterministic models into probabilistic ones via retrofitting with a proper scoring rule: the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们采用一种训练高效的策略，通过使用适当的评分规则——连续排序概率分数(CRPS)——进行改造，将预训练的确定性模型转化为概率模型。

sentences.en: Crucially, this approach is architecture-agnostic: it applies the same adaptation mechanism across distinct model backbones with minimal code modifications.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，这种方法与架构无关：它针对不同的模型骨干网络应用相同的适配机制，只需极少的代码改动。

sentences.en: The method proves highly effective across different scales of pre-training: for models trained on single dynamical systems, we achieve $20–54\%$ reductions in rollout CRPS and up to $30\%$ improvements in variance-normalised RMSE (VRMSE) relative to compute-matched deterministic fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 该方法在不同规模的预训练中都极为有效：对于在单一动力系统上训练的模型，相较于计算量匹配的确定性微调，我们在 rollout CRPS 上实现了 $20–54\%$ 的降低，并在方差归一化RMSE(VRMSE)上实现高达 $30\%$ 的提升。

sentences.en: We further validate our approach on a PDE foundation model, trained on multiple systems and retrofitted on the dataset of interest, to show that our probabilistic adaptation yields an improvement of up to $40\%$  in CRPS and up to $15\%$ in VRMSE compared to deterministic fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在PDE基础模型上验证了该方法，该模型在多个系统上训练并在目标数据集上改造，结果表明与确定性微调相比，我们的概率适配在CRPS上带来高达 $40\%$ 的提升，在VRMSE上带来高达 $15\%$ 的提升。

sentences.en: Validated across diverse architectures and dynamics, our results show that probabilistic PDE modelling need not require retraining from scratch, but can be unlocked from existing deterministic backbones with modest additional training cost.
sentences.zh: 在多种架构与动力学上的验证结果表明，概率PDE建模未必需要从头重新训练，而可以通过适度的额外训练成本从现有确定性骨干网络中解锁。

title_en: Probabilistic Robustness Certificates against Adversarial Attacks
title_zh: 抵御对抗攻击的概率鲁棒性认证

sentences.en: The growing use of machine learning in safety-critical settings heightens vulnerability to *adversarial attacks*.
sentences.zh: 机器学习在安全关键场景中的日益普及，加剧了对对抗性攻击(*adversarial attacks*)的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Existing defense mechanisms typically either lack formal guarantees or depend on restrictive assumptions about the model family, the threat model, or the poisoning budget, and many only offer point-wise certification.
sentences.zh: 现有的防御机制通常要么缺乏正式保证，要么依赖于关于模型族、威胁模型或投毒预算的限制性假设，而且许多仅提供点级认证。

sentences.en: Importantly, they often overlook the inherent stochasticity of modern training pipelines, which undermines their practical reliability.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，它们常常忽视现代训练流程固有的随机性，这削弱了其实际可靠性。

sentences.en: We introduce a probabilistic framework that views gradient-based training as a *discrete-time stochastic dynamical system* and formulates poisoning robustness as a safety verification task.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个概率框架，将基于梯度的训练视为离散时间随机动力系统，并将投毒鲁棒性表述为安全验证任务。

sentences.en: Leveraging *barrier certificates* (BCs), we derive sufficient conditions to probabilistically certify a robust radius against worst-case ${\ell}_p$-bounded poisoning, guaranteeing that the final model parameters remain within a safe set.
sentences.zh: 利用路标认证(barrier certificates, BCs)，我们推导出充分条件，以概率方式认证针对最坏情况 ${\ell}_p$ 有界投毒的鲁棒半径，确保最终模型参数保持在安全集内。

sentences.en: For tractable computation, we represent BCs with neural networks and obtain *probably approximately correct* (PAC) guarantees through a *scenario convex problem*.
sentences.zh: 为便于计算，我们用神经网络表示BC，并通过情景凸规划(secenario convex problem)获得可能近似正确的(PAC)保证。

sentences.en: Our method identifies the largest certified radius for which the trained model is probabilistically accurate with a specified confidence level.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法识别出最大的已认证半径，在此半径下训练得到的模型以指定置信度水平在概率上准确。

sentences.en: Experiments on MNIST, SVHN, and CIFAR-10 show that our framework offers formal robustness guarantees under stochastic training, while being model-agnostic and not requiring prior knowledge of the attack strategy.
sentences.zh: 在MNIST、SVHN和CIFAR-10上的实验表明，我们的框架在随机训练下提供正式的鲁棒性保证，同时与模型无关且无需事先了解攻击策略。

title_en: Probabilistic Salient Object Ranking
title_zh: 概率显著对象排序

sentences.en: Salient Object Ranking (SOR) aims to study how humans visually explore complex scenes by predicting an ordered sequence of objects that attracts our attention.
sentences.zh: 显著对象排序(SOR)旨在通过预测吸引我们注意力的有序对象序列，来研究人类如何视觉地探索复杂场景。

sentences.en: Existing SOR approaches typically model this ranking deterministically, assuming a single, fixed ranking sequence of attention.
sentences.zh: 现有的SOR方法通常以确定性的方式建模这种排序，假设存在一个单一的、固定的注意力排序序列。

sentences.en: However, such deterministic SOR fails to capture the true nature of human attention.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种确定性SOR无法捕捉人类注意力的真实本质。

sentences.en: We observe that human attention shifts exhibit variability and stochasticity, i.e., the next object of fixation is not a definitive choice but rather a probability distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，人类注意力的转移表现出变异性和随机性，即下一个注视对象并非确定的选择，而是一个概率分布。

sentences.en: Yet, existing SOR methods and evaluation metrics do not account for this inherent randomness.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的SOR方法和评估指标并未考虑这种固有的随机性。

sentences.en: To address this fundamental problem, we first propose ProbSOR, a novel Probabilistic Salient Object Ranking framework built upon a vision-language model (VLM) backbone.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个根本问题，我们首先提出ProbSOR，一个构建在视觉-语言模型(VLM)骨干之上的新型概率显著对象排序框架。

sentences.en: By incorporating Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), ProbSOR explicitly learns the uncertainty of attention shifts.
sentences.zh: 通过引入组相对策略优化(GRPO)，ProbSOR显式地学习注意力转移的不确定性。

sentences.en: We then propose a new metric tailored for ProbSOR, as existing SOR metrics only support deterministic rankings.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们提出一个专为ProbSOR定制的新指标，因为现有的SOR指标只支持确定性排序。

sentences.en: We further construct a ProbSOR dataset comprising 15,000 probabilistic SOR samples, to support both model training and evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步构建了一个包含15,000个概率SOR样本的ProbSOR数据集，以同时支持模型训练和评估。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that ProbSOR achieves strong performance in salient object ranking under both our proposed and traditional benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在我们提出的基准和传统基准下，ProbSOR在显著对象排序方面都取得了强劲的性能。

title_en: Probabilistically-routed Bayesian Additive Spanning Trees for Learning on Constrained Domains
title_zh: 用于受限域学习的概率路由贝叶斯加性生成树

sentences.en: Bayesian additive spanning tree (BAST) is an useful tool for interpretable, non-parametric regression on complex constrained domains.
sentences.zh: 贝叶斯加性生成树(BAST)是用于复杂受限域上可解释非参数回归的有用工具。

sentences.en: It improves upon the performance of Bayesian additive regression trees (BART) by replacing axis-aligned splits through binary tree components by cuts on a spanning tree components, enabling the formation of contiguous splits that respect the underlying complex structure.
sentences.zh: 它用生成树分量上的切割替代二叉树分量上的轴对齐分割，从而能够在遵循底层复杂结构的同时形成连续分割，由此改进了贝叶斯加性回归树(BART)的性能。

sentences.en: While BAST is effective for learning on constrained spaces, it still relies on hard partitions, albeit on spanning trees, which limits its ability to represent smoothly varying functions on constrained domains.
sentences.zh: 虽然BAST在受限空间上的学习很有效，但它仍然依赖硬分割（即便是基于生成树的），这限制了它在受限域上表示平滑变化函数的能力。

sentences.en: We propose Probabilistically-routed Bayesian additive spanning trees (PR-BAST), a principled relaxation that replaces hard cuts on  spanning tree components with probabilistic routing along  spanning tree components.
sentences.zh: 我们提出概率路由贝叶斯加性生成树(PR-BAST)，一种原则性的松弛方法，用沿生成树分量的概率路由替代生成树分量上的硬切割。

sentences.en: PR-BAST represents the regression surface as an additive ensemble of such spanning tree-aligned smooth components.
sentences.zh: PR-BAST将回归曲面表示为这种生成树对齐平滑分量的加性集成。

sentences.en: Conditional on a fixed spanning tree, each component in PR-BAST induces a Gaussian random field with a sparse, tree-structured precision matrix, enabling scalable posterior computation via sparse linear algebra.
sentences.zh: 在固定生成树的条件下，PR-BAST中的每个分量会诱导出具有稀疏树结构精度矩阵的高斯随机场，从而能够通过稀疏线性代数实现可扩展的后验计算。

sentences.en: We theoretically establish that  PR-BAST yields strictly faster posterior contraction rates compared to BAST under graph-smooth truth.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明，在图平滑真实值下，PR-BAST的后验收缩速率严格快于BAST。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that PR-BAST consistently improves accuracy over BAST and other baselines, while retaining the interpretability of  tree-based models.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，PR-BAST在准确率上始终优于BAST及其他基线方法，同时保留了基于树模型的可解释性。

title_en: Probability of Matching for Batch Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
title_zh: 批量多目标贝叶斯优化的匹配概率

sentences.en: In batch multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO), it is often desirable to identify the whole Pareto optimal set, especially when considering the complicated interplay between different design criteria and constraints.
sentences.zh: 在批量多目标贝叶斯优化(MOBO)中，往往需要识别整个帕累托最优集，尤其是在考虑不同设计准则和约束之间复杂相互作用的时候。

sentences.en: This poses unique challenges in acquiring batches of both high quality and diversity to cover the Pareto front.
sentences.zh: 这给采集既高质量又多样化的批次以覆盖帕累托前沿带来了独特的挑战。

sentences.en: We propose a novel acquisition strategy, Probability of Matching (POM), which evaluates both batch candidate quality and diversity by explicitly capturing the likelihood that all batch points are Pareto optimal, and the probability that they collectively cover the full Pareto set.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新颖的采集策略，匹配概率(POM)，它通过显式捕捉所有批量点均为帕累托最优的可能性，以及它们共同覆盖完整帕累托集的概率，来评估批量候选的质量与多样性。

sentences.en: To estimate the coverage probability and promote diversity, we incorporate non-replacement sampling principles, resulting in our new POM-guided batch MOBO method.
sentences.zh: 为估计覆盖概率并促进多样性，我们纳入不放回采样原则，从而形成新的POM引导的批量MOBO方法。

sentences.en: Across synthetic benchmarks and real-world tasks, our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard MOBO metrics as well as a new design-space coverage metric, Expected Minimum Distance (EMD), with comparable computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在合成基准和真实世界任务上，我们的方法在标准MOBO指标以及新的设计空间覆盖指标——期望最小距离(EMD)上始终优于最先进的基线方法，且计算效率相当。

title_en: Probability-Entropy Calibration: An Elastic Indicator for Adaptive Fine-tuning
title_zh: 概率-熵校准：自适应微调的弹性指标

sentences.en: Token-level reweighting is a simple yet effective mechanism for controlling supervised fine-tuning, but common indicators are largely one-dimensional: the ground-truth probability reflects downstream alignment, while token entropy reflects intrinsic uncertainty induced by the pre-training prior.
sentences.zh: 词元级重加权是控制监督微调的一种简单而有效的机制，但常见指标基本是一维的：真实标签概率反映下游对齐程度，而词元熵反映预训练先验所诱发的内在不确定性。

sentences.en: Ignoring entropy can misidentify noisy or easily replaceable tokens as learning-critical, while ignoring probability fails to reflect target-specific alignment.
sentences.zh: 忽略熵可能将噪声词元或易于替换的词元误判为学习关键，而忽略概率则无法反映目标特定对齐。

sentences.en: RankTuner introduces a probability--entropy calibration signal, the **Relative Rank Indicator**, by comparing the rank of the ground-truth token with its expected rank under the predictiondiction distribution.
sentences.zh: RankTuner引入一种概率-熵校准信号，即相对秩指标，通过比较真实标签词元的秩与其在预测分布下的期望秩来实现。

sentences.en: The inverse indicator is used as a token-wise **Relative Scale** to reweight the fine-tuning objective, focusing updates on truly under-learned tokens without over-penalizing intrinsically uncertain positions.
sentences.zh: 逆指标被用作词元级的相对尺度来对微调目标进行重加权，将更新聚焦于真正欠学习的词元，同时不过度惩罚内在不确定的位置。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple backbones show consistent improvements on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, transfer gains on out-of-distribution reasoning, and pre code generation performance over probability- or entropy-only reweighting baselines.
sentences.zh: 在多种骨干网络上的实验表明，与仅使用概率或仅使用熵的重加权基线相比，在数学推理基准上取得了一致的改进，在分布外推理上获得了迁移收益，并改善了代码生成性能。
