title_en: Probably Approximately Correct Labels
title_zh: 概率近似正确标签

sentences.en: Obtaining high-quality labeled datasets is often costly, requiring either human annotation or expensive experiments.
sentences.zh: 获取高质量的标注数据集往往成本高昂，需要人工标注或昂贵的实验。

sentences.en: In theory, powerful pre-trained AI models provide an opportunity to automatically label datasets and save costs.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，强大的预训练AI模型为自动标注数据集并节省成本提供了机会。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, these models come with no guarantees on their accuracy, making wholesale replacement of manual labeling impractical.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这些模型在准确性上没有保证，使得完全用其替代人工标注变得不切实际。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a method for leveraging pre-trained AI models to curate cost-effective and high-quality datasets.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种利用预训练AI模型来构建经济高效且高质量数据集的方法。

sentences.en: In particular, our approach results in probably approximately correct labels: with high probability, the overall labeling error is small.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们的方法产生的标签是概率近似正确的：以高概率，整体标注误差很小。

sentences.en: Our method is nonasymptotically valid under minimal assumptions on the dataset or the AI model being studied, and thus enables rigorous yet efficient dataset curation using modern AI models.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在关于数据集或所研究AI模型的极少假设下具有非渐近有效性，从而能够利用现代AI模型进行严谨而高效的数据集构建。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the benefits of the methodology through text annotation with large language models, image labeling with pre-trained vision models, and protein folding analysis with AlphaFold.
sentences.zh: 我们通过大型语言模型的文本标注、预训练视觉模型的图像标注以及AlphaFold的蛋白质折叠分析来展示该方法论的优势。

title_en: ProbeLLM: Automating Principled Diagnosis of LLM Failures
title_zh: ProbeLLM：自动化LLM失败的原则性诊断

sentences.en: Understanding how and why large language models (LLMs) fail is becoming a central challenge as models rapidly evolve and static evaluations fall behind.
sentences.zh: 随着模型快速演进而静态评估逐渐落后，理解大型语言模型(LLM)如何失败以及为何失败正成为一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: While automated probing has been enabled by dynamic test generation, existing approaches often discover isolated failure cases, lack principled control over exploration, and provide limited insight into the underlying structure of model weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 虽然动态测试生成已经实现了自动化探针，但现有方法往往只会发现孤立的失败案例，缺乏对探索的原则性控制，并且对于模型弱点的底层结构提供有限的洞察。

sentences.en: We propose ProbeLLM, a benchmark-agnostic automated probing framework that elevates weakness discovery from individual failures to structured failure modes.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProbeLLM，一个与基准无关的自动化探针框架，将弱点发现从单个失败提升到结构化失败模式。

sentences.en: ProbeLLM formulates probing as a hierarchical Monte Carlo Tree Search, explicitly allocating limited probing budgets between global exploration of new failure regions and local refinement of recurring error patterns.
sentences.zh: ProbeLLM将探针形式化为层次化蒙特卡洛树搜索，在探索新失败区域的全局探索与细化反复出现错误模式的局部细化之间显式分配有限的探针预算。

sentences.en: By restricting probing to verifiable test cases and leveraging tool-augmented generation and verification, ProbeLLM grounds failure discovery in reliable evidence.
sentences.zh: 通过将探针限制在可验证的测试案例，并利用工具增强的生成与验证，ProbeLLM将失败发现建立在可靠证据之上。

sentences.en: Discovered failures are further consolidated into interpretable failure modes via failure-aware embeddings and boundary-aware induction.
sentences.zh: 发现到的失败进一步通过失败感知嵌入和边界感知归纳整合为可解释的失败模式。

sentences.en: Across diverse benchmarks and LLMs, ProbeLLM reveals substantially broader, cleaner, and more fine-grained failure landscapes than static benchmarks and prior automated methods, supporting a shift from case-centric evaluation toward principled weakness discovery
sentences.zh: 在多种基准和LLM上，ProbeLLM揭示出的失败图景比静态基准和先前的自动化方法更广泛、更清晰且更细致，支持从以案例为中心的评估转向原则性的弱点发现。

title_en: Probing Cross-modal Information Hubs in Audio-Visual LLMs
title_zh: 探析音视频LLM中的跨模态信息枢纽

sentences.en: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have recently emerged as a powerful architecture capable of jointly reasoning over audio, visual, and textual modalities.
sentences.zh: 音视频大语言模型(AVLLM)近来已成为一种强大的架构，能够对音频、视觉和文本模态进行联合推理。

sentences.en: In AVLLMs, the bidirectional interaction between audio and video modalities introduces intricate processing dynamics, necessitating a deeper understanding of their internal mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 在AVLLM中，音频与视频模态之间的双向交互引入了复杂的处理动态，因此需要更深入地理解其内部机制。

sentences.en: However, unlike extensively studied text-only or large vision language models, the internal workings of AVLLMs remain largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，与已被广泛研究的纯文本或大型视觉语言模型不同，AVLLM的内部运作在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we focus on cross-modal information flow between audio and visual modalities in AVLLMs, investigating where information derived from one modality is encoded within the token representations of the other modality.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们聚焦于AVLLM中音频与视觉模态之间的跨模态信息流，研究源自某一模态的信息被编码在另一模态词元表示中的何处。

sentences.en: Through an analysis of multiple recent AVLLMs, we uncover two common findings.
sentences.zh: 通过分析多个近期AVLLM，我们发现了两个共同的结果。

sentences.en: First, AVLLMs primarily encode integrated audio-visual information in sink tokens.
sentences.zh: 首先，AVLLM主要将整合后的音视频信息编码在汇聚词元中。

sentences.en: Second, sink tokens do not uniformly hold cross-modal information.
sentences.zh: 其次，汇聚词元并非均匀地承载跨模态信息。

sentences.en: Instead, a distinct subset of sink tokens, which we term cross-modal sink tokens, specializes in storing such information.
sentences.zh: 相反，一个独特的汇聚词元子集，我们称之为跨模态汇聚词元，专门负责存储此类信息。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, we further propose a simple training-free  hallucination mitigation method by encouraging reliance on integrated cross-modal information within cross-modal sink tokens.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们进一步提出一种简单的、无需训练的幻觉缓解方法，通过鼓励依赖跨模态汇聚词元内整合的跨模态信息来实现。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/kaistmm/crossmodal-hub.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/kaistmm/crossmodal-hub 获取。

authors.name: Chaeyoung Jung
authors.institution: KAIST, Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology

title_en: Probing How Scalable Table Data Enhances General Long-Context Reasoning
title_zh: 探析可扩展的表格数据如何增强通用长上下文推理

sentences.en: As real-world tasks grow increasingly complex, long-context reasoning has become a core capability for Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 随着真实世界任务日益复杂，长上下文推理已成为大型语言模型(LLM)的核心能力。

sentences.en: However, few studies explore which data types are effective for long-context reasoning and why.
sentences.zh: 然而，很少有研究探讨哪些数据类型对长上下文推理有效以及为何有效。

sentences.en: We find that structured table data with periodic structures shows strong potential for long-context reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，具有周期结构的结构化表格数据在长上下文推理方面展现出强大的潜力。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we mathematically analyze tabular dependency structures using mutual information, revealing periodic non-vanishing dependencies in table data.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们用互信息对表格依赖结构进行数学分析，揭示出表格数据中存在周期性的非消失依赖。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we systematically analyze the capabilities of structured table data, conduct relevant scaling experiments, and validate its underlying mechanisms for enhancing long-context reasoning, yielding several meaningful insights.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们系统地分析了结构化表格数据的能力，开展了相关的规模扩展实验，并验证了其增强长上下文推理的底层机制，得出了若干有意义的洞见。

sentences.en: Leveraging these insights, we propose a simple yet scalable pipeline(TableLong) for synthesizing high-quality, diverse, and verifiable structured table data to boost long-context reasoning via RL.
sentences.zh: 利用这些洞见，我们提出一个简单而可扩展的流水线TableLong，用于合成高质量、多样化且可验证的结构化表格数据，以通过强化学习提升长上下文推理。

sentences.en: Extensive experimental results demonstrate that table data significantly enhances the long-context reasoning capability of LLMs across multiple long-context benchmarks (+8.24\% on average), and even improves performance on out-of-domain benchmarks (+8.06\% on average).
sentences.zh: 大量实验结果表明，表格数据显著增强了LLM在多个长上下文基准上的长上下文推理能力（平均+8.24\%），甚至提升了在域外基准上的性能（平均+8.06\%）。

sentences.en: We hope that our insights provide practical guidance for effective post-training data to enhance long-context reasoning in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们希望我们的洞见能为有效的后训练数据提供实用指导，以增强LLM中的长上下文推理。

authors.name: Yang Liu
authors.institution: Academy of Mathematics and Systems Sciences

title_en: Probing RLVR Training Instability through the Lens of Objective-Level Hacking
title_zh: 从目标层级欺骗的视角探析RLVR训练不稳定性

sentences.en: Prolonged reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to drive continuous improvements in the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but the training is often prone to instabilities, especially in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures.
sentences.zh: 已有研究表明，使用可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)的长期训练能够推动大型语言模型推理能力的持续提升，但训练往往容易不稳定，尤其是在混合专家(MoE)架构中。

sentences.en: Training instability severely undermines model capability improvement, yet its underlying causes and mechanisms remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 训练不稳定性严重削弱了模型能力的提升，但其根本原因和机制仍鲜为人知。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a principled framework for understanding RLVR instability through the lens of *objective-level hacking*.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入一个原则性框架，从目标层级欺骗(*objective-level hacking*)的视角来理解RLVR的不稳定性。

sentences.en: Unlike reward hacking, which arises from exploitable verifiers, objective-level hacking emerges from *token-level credit misalignment* and is manifested as system-level spurious signals in the optimization objective.
sentences.zh: 与源于可被利用验证器的奖励欺骗不同，目标层级欺骗产生于词元级信用错配，并在优化目标中表现为系统级的虚假信号。

sentences.en: Grounded in our framework, together with extensive experiments on a 30B MoE model, we trace the origin and formalize the mechanism behind a key pathological training dynamic in MoE models: the abnormal growth of the training-inference discrepancy, a phenomenon widely associated with instability but previously lacking a mechanistic explanation.
sentences.zh: 以我们的框架为基础，结合在30B MoE模型上的大量实验，我们追溯了MoE模型中一个关键病理训练动态的起源并形式化其机制：训练-推理差异的异常增长，这一现象虽与不稳定性广泛相关，但此前缺乏机理性的解释。

sentences.en: These findings provide a concrete and causal account of the training dynamics underlying instabilities in MoE models, offering guidance for the design of stable RLVR algorithms.
sentences.zh: 这些发现为MoE模型在不稳定性背后的训练动态提供了具体而因果性的解释，为设计稳定的RLVR算法提供了指导。

authors.name: Xinyuan Zhu
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Probing the Geometry of Diffusion Models with the String Method
title_zh: 用弦方法探析扩散模型的几何结构

sentences.en: Understanding the geometry of learned distributions is fundamental to improving and interpreting diffusion models, yet systematic tools for exploring their landscape remain limited.
sentences.zh: 理解所学分布的几何结构对于改进和解释扩散模型是基础性的，但用于探索其景观的系统性工具仍然有限。

sentences.en: Standard latent-space interpolations fail to respect the structure of the learned distribution, often traversing low-density regions.
sentences.zh: 标准的潜空间插值无法遵循所学分布的结构，往往会穿越低密度区域。

sentences.en: We introduce a framework based on the string method that computes continuous paths between samples by evolving curves under the learned score function.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个基于弦方法的框架，通过在所学分数函数下演化曲线来计算样本之间的连续路径。

sentences.en: Operating on pretrained models without retraining, our approach interpolates between three regimes: pure generative transport, which yields continuous sample paths; gradient-dominated dynamics, which recover minimum energy paths (MEPs); and finite-temperature string dynamics, which compute principal curves---self-consistent paths that balance energy and entropy.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在无需重新训练的预训练模型上运行，可在这三种机制之间插值：纯生成输运，它产生连续的样本路径；梯度主导动力学，它恢复最小能量路径(MEP)；以及有限温度弦动力学，它计算主曲线——即在能量与熵之间取得平衡的自洽路径。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that the choice of regime matters in practice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，机制的选择在实践中很重要。

sentences.en: For image diffusion models, MEPs contain high-likelihood but unrealistic ``cartoon'' images, confirming prior observations that likelihood maxima appear unrealistic; principal curves instead yield realistic morphing sequences despite lower likelihood.
sentences.zh: 对于图像扩散模型，MEP包含高似然但不真实的“卡通”图像，证实了先前关于似然最大值显得不真实的观察；而主曲线尽管似然较低，却产生更真实的形变序列。

sentences.en: For protein structure prediction, our method computes transition pathways between metastable conformers directly from models trained on static structures, yielding paths with physically plausible intermediates.
sentences.zh: 对于蛋白质结构预测，我们的方法直接从静态结构上训练的模型计算亚稳态构象之间的转变路径，得到具有物理上合理中间体的路径。

sentences.en: Together, these results establish the string method as a principled tool for probing the modal structure of diffusion models---identifying modes, characterizing barriers, and mapping connectivity in complex learned distributions.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些结果确立了弦方法作为探析扩散模型模态结构的原理性工具——识别模态、刻画势垒，并映射复杂所学分布中的连通性。

title_en: Probing the Inductive Bias of Neural Networks through Learning Random Cellular Automata
title_zh: 通过学习随机元胞自动机探析神经网络的归纳偏置

sentences.en: Why do neural networks generalize well on natural data?
sentences.zh: 为什么神经网络在自然数据上能够很好地泛化？

sentences.en: Natural data originates from processes subject to specific physical constraints, such as temporal and spatial invariance, that make it easier to learn.
sentences.zh: 自然数据源自受特定物理约束支配的过程，如时间与空间不变性，这些约束使其更容易学习。

sentences.en: We investigate the sufficiency of these properties using 2D cellular automata as a controlled testbed: systems that are perfectly local, symmetric, and deterministic.
sentences.zh: 我们使用二维元胞自动机作为受控测试平台，来研究这些性质的充分性：这些系统是完美局部、对称且确定性的。

sentences.en: We find that these conditions alone are \textit{not sufficient} to predict the $k$-step evolution of a cellular automaton.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，仅凭这些条件并不\textit{not sufficient}，无法预测元胞自动机的 $k$ 步演化。

sentences.en: We then examine smoothness (average sensitivity) as an additional criterion and find it predictive but still incomplete.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将平滑性（平均敏感度）作为附加判据加以考察，发现它具有预测性但仍不完整。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce a circuit complexity perspective, hypothesizing that natural functions are computable by small circuits.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入电路复杂性的视角，假设自然函数可由小电路计算。

sentences.en: Junta coefficients, measuring the concentration of Fourier weight by interaction degree, provide a tighter predictor of learnability and a correspondence to combinatorial complexity.
sentences.zh: Junta系数衡量傅里叶权重按交互程度的集中度，它提供了对可学性更紧致的预测，并与组合复杂度相对应。

sentences.en: Across architectures (CNNs, transformers, MLPs), learnable functions are predominantly those with spectral weight concentrated at low degrees and therefore low complexity.
sentences.zh: 在各种架构（CNN、transformer、MLP）中，可学习的函数主要是那些谱权重集中于低阶交互、因而复杂度较低的函数。

sentences.en: These results would be consistent with the hypothesis that natural data is learnable because natural dynamics filters out complex, high-degree interactions.
sentences.zh: 这些结果与如下假设一致：自然数据之所以可学，是因为自然动力学过滤掉了复杂的高阶交互。

title_en: Probing the Knowledge Boundary: An Interactive Agentic Framework for Deep Knowledge Extraction
title_zh: 探测知识边界：用于深度知识提取的交互式智能体框架

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be seen as compressed knowledge bases, but it remains unclear what knowledge they truly contain and how far their knowledge boundary extends.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)可被视为压缩的知识库，但它们真正包含哪些知识以及其知识边界延伸多远，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks are mostly static and provide limited support for systematic knowledge probing.
sentences.zh: 现有的基准大多是静态的，对系统性知识探测的支持有限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose an interactive agentic framework to systematically extract and quantify the knowledge of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个交互式智能体框架，用于系统性地提取并量化LLM的知识。

sentences.en: Our method includes four adaptive exploration policies to probe knowledge at different granularity.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法包含四种自适应探索策略，以在不同粒度上探析知识。

sentences.en: To ensure the quality of extracted knowledge, we introduce a three-stage knowledge processing pipeline that combines vector-based filtering to remove strict duplicates, LLM-based adjudication to resolve ambiguous semantic overlap, and domain relevance auditing to retain valid knowledge units.
sentences.zh: 为确保所提取知识的质量，我们引入一个三阶段知识处理流水线，将基于向量的过滤（去除严格重复）、基于LLM的裁决（解决模糊的语义重叠）以及领域相关性审查（保留有效的知识单元）相结合。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we find that Recursive Taxonomy is the most effective exploration strategy.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们发现递归分类法是最高效的探索策略。

sentences.en: We also observe a clear knowledge scaling law, where larger models consistently recover more knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我们还观察到清晰的知识规模定律，即更大的模型始终能恢复更多知识。

sentences.en: In addition, we identify a Pass@1 versus Pass@k trade-off: domain-specialized models achieve higher initial accuracy but experience rapid degradation, while general-purpose models maintain stable performance over extended extraction.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们识别出Pass@1与Pass@k之间的权衡：领域专化模型初始准确率更高但会迅速退化，而通用模型在长时间提取过程中保持稳定的性能。

sentences.en: Finally, our results show that differences in training data composition lead to distinct and measurable knowledge profiles across model families, reflecting how pretraining shapes each model's parametric knowledge.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的结果表明，训练数据构成的差异会导致不同模型家族之间呈现出独特且可测量的知识画像，反映了预训练如何塑造每个模型的参数化知识。

authors.name: Tao Feng
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

title_en: Problem Distributions as Tasks: Repurposing Meta Learning for Generative Combinatorial Optimization towards Multi-task Pretraining and Adaptation
title_zh: 把问题分布视为任务：重新利用元学习实现面向多任务预训练与适配的生成式组合优化

sentences.en: Despite the fast progress of Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) on graphs, existing solvers mainly learn a narrow task (e.g., uniform TSP) at a time and hardly handle instances over diverse distributions.
sentences.zh: 尽管神经组合优化(NCO)在图上的进展迅速，但现有求解器主要一次学习一个狭窄的任务（如均匀TSP），难以处理来自多种分布的实例。

sentences.en: This paper proposes M$^2$GenCO, a **M**ulti-task learning framework that pioneers the instantiation of the **M**eta-learning mechanism with diffusion-based **Gen**erative solving for **CO** Problems (COPs) on graphs, first formulating "tasks" in meta-learning as distinct problem types instead of instances of the same problem.
sentences.zh: 本文提出M$^2$GenCO，一个多任务学习框架，率先将元学习机制与基于扩散的生成式求解相实例化用于图上的组合优化问题(COP)，首次将元学习中的“任务”形式化为不同的问题类型而非同一问题的实例。

sentences.en: With a tailored lightweight graph neural network, our framework performs effective joint pre-training on a variety of problem types and efficient fine-tuning to adapt for out-of-distribution scenarios.
sentences.zh: 凭借定制化的轻量图神经网络，我们的框架能够在多种问题类型上进行有效的联合预训练，并进行高效的微调以适应分布外场景。

sentences.en: Further, we establish a benchmark comprising 5 classic graph COPs with varying scales and multiple distributions, forming 38 distinct test datasets that facilitate standard evaluation of generalizability and adaptability for NCO solvers.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们建立一个涵盖5个经典图COP、具有不同规模与多种分布的基准，形成38个不同的测试数据集，以方便对NCO求解器的泛化性与适应性进行标准评估。

sentences.en: Empirically, M$^2$GenCO with greedy decoder yields an overall 9.16\% performance gain with an average 95.6$\times$ acceleration for inference, and achieves concrete state-of-the-arts on all test sets with simple local searchers, maintaining superior solving time against previous neural methods.
sentences.zh: 实验上，采用贪婪解码器的M$^2$GenCO整体性能提升9.16\%，推理平均加速95.6$\times$，并且在所有测试集上仅用简单局部搜索即取得当前最先进水平，同时保持优于先前神经方法的求解时间。

sentences.en: The computational resource and time consumption for training are saved by up to 82% and 91%, respectively.
sentences.zh: 训练所需的计算资源与时间分别节省高达82%和91%。

title_en: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts
title_zh: ProbMoE：混合专家的可微分概率路由

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale by activating only a small subset of experts per token.
sentences.zh: 混合专家(MoE)模型通过每个词元只激活一小部分专家来实现模型的扩展。

sentences.en: However, training such models remains challenging because top-$k$ routing is discrete and non-differentiable, requiring gradient estimators for expert selection whose design remains a central open problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练这类模型仍然具有挑战性，因为 top-$k$ 路由是离散且不可微的，需要为专家选择设计梯度估计器，而这一设计仍是核心的开放问题。

sentences.en: We introduce ProbMoE, a probabilistic routing framework that models expert selection as a distribution over cardinality-constrained expert subsets and formulates routing as probabilistic inference in this discrete subset space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProbMoE，一个概率路由框架，它将专家选择建模为基数受约束专家子集上的分布，并将路由形式化为这一离散子集空间中的概率推断。

sentences.en: We first propose ProbMoE Exact-$k$ routing, which samples $k$-expert subsets in the forward pass, and the backward pass uses gradients through each expert's exact marginal probability as a tractable surrogate for the true gradient.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出ProbMoE Exact-$k$ 路由，在前向过程中采样 $k$ 个专家的子集，后向过程则利用每个专家精确边际概率的梯度作为真实梯度的可处理替代。

sentences.en: ProbMoE naturally generalizes to a dynamic-$k$ routing setting, where both training and inference constrain the routing cardinality to the same predefined range, allowing adaptive expert allocation per token.
sentences.zh: ProbMoE自然地推广到动态-$k$ 路由设置，其中训练和推理都将路由基数约束到同一预定义范围内，从而允许每个词元的自适应专家分配。

sentences.en: Across benchmarks and model backbones, ProbMoE Exact-$k$ achieves strong performance compared to competitive baselines, with improved expert utilization and routing diversity;
sentences.zh: 在多种基准和模型骨干上，ProbMoE Exact-$k$ 相较于有竞争力的基线取得了强劲的性能，并改善了专家利用率与路由多样性；

sentences.en: ProbMoE Dynamic-$k$ achieves comparable performance with fewer activated experts.
sentences.zh: ProbMoE Dynamic-$k$ 以更少的激活专家取得了相当的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/HengHugoZhao/ProbMoE.git
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/HengHugoZhao/ProbMoE.git 获取。

title_en: Procedural Generation Of Algorithm Discovery Tasks in Machine Learning
title_zh: 机器学习中算法发现任务的程序化生成

sentences.en: Automating the development of machine learning algorithms has the potential to unlock new breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 自动化的机器学习算法开发具有开启新突破的潜力。

sentences.en: However, our ability to *improve* and *evaluate* algorithm discovery systems has thus far been limited by existing task suites.
sentences.zh: 然而，时至今日，我们改进和评估算法发现系统的能力一直受到现有任务套件的限制。

sentences.en: They suffer from many issues, such as: poor evaluation methodologies; data contamination; and containing saturated or very similar problems.
sentences.zh: 这些套件存在许多问题，例如：评估方法欠佳；数据污染；以及包含已饱和或非常相似的问题。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce *DiscoGen*, a procedural generator of algorithm discovery tasks for machine learning, such as developing optimisers for reinforcement learning or loss functions for image classification.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们引入*DiscoGen*，一个用于机器学习的算法发现任务程序生成器，例如为强化学习开发优化器或为图像分类开发损失函数。

sentences.en: Motivated by the success of procedural generation in reinforcement learning, DiscoGen spans billions of tasks of varying difficulty and complexity from a range of machine learning fields.
sentences.zh: 受强化学习中程序生成成功案例的启发，DiscoGen涵盖了来自多个机器学习领域的数十亿个难度与复杂度各异的任务。

sentences.en: These tasks are specified by a small number of configuration parameters and can be used to optimise algorithm discovery agents (ADAs).
sentences.zh: 这些任务由少量配置参数指定，可用于优化算法发现智能体(ADA)。

sentences.en: We present *DiscoBench*, a fixed, small subset of DiscoGen tasks for principled evaluation of ADAs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*DiscoBench*，一个固定的、规模较小的DiscoGen任务子集，用于对ADA进行原则性评估。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose a number of ambitious, impactful research directions enabled by DiscoGen, and demonstrate its use for ADA optimisation through scaling experiments for automated prompt tuning.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出若干由DiscoGen支持的雄心勃勃且具有影响力的研究方向，并通过自动化提示调优的规模扩展实验展示了其在ADA优化中的应用。

sentences.en: DiscoGen is released open-source.
sentences.zh: DiscoGen已开源发布。

title_en: Procedural Pretraining: Warming Up Language Models with Abstract Data
title_zh: 程序化预训练：用抽象数据为语言模型预热

sentences.en: Pretraining directly on web-scale corpora is the de facto paradigm for building language models.
sentences.zh: 直接在网络规模语料上预训练是构建语言模型的事实范式。

sentences.en: We study an alternative setting where the model is initially exposed to abstract structured data, as a means to ease the subsequent acquisition of rich semantic knowledge, much like humans learn simple logic and mathematics before higher reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一种替代设置，即让模型最初接触抽象的结构化数据，作为减轻后续获取丰富语义知识负担的手段，正如人类在更高层次推理之前先学习简单的逻辑与数学。

sentences.en: We specifically focus on *procedural data*, generated by formal languages and other simple algorithms, as such abstract data.
sentences.zh: 我们特别关注由形式语言及其他简单算法生成的程序化数据，将其作为此类抽象数据。

sentences.en: We first  diagnose the algorithmic skills that different forms of procedural data can improve, often significantly.
sentences.zh: 我们首先诊断不同形式的程序化数据能够改进（且往往显著改进）哪些算法技能。

sentences.en: For example, on context recall (Needle-in-a-haystack), the accuracy jumps from 10 to 98% when pretraining on Dyck sequences (balanced brackets).
sentences.zh: 例如，在上下文回忆（大海捞针）任务上，当使用Dyck序列（平衡括号）进行预训练时，准确率从10%跃升至98%。

sentences.en: Second, we study how these gains are reflected in pretraining larger models (up to 1.3B).
sentences.zh: 其次，我们研究这些收益如何体现在更大模型（高达1.3B）的预训练中。

sentences.en: We find that front-loading as little as 0.1% procedural data significantly outperforms standard pretraining on natural language, code, and informal mathematics (C4, CodeParrot, and DeepMind-Math datasets).
sentences.zh: 我们发现，仅前置加载0.1%的程序化数据，就在自然语言、代码和非正式数学（C4、CodeParrot和DeepMind-Math数据集）上显著优于标准预训练。

sentences.en: Notably, this *procedural pretraining* enables the models to reach the same loss value with only 55, 67, 86% of the original data.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这种程序化预训练使模型仅用原始数据的55%、67%、86%即可达到相同的损失值。

sentences.en: Third, we explore the mechanisms behind and find that procedural pretraining instils non-trivial structure in both attention and MLP layers.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们探究其背后的机制，发现程序化预训练在注意力层和MLP层中都注入了非平凡的结构。

sentences.en: The former is particularly important for structured domains (e.g. code), and the latter for language.
sentences.zh: 前者对于结构化领域（如代码）尤为重要，后者则对语言重要。

sentences.en: Finally, we lay a path for combining multiple forms of procedural data.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们为组合多种形式的程序化数据铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Our results show that procedural pretraining is a simple, lightweight means to improving performance and accelerating language model pretraining, ultimately suggesting the promise of disentangling knowledge acquisition from reasoning in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，程序化预训练是一种简单、轻量化的手段，可用于提升性能并加速语言模型预训练，最终表明在LLM中将知识获取与推理解耦的前景。

authors.name: Hemanth Saratchandran
authors.institution: University of Adelaide/Australian Institute of Machine Learning

title_en: Process Reward Agents for Steering Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning
title_zh: 用于引导知识密集推理的过程奖励智能体

sentences.en: Reasoning in knowledge-intensive domains remains challenging as intermediate steps are often not locally verifiable: unlike math or code, evaluating step correctness may require synthesizing clues across large external knowledge sources.
sentences.zh: 知识密集领域的推理仍具挑战性，因为中间步骤往往无法局部验证：与数学或代码不同，评估步骤的正确性可能需要跨大型外部知识源综合线索。

sentences.en: As a result, subtle errors can propagate through reasoning traces, potentially never to be detected.
sentences.zh: 因此，细微的错误会在推理轨迹中传播，甚至可能永远无法被检测到。

sentences.en: Prior work has proposed process reward models (PRMs), including retrieval-augmented variants, but these methods operate post hoc, scoring completed trajectories, which prevents their integration into dynamic inference procedures.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作提出了过程奖励模型(PRM)，包括检索增强的变体，但这些方法事后运行，对完成的轨迹打分，这阻碍了它们融入动态推理过程。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce Process Reward Agents (PRA), an inference-time method for providing domain-grounded, online, step-wise rewards to a frozen policy.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们引入过程奖励智能体(PRA)，一种推理时方法，为冻结策略提供基于领域、在线的逐步奖励。

sentences.en: In contrast to prior retrieval-augmented PRMs, PRA enables search-based decoding to rank and prune candidate trajectories at every generation step.
sentences.zh: 与先前的检索增强PRM不同，PRA使基于搜索的解码能够在每个生成步骤对候选轨迹进行排序和剪枝。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple medical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PRA consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 81.9% accuracy on MedQA with Qwen3-4B, a new state of the art at the 4B scale.
sentences.zh: 在多个医学推理基准上的实验表明，PRA始终优于强基线，在使用Qwen3-4B时于MedQA上达到81.9%的准确率，这是4B规模下新的最先进水平。

sentences.en: Importantly, PRA generalizes to unseen frozen policy models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters, improving their accuracy by up to 25.7% without any policy model updates.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，PRA能够泛化到从0.5B到8B参数的各种未见过的冻结策略模型，在不对策略模型进行任何更新的情况下将其准确率最多提升25.7%。

sentences.en: More broadly, PRA suggests a paradigm in which frozen reasoners are decoupled from domain-specific reward modules, allowing the deployment of new backbones in complex domains without retraining.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，PRA提出了一种范式，其中冻结的推理器与领域特定的奖励模块解耦，从而可以在复杂领域部署新的骨干网络而无需重新训练。

sentences.en: All code and data are publicly available at https://process-reward-agents.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 所有代码和数据均可在 https://process-reward-agents.github.io/ 公开获取。

title_en: Process Reward Models That Think
title_zh: 会思考的过程奖励模型

sentences.en: Step-by-step verifiers—also known as process reward models (PRMs)—are a key ingredient for test-time scaling, but training them requires expensive step-level supervision.
sentences.zh: 逐步验证器——又称过程奖励模型(PRM)——是测试时扩展的关键要素，但训练它们需要昂贵的步骤级监督。

sentences.en: This work aims to build data-efficient PRMs as verbalized step-wise reward models that verify every step in the solution by generating a verification chain-of-thought (CoT).
sentences.zh: 本工作旨在构建数据高效的过程奖励模型，作为言语化的逐步奖励模型，通过生成验证思维链(CoT)来验证解决方案中的每个步骤。

sentences.en: We propose ThinkPRM, a long CoT verifier fine-tuned on orders of magnitude fewer process labels than those required by discriminative PRMs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ThinkPRM，一个长CoT验证器，其在过程标签上的微调数据量比判别式PRM所需的数量级更少。

sentences.en: Our approach capitalizes on the inherent reasoning abilities of long CoT models, and outperforms LLM-as-a-Judge and discriminative verifiers—using only 1% of the process labels in PRM800K—across several challenging benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法充分利用长CoT模型固有的推理能力，在多个具有挑战性的基准上，仅使用PRM800K中1%的过程标签，即优于LLM-as-a-Judge和判别式验证器。

sentences.en: Specifically, ThinkPRM beats the baselines on ProcessBench, MATH-500, and AIME ’24 under best-of-N selection and reward-guided search.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在best-of-N选择和奖励引导搜索下，ThinkPRM在ProcessBench、MATH-500和AIME ’24上击败了基线方法。

sentences.en: In an out-of-domain evaluation over subsets of GPQA-Diamond and LiveCodeBench, our PRM surpasses discriminative verifiers trained with the full PRM800K by 8% and 4.5%, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在GPQA-Diamond和LiveCodeBench子集上的域外评估中，我们的PRM分别以8%和4.5%的优势超越了使用完整PRM800K训练的判别式验证器。

sentences.en: Lastly, under the same token budget, ThinkPRM scales up verification compute more effectively compared to LLM-as-a-Judge, outperforming it by 7.2% on a subset of ProcessBench.
sentences.zh: 最后，在相同的词元预算下，与LLM-as-a-Judge相比，ThinkPRM能更有效地扩展验证计算量，在ProcessBench的一个子集上以7.2%的优势胜出。

sentences.en: This work highlights the value of generative, long CoT PRMs that can scale test-time compute for verification while requiring minimal supervision for training.
sentences.zh: 这项工作凸显了生成式长CoT PRM的价值，它们能够扩展用于验证的测试时计算，同时训练所需的监督极少。

authors.name: Hao Peng
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science,  University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

title_en: ProcMEM: Learning Reusable Procedural Memory from Experience via Non-Parametric PPO for LLM Agents
title_zh: ProcMEM：通过非参数PPO让LLM智能体从经验中学习可复用的程序性记忆

sentences.en: LLM-driven agents demonstrate strong performance in sequential decision-making but often rely on on-the-fly reasoning, re-deriving solutions even in recurring scenarios.
sentences.zh: LLM驱动的智能体在序贯决策方面展现出强劲的性能，但往往依赖即时的推理，即使在反复出现的场景中也会重新推导解决方案。

sentences.en: This insufficient experience reuse leads to computational redundancy and execution instability.
sentences.zh: 这种不足的经验复用导致了计算冗余和执行不稳定。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose ProcMEM, a framework that enables agents to autonomously learn procedural memory from interaction experiences without parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出ProcMEM，一个使智能体能够在无需参数更新的情况下从交互经验中自主学习程序性记忆的框架。

sentences.en: By formalizing a Skill-MDP, ProcMEM transforms passive episodic narratives into executable Skills defined by activation, execution, and termination conditions to ensure executability.
sentences.zh: 通过形式化Skill-MDP，ProcMEM将被动的情景叙述转化为由激活、执行和终止条件定义的可执行技能，以确保可执行性。

sentences.en: To achieve reliable reusability without capability degradation, we introduce Non-Parametric PPO, which leverages semantic gradients for high-quality candidate generation and a PPO Gate for robust Skill verification.
sentences.zh: 为在能力不退化的情况下实现可靠的复用性，我们引入非参数PPO，它利用语义梯度进行高质量候选生成，并利用PPO门进行稳健的技能验证。

sentences.en: Through score-based maintenance, ProcMEM sustains compact, high-quality procedural memory.
sentences.zh: 通过基于分数的维护，ProcMEM维持了紧凑、高质量的程序性记忆。

sentences.en: Experimental results across in-domain, cross-task, and cross-agent scenarios demonstrate that ProcMEM achieves \textbf{superior reuse rates and significant performance gains} with extreme memory compression.
sentences.zh: 在域内、跨任务和跨智能体场景中的实验结果表明，ProcMEM在实现极致记忆压缩的同时，取得了\textbf{更优的复用率和显著的性能提升}。

sentences.en: Visualized evolutionary trajectories and Skill distributions further reveal how ProcMEM transparently accumulates, refines, and reuses procedural knowledge to facilitate long-term autonomy.
sentences.zh: 可视化的演化轨迹与技能分布进一步揭示了ProcMEM如何透明地积累、精炼和复用程序性知识，以促进长期自主性。

title_en: ProConMV: Provenance-Enabled Conceptual Framework for Interpretable Multi-View Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
title_zh: ProConMV：面向可解释多视图糖尿病视网膜病变诊断的溯源概念框架

sentences.en: Existing deep learning models have demonstrated potential in Diabetic retinopathy (DR) diagnosis, but they still suffer from three key challenges: reliance on single-source inputs, opaque and untraceable reasoning processes, and the absence of a mechanism for result verification.
sentences.zh: 现有的深度学习模型在糖尿病视网膜病变(DR)诊断中已展现出潜力，但它们仍面临三大关键挑战：依赖单一来源的输入、推理过程不透明且不可追溯，以及缺乏结果验证机制。

sentences.en: Thus, we propose a provenance-enabled concept-based framework for multi-view DR diagnostic (ProConMV), which integrates DR lesion masks, clinical text and multi-view data, utilizing multimodal prompt analysis and visual-text concept interaction to learn the interpretable multi-source input.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个启用溯源的基于概念的多视图DR诊断框架(ProConMV)，它整合DR病变掩膜、临床文本和多视图数据，利用多模态提示分析与视觉-文本概念交互来学习可解释的多来源输入。

sentences.en: During the reasoning stage, the proposed framework introduces lesion concepts for causal reasoning chains combining clinical guidelines, and adds doctor intervention for human-machine collaboration.
sentences.zh: 在推理阶段，所提出的框架引入病变概念以构建结合临床指南的因果推理链，并加入医生干预以实现人机协作。

sentences.en: For dynamic fusion decision and verification in multi-view DR diagnosis, we derive via generalization theory that incorporating each view’s lesion concept uncertainty and grading uncertainty reduces the generalization error upper bound.
sentences.zh: 为在多视图DR诊断中实现动态融合决策与验证，我们通过泛化理论推导出：纳入每个视图的病变概念不确定性与分级不确定性可以降低泛化误差上界。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we design a dual uncertainty-aware module to enable provenance-based verification, ultimately enabling verifiable analysis of DR diagnostic results.
sentences.zh: 相应地，我们设计了一个双不确定性感知模块以实现基于溯源的验证，最终实现对DR诊断结果的可验证分析。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments conducted on two public multi-view DR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
sentences.zh: 在两个公开的多视图DR数据集上进行的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

sentences.en: The code will be released at https://github.com/SoY0ung/ProConMV.
sentences.zh: 代码将在 https://github.com/SoY0ung/ProConMV 发布。

title_en: ProEval: Proactive Failure Discovery and Efficient Performance Estimation for Generative AI Evaluation
title_zh: ProEval：面向生成式AI评估的主动失败发现与高效性能估计

sentences.en: Evaluating generative AI models is increasingly resource-intensive due to slow inference, expensive raters, and a rapidly growing landscape of models and benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 由于推理缓慢、评分成本高昂，以及模型和基准的版图迅速扩大，评估生成式AI模型日益耗费资源。

sentences.en: We propose ProEval, a proactive evaluation framework that leverages transfer learning to efficiently estimate performance and identify failure cases.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProEval，一个主动评估框架，利用迁移学习高效地估计性能并识别失败案例。

sentences.en: ProEval employs pre-trained Gaussian Processes (GPs) as surrogates for the performance score function, mapping model inputs to metrics such as the severity of errors or safety violations.
sentences.zh: ProEval采用预训练的高斯过程(GP)作为性能评分函数的代理，将模型输入映射到诸如错误严重程度或安全违规等指标。

sentences.en: By framing performance estimation as Bayesian quadrature (BQ) and failure discovery as superlevel set sampling, we develop uncertainty-aware decision strategies that actively select or synthesize highly informative inputs for testing.
sentences.zh: 通过将性能估计构建为贝叶斯求积(BQ)，将失败发现构建为超水平集采样，我们开发出不确定性感知的决策策略，主动选择或合成信息量丰富的测试输入。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that our pre-trained GP-based BQ estimator is unbiased and bounded.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明了基于预训练GP的BQ估计器是无偏且有界的。

sentences.en: Empirically, extensive experiments on reasoning, safety alignment, and classification benchmarks demonstrate that ProEval is significantly more efficient than competitive baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验上，在推理、安全对齐和分类基准上的大量实验表明，ProEval显著优于有竞争力的基线方法。

sentences.en: It requires 8–65x fewer samples to achieve estimates within $\pm1\%$ of the ground truth, while simultaneously revealing more diverse failure cases under a stricter evaluation budget.
sentences.zh: 它以8–65倍更少的样本即可获得在真实值 $\pm1\%$ 范围内的估计，同时在更严格的评估预算下揭示更多样化的失败案例。

sentences.en: Our open-sourced code and data can be found at https://github.com/google-deepmind/proeval.
sentences.zh: 我们开源的代码与数据可在 https://github.com/google-deepmind/proeval 获取。

title_en: Profiling the Irrational Agent: Cognitive Modeling of LLM Behaviors in Sequential Jailbreaks
title_zh: 剖析非理性智能体：序贯越狱中LLM行为的认知建模

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, yet they remain vulnerable to sequential jailbreaks that exploit multi-turn interaction to circumvent safety mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地部署在高风险场景中，但它们仍容易受到利用多轮交互规避安全机制的序贯越狱攻击。

sentences.en: Current safety evaluations are largely outcome-based, offering little insight into the latent decision processes that lead to unsafe compliance.
sentences.zh: 当前的安全评估大多基于结果，无法深入洞察导致不安全服从的潜在决策过程。

sentences.en: We propose an interpretable cognitive modeling framework that couples a controlled elicitation paradigm, the Contextual Iowa Gambling Task (C-IGT), with a Generalized Rescorla--Wagner (GRW) architecture to decompose behavior into measurable mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个可解释的认知建模框架，将受控引出范式——情境爱荷华赌博任务(C-IGT)——与广义Rescorla–Wagner(GRW)架构相结合，将行为分解为可测量的机制。

sentences.en: Across a diverse set of mainstream LLMs, we find that sequential vulnerability is not explained by scale alone but emerges from interactions among cognitive factors, including optimism-biased learning, perceptual reward amplification, and choice inertia.
sentences.zh: 在一组多样化的主流LLM上，我们发现序贯脆弱性并不能仅用规模来解释，而是源于各种认知因素的相互作用，包括乐观偏向学习、感知奖励放大和选择惯性。

sentences.en: Moreover, counterfactual feedback and psychologically framed rewards (e.g., regret, authority, threat) substantially accelerate the transition from refusal to compliance.
sentences.zh: 此外，反事实反馈和心理框架化的奖励（如遗憾、权威、威胁）会显著加速从拒绝到服从的转变。

sentences.en: These results yield principled cognitive profiles of LLM "irrationality" and provide insights for interdisciplinary research on LLM agents at the intersection of machine learning and human behavioral science.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为我们提供了LLM“非理性”的原则性认知画像，并为机器学习与人类行为科学交叉领域关于LLM智能体的跨学科研究提供了洞见。

title_en: Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
title_zh: 渐进式塞入：可靠的词元压缩及其揭示的内容

sentences.en: Token cramming compresses sequences into learned embeddings with near-perfect reconstruction, but fixed token budgets and 99\% accuracy thresholds leave it unclear whether residual errors reflect optimization failures or fundamental limits.
sentences.zh: 词元塞入以近乎完美的重建将序列压缩为学得的嵌入，但固定的词元预算和99\%的准确率阈值使我们不清楚残余误差反映的是优化失败还是根本性限制。

sentences.en: We introduce progressive cramming, which grows the target prefix token-by-token, stopping only when reconstruction is no longer achievable within a fixed optimization budget.
sentences.zh: 我们引入渐进式塞入，它逐个词元地增长目标前缀，仅在固定优化预算内无法再实现重建时停止。

sentences.en: Progressive trajectories occupy low-dimensional structure in embedding space.
sentences.zh: 渐进式轨迹在嵌入空间中占据低维结构。

sentences.en: Prepending a crammed embedding causes a moderate but consistent accuracy drop on multiple-choice benchmarks even with the original prefix in context, and collapses capability almost entirely under generative evaluation.
sentences.zh: 即使原始前缀已在上下文中，将塞入的嵌入前置也会在多项选择基准上造成中度但一致的准确率下降，而在生成式评估下几乎完全丧失能力。

sentences.en: Causal attention-knockout interventions trace this degradation to the embedding's interactions in the model's early layers.
sentences.zh: 因果注意力剔除干预将这种退化追溯到嵌入在模型早期层中的交互。

sentences.en: These results position progressive cramming as a tool for studying compression limits and show that perfect reconstruction - achievable through brittle steering rather than transferable semantics - is insufficient for meaningful compression.
sentences.zh: 这些结果将渐进式塞入定位为研究压缩限制的工具，并表明完美重建——通过脆弱的引导而非可迁移语义实现——不足以构成有意义的压缩。

title_en: Progressive Graph Structure Adjustment for Homophily Shift Adaptation
title_zh: 面向同质性偏移适配的渐进式图结构调整

sentences.en: We propose *Progressive Structure Adjustment for Homophily Shift* (*PSAHS*), a lightweight method for *Graph Domain Adaptation* (*GDA*) that explicitly addresses cross-domain mismatch in node-level homophily.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*面向同质性偏移的渐进式结构调整*(*PSAHS*)，一种用于*图域适配*(*GDA*)的轻量方法，显式地解决节点级同质性上的跨域失配。

sentences.en: PSAHS enhances node homophily in the source graph to a prescribed level by reweighting edges and introducing additional intra-class connections for low-homophily nodes, and conservatively refines the target graph using agreement-consistent predictions from a structure-aware *Graph Neural Network* (*GNN*) and an attribute-only *Multi-Layer Perceptron* (*MLP*) to ensure reliability under label scarcity.
sentences.zh: PSAHS通过重新加权边并为低同质性节点引入额外的类内连接，将源图中的节点同质性提升到预定水平，并利用结构感知*图神经网络*(*GNN*)与仅属性*多层感知机*(*MLP*)的一致性预测，保守地精炼目标图，以确保在标签稀缺下的可靠性。

sentences.en: After each structural refinement, domain-adversarial training is employed to align node representations across domains.
sentences.zh: 在每次结构精炼之后，采用域对抗训练来对齐跨域的节点表示。

sentences.en: PSAHS employs a progressive training scheme that alternates between structure adjustment and representation alignment, where increasingly informative representations enable safer homophily correction, and the refined structure in turn improves representation learning.
sentences.zh: PSAHS采用渐进式训练方案，在结构调整与表示对齐之间交替进行，其中信息日益丰富的表示能够实现更安全的同质性校正，而精炼后的结构反过来又改进表示学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple GDA benchmarks demonstrate that PSAHS consistently outperforms strong baselines, with particularly large gains under severe homophily mismatch, highlighting the importance of explicit homophily alignment for effective cross-graph transfer.
sentences.zh: 在多个GDA基准上的大量实验表明，PSAHS始终优于强基线，在严重的同质性失配下收益尤为明显，凸显了显式同质性对齐对有效跨图迁移的重要性。

title_en: Projection-Free Algorithms for Minimax Problems
title_zh: 面向极小极大问题的无投影算法

sentences.en: This paper addresses constrained smooth saddle-point problems in settings where projection onto the feasible sets is computationally expensive.
sentences.zh: 本文处理一类约束光滑鞍点问题，其中投影到可行集上的计算代价高昂。

sentences.en: We bridge the gap between projection-based and projection-free optimization by introducing a unified dual dynamic smoothing framework that enables the design of efficient single-loop algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入一个统一的双动态平滑框架来弥合基于投影与无投影优化之间的差距，该框架能够设计出高效的单循环算法。

sentences.en: Within this framework, we establish convergence results for nonconvex-concave and nonconvex-strongly concave settings.
sentences.zh: 在此框架内，我们为非凸-凹与非凸-强凹情形建立了收敛性结果。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that this framework is naturally applicable to convex-concave problems, providing a unified analysis across varying payoff structures.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明该框架自然地适用于凸-凹问题，从而在多种收益结构上提供统一的分析。

sentences.en: We propose and analyze three algorithmic variants based on the application of a linear minimization oracle over the minimization variable, the maximization variable, or both.
sentences.zh: 我们提出并分析了三种算法变体，分别基于在最小化变量、最大化变量或两者上应用线性最小化预言。

sentences.en: Notably, our analysis yields anytime convergence guarantees without requiring a pre-specified iteration horizon.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的分析无需预先指定迭代视界，即可给出随时收敛保证。

sentences.en: These results significantly narrow the performance gap between projection-free and projection-based methods for minimax optimization.
sentences.zh: 这些结果显著缩小了无投影与基于投影方法在极小极大优化中的性能差距。

title_en: ProjQ: Project-and-Quantize for Adapter-Aware LLM Compression
title_zh: ProjQ：面向适配器感知LLM压缩的投影与量化

sentences.en: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) constitute the standard pipeline for efficient Large Language Model (LLM) deployment.
sentences.zh: 训练后量化(PTQ)与低秩适配(LoRA)构成了高效大型语言模型(LLM)部署的标准流水线。

sentences.en: However, applying them sequentially poses a problem: PTQ often leaves behind random noise that is spread out (across the model's weights) in a way LoRA canot easily fix, meaning that LoRA ends up wasting its limited capacity trying to fix uncorrectable noise instead of improving task performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，顺序应用它们会带来一个问题：PTQ常留下散布（在模型权重中）的随机噪声，LoRA难以轻松修正这些噪声，这意味着LoRA最终将有限的能力浪费在尝试修正无法修正的噪声上，而非提升任务性能。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose \textbf{ProjQ}, a novel framework for  constraining quantization noise to the low-rank manifold via orthogonal subspace projection.
sentences.zh: 我们提出\textbf{ProjQ}，一个通过正交子空间投影将量化噪声约束到低秩流形上的全新框架。

sentences.en: We derive an efficient alternating algorithm that shapes the quantization noise into a low-rank structure, effectively offloading dominant error components to the subsequent adapter while minimizing the residual error in the orthogonal "uncorrectable" subspace.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出一个高效的交替算法，将量化噪声塑造成低秩结构，有效将主导误差成分卸载给后续适配器，同时最小化正交“不可修正”子空间中的残余误差。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that ProjQ preserves strictly greater model plasticity for downstream tasks compared to standard PTQ.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析表明，与标准PTQ相比，ProjQ为下游任务保留了严格更大的模型可塑性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on LLaMA-2, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 confirm that ProjQ consistently outperforms existing methods in both quantization error compensation and downstream task fine-tuning, achieving up to $2\times$ lower evaluation loss for compensation and matching the performance of standard 4-bit baselines on language modeling tasks with only 3 bits.
sentences.zh: 在LLaMA-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3上的大量实验证实，ProjQ在量化误差补偿与下游任务微调方面始终优于现有方法，补偿时的评估损失最多降低$2\times$，并且仅用3比特即可在语言建模任务上匹配标准4比特基线的性能。

sentences.en: The code is available on \url{https://github.com/yy9301/ProjQ}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在\url{https://github.com/yy9301/ProjQ}获取。

title_en: ProMeCD: Unifying Long-Tailed and Noisy Label Learning via White-Box Control
title_zh: ProMeCD：通过白盒控制统一长尾与噪声标签学习

sentences.en: Real-world data is rarely clean; it is plagued by severe class imbalance (long-tailed distributions) and label corruption.
sentences.zh: 现实世界的数据很少是干净的；它受到严重类别不平衡（长尾分布）和标签损坏的困扰。

sentences.en: Current solutions lean heavily on "black-box" meta-learning to re-weight samples.
sentences.zh: 当前的解决方案在很大程度上依赖“黑盒”元学习来重新加权样本。

sentences.en: However, this paradigm introduces a fatal circular dependency: it relies on pristine, balanced validation sets to guide the optimization, which are essentially non-existent in the wild.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种范式引入了致命的循环依赖：它依赖几乎在现实世界中不存在的纯净、平衡的验证集来引导优化。

sentences.en: We propose ProMeCD, a self-referential framework that breaks this dependency by recasting optimization as an autonomous control problem.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProMeCD，一个自指框架，通过将优化重新表述为自主控制问题来打破这种依赖。

sentences.en: Instead of training an opaque neural meta-learner, we employ a transparent proportional-integral controller.
sentences.zh: 我们不再训练不透明的神经元学习器，而是采用透明的比例-积分控制器。

sentences.en: The system monitors ``cognitive entropy'' that is a metric derived from von Mises-Fisher gradient statistics to assess learning uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 该系统监测“认知熵”，这是一个由von Mises-Fisher梯度统计导出的指标，用于评估学习不确定性。

sentences.en: To resolve the scalar ambiguity between tail and noisy samples, ProMeCD employs a decoupled control strategy: it boosts tail classes via integral accumulation of magnitude deficits when directional consistency is high, while suppressing noise via proportional feedback when consistency collapses.
sentences.zh: 为解决尾部样本与噪声样本之间的标量模糊性，ProMeCD采用解耦控制策略：当方向一致性高时，通过幅度亏空的积分累积增强尾部类别；当一致性崩溃时，通过比例反馈抑制噪声。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that this mechanism guarantees convergence and formally prevents the minority initial drop, ensuring monotonic improvement for rare classes.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明该机制保证收敛，并正式防止少数类初始下降，确保稀有类别获得单调改进。

sentences.en: Crucially, ProMeCD is fully white-box and validation-free.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，ProMeCD是完全白盒且无需验证集的。

sentences.en: Experiments on CIFAR-LT, iNaturalist, CIFAR-N, mini WebVision, and Clothing1M confirm that ProMeCD is not merely efficient; it outperforms the recent meta-learner FMW-Net by over 10\% in severe imbalance settings, proving that explicit control theory offers a superior path to handling imperfect data.
sentences.zh: 在CIFAR-LT、iNaturalist、CIFAR-N、mini WebVision和Clothing1M上的实验证实，ProMeCD不仅高效，而且在严重不平衡设置下以超过10\%的优势超越了最近的元学习器FMW-Net，证明显式控制理论为处理不完美数据提供了更优的路径。

title_en: ProMiSE: Protein Multi-State Evaluation Benchmark in Biological Contexts
title_zh: ProMiSE：生物学语境下的蛋白质多状态评估基准

sentences.en: Proteins are inherently dynamic, with biological functions often emerging from transitions between multiple conformational states.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质本质上是动态的，其生物学功能往往源于多个构象状态之间的转变。

sentences.en: While recent breakthroughs have largely addressed the static structure prediction problem, no systematic benchmark exists to demonstrate how well current models capture functionally relevant dynamics.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期的突破在很大程度上解决了静态结构预测问题，并不存在系统的基准来展示当前模型捕捉功能相关动态的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce ProMiSE, the first benchmark that provides both a dataset and an evaluation scheme, based on native biological assemblies and integrating major conformational change mechanisms—intrinsic, ligand-induced, and protein-induced—within a single curated dataset.
sentences.zh: 我们引入ProMiSE，第一个同时提供数据集与评估方案，基于天然生物学组装体，并将主要的构象变化机制——内源性、配体诱导与蛋白质诱导——整合在单一精选数据集中的基准。

sentences.en: We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art structure prediction models, including AlphaFold3 and recent generative approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们对最先进的结构预测模型（包括AlphaFold3和近期的生成式方法）进行了全面评估。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that current models exhibit a limited ability to sample intrinsic multi-states and are often insensitive to biological context in induced scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，当前模型在采样内源性多状态方面的能力有限，并且在诱导情境下常常对生物学语境不敏感。

sentences.en: Internal representation analysis suggests that training-data exposure can shift predictions toward dominant conformational states over alternative biologically relevant states, primarily at the structure module.
sentences.zh: 内部表示分析表明，训练数据暴露可以使预测偏向主导构象状态，而非其他生物学相关的备选状态，这主要发生在结构模块中。

sentences.en: In contrast, results from BioEmu indicate that reducing decoding-stage bias can substantially improve multi-state sampling without major changes to upstream pair representations.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，BioEmu的结果表明，减少解码阶段偏差可以显著改善多状态采样，而无需对上游成对表示进行重大改动。

authors.name: Hahnbeom Park
authors.institution: Korea Institute of Science and Technology

title_en: Prompt Estimation from Prototypes for Federated Prompt Tuning of Vision Transformers
title_zh: 基于原型的提示估计用于视觉transformer的联邦提示调优

sentences.en: Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) of pre-trained Vision Transformers (ViTs) has proven highly effective as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for adapting large models to downstream tasks with limited data.
sentences.zh: 对预训练视觉transformer(ViT)进行视觉提示调优(VPT)已被证明是一种高度有效的参数高效微调技术，可在数据有限的情况下将大模型适配到下游任务。

sentences.en: Its parameter efficiency makes it particularly suitable for Federated Learning (FL), where both communication and computation budgets are often constrained.
sentences.zh: 其参数高效性使其特别适合联邦学习(FL)，因为通信与计算预算通常都受限。

sentences.en: However, global prompt tuning struggles to generalize across heterogeneous clients, while personalized tuning overfits to local data and lacks generalization.
sentences.zh: 然而，全局提示调优难以在异质客户端之间泛化，而个性化调优则会过拟合本地数据且缺乏泛化性。

sentences.en: We propose PEP-FedPT (Prompt Estimation from Prototypes for Federated Prompt Tuning), a unified framework designed to achieve both generalization and personalization in federated prompt tuning of ViTs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出PEP-FedPT(基于原型的提示估计用于联邦提示调优)，一个旨在同时实现ViT联邦提示调优中泛化与个性化的统一框架。

sentences.en: Within this framework, we introduce the novel Class-Contextualized Mixed Prompt (CCMP) — based on class-specific prompts maintained alongside a globally shared prompt.
sentences.zh: 在该框架内，我们引入新颖的类情境化混合提示(CCMP)——基于与全局共享提示同时维护的类别特定提示。

sentences.en: For each input, CCMP adaptively combines class-specific prompts using weights derived from global class prototypes and client class priors.
sentences.zh: 对于每个输入，CCMP使用由全局类别原型与客户端类别先验推导出的权重，自适应地组合类别特定提示。

sentences.en: This approach enables per-sample prompt personalization without storing client-dependent trainable parameters.
sentences.zh: 这种方法无需存储与客户端相关的可训练参数，即可实现逐样本提示的个性化。

sentences.en: The prompts are collaboratively optimized via traditional federated averaging technique on the same.
sentences.zh: 这些提示通过相同的传统联邦平均技术进行协同优化。

sentences.en: Comprehensive evaluations on CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, DomainNet, and iNaturalist datasets demonstrate that PEP-FedPT consistently surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines under diverse data heterogeneity scenarios, establishing a strong foundation for efficient and generalizable federated prompt tuning of Vision Transformers.
sentences.zh: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet、DomainNet和iNaturalist数据集上的全面评估表明，PEP-FedPT在多种数据异质性场景下始终超越最先进的基线方法，为视觉transformer高效且可泛化的联邦提示调优奠定了坚实基础。

title_en: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion
title_zh: 将提示注入视为角色混淆

sentences.en: LLMs see the world as a single stream of text, partitioned into *roles* like <user> or <tool>.
sentences.zh: LLM将世界视为单个文本流，并划分为<user>或<tool>等角色。

sentences.en: We trace **prompt injection** to **role confusion**: models perceive the source of text from *how it sounds*, not its labeled role.
sentences.zh: 我们将提示注入追溯到角色混淆：模型依据文本听起来的样子来感知其来源，而非其标记的角色。

sentences.en: A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like <user> text, despite its <tool> label.
sentences.zh: 隐藏在网页中的一条命令之所以能劫持智能体，仅仅是因为它听起来像<user>文本，尽管其标签为<tool>。

sentences.en: We design *role probes* to measure how LLMs internally perceive "who is speaking", and find that injected text occupies the same representational space as the trusted role it imitates.
sentences.zh: 我们设计角色探针来测量LLM在内部如何感知“谁在说话”，并发现被注入的文本占据了与被模仿的可信角色相同的表示空间。

sentences.en: We demonstrate this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts and tool outputs.
sentences.zh: 我们通过CoT伪造来展示这一点，这是一种零样本攻击，在用户提示和工具输出中注入伪造的推理。

sentences.en: Models mistake the forgery for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success against frontier models with near-zero baselines.
sentences.zh: 模型会把伪造当作自己的思维，从而在前沿模型上实现60%的攻击成功率，而基线几乎为零。

sentences.en: Strikingly, the degree of role confusion predicts attack success before a single token is generated.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，角色混淆的程度可以在生成第一个词元之前就预测攻击成功率。

sentences.en: This mechanism generalizes beyond CoT Forgery to standard agent prompt injections, revealing prompt injection as a measurable consequence of role perception.
sentences.zh: 这一机制可泛化到标准智能体提示注入，而不仅限于CoT伪造，揭示提示注入是角色感知的可测量后果。

sentences.en: To the model, sounding like a role is indistinguishable from being one.
sentences.zh: 对模型而言，听起来像一个角色与真正成为一个角色是无法区分的。

title_en: Prompt Optimization with Minimal Unlabeled Input via Meta-Reasoning
title_zh: 通过元推理在极少未标注输入下进行提示优化

sentences.en: Prompt optimization is critical for maximizing the performance of large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 提示优化对于最大化大型语言模型(LLM)的性能至关重要。

sentences.en: However, it often relies on costly labeled data.
sentences.zh: 然而，它往往依赖昂贵的标注数据。

sentences.en: Self-supervised methods reduce data dependency, but they suffer from optimization ambiguity or high computational costs.
sentences.zh: 自监督方法降低了对数据的依赖，但存在优化模糊性或高计算成本的问题。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose the Meta-Reasoning Prompt Engineering Agent (MR.PEA), a self-supervised prompt optimization framework that operates with minimal input.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出元推理提示工程智能体(MR.PEA)，一个在极少输入下运行的自监督提示优化框架。

sentences.en: MR.PEA leverages meta-reasoning to iteratively build task-specific knowledge, including problem-solving strategies and evaluation criteria, while adaptively retrieving external information to enhance its understanding.
sentences.zh: MR.PEA利用元推理迭代地构建任务特定知识，包括问题求解策略与评估标准，同时自适应检索外部信息来增强理解。

sentences.en: This knowledge guides the generation of diverse validation examples, targeted prompt refinement, and comprehensive quality assessments.
sentences.zh: 这些知识指导多样化验证样本的生成、有针对性的提示精炼以及全面的质量评估。

sentences.en: Experiments on GSM8K and Big-Bench Hard show that MR.PEA outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average performance gain of 7.4% with an optimization cost as low as $0.01 per task.
sentences.zh: 在GSM8K和Big-Bench Hard上的实验表明，MR.PEA优于现有基线，平均性能提升7.4%，优化成本低至每个任务$0.01。

title_en: Prompt Reinjection: Alleviating Prompt Forgetting in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: 提示再注入：缓解多模态扩散transformer中的提示遗忘

sentences.en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiTs) for text-to-image generation maintain separate text and image branches, with bidirectional information flow between text tokens and visual latents throughout denoising.
sentences.zh: 用于文生图的多模态扩散transformer(MMDiT)维持独立的文本与图像分支，并在去噪过程中实现文本词元与视觉潜变量之间的双向信息流动。

sentences.en: In this setting, we observe a prompt forgetting phenomenon: the semantics of the prompt representation in the text branch is progressively forgotten as depth increases.
sentences.zh: 在这种设定下，我们观察到一种提示遗忘现象：文本分支中提示表示的语义会随深度的增加而逐渐被遗忘。

sentences.en: We further verify this effect on three representative MMDiTs—SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1 by probing linguistic attributes of the representations over the layers in the text branch.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对文本分支中各层的表示进行语言属性探测，在三种具有代表性的MMDiT——SD3、SD3.5和FLUX.1上进一步验证了这一效应。

sentences.en: Motivated by these findings, we introduce a training-free approach, prompt reinjection, which reinjects prompt representations from early layers into later layers to alleviate this forgetting.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现的启发，我们引入一种无需训练的方法，即提示再注入，它从早期层将提示表示重新注入后期层，以缓解这种遗忘。

sentences.en: Experiments on GenEval, DPG, and T2I-CompBench++ show consistent gains in instruction-following capability, along with improvements on metrics capturing preference, aesthetics, and overall text--image generation quality.
sentences.zh: 在GenEval、DPG和T2I-CompBench++上的实验显示，在指令遵循能力上取得了一致的提升，同时在捕捉偏好、美学以及整体文生图质量等指标上也获得了改进。

authors.name: Yuwei Sun
authors.institution: Shanghai Academy of Artificial Intelligence for Science

title_en: Prompt Tuning for CLIP on the Pretrained Manifold
title_zh: 在预训练流形上进行CLIP的提示调优

sentences.en: Prompt tuning introduces learnable prompt vectors that adapt pretrained vision-language models to downstream tasks in a parameter-efficient manner.
sentences.zh: 提示调优引入可学习的提示向量，以参数高效的方式将预训练的视觉-语言模型适配到下游任务。

sentences.en: However, under limited supervision, prompt tuning alters pretrained representations and drives downstream features away from the pretrained manifold toward directions that are unfavorable for transfer.
sentences.zh: 然而，在监督有限的情况下，提示调优会改变预训练表示，并将下游特征从预训练流形推向对迁移不利的方向。

sentences.en: This drift degrades generalization.
sentences.zh: 这种漂移会损害泛化能力。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose ManiPT, a framework that performs prompt tuning on the pretrained manifold.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出ManiPT，一个在预训练流形上进行提示调优的框架。

sentences.en: ManiPT introduces cosine consistency constraints in both the text and image modalities to confine the learned representations within the pretrained geometric neighborhood.
sentences.zh: ManiPT在文本与图像模态中都引入余弦一致性约束，将学得的表示限制在预训练几何邻域内。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a structural bias that enforces incremental corrections, guiding the adaptation along transferable directions to mitigate reliance on shortcut learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一种施加增量校正的结构偏置，引导适配沿可迁移方向进行，以减轻对捷径学习的依赖。

sentences.en: From a theoretical perspective, ManiPT alleviates overfitting tendencies under limited data.
sentences.zh: 从理论角度看，ManiPT在数据有限时缓解了过拟合倾向。

sentences.en: Our experiments cover four downstream settings: unseen-class generalization, few-shot classification, cross-dataset transfer, and domain generalization.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验涵盖四种下游设置：未见类泛化、少样本分类、跨数据集迁移和域泛化。

sentences.en: Across these settings, ManiPT achieves higher average performance than baseline methods.
sentences.zh: 在这些设置中，ManiPT的平均性能均高于基线方法。

sentences.en: Notably, ManiPT provides an explicit perspective on how prompt tuning overfits under limited supervision.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，ManiPT为提示调优如何在监督有限时过拟合提供了明确的视角。

authors.name: David Zhang
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

title_en: PromptDyG: Test-Time Prompt Adaptation on Dynamic Graphs
title_zh: PromptDyG：动态图上的测试时提示适配

sentences.en: Activities in numerous evolving systems can be represented as dynamic graphs in snapshot form at different time intervals, i.e., discrete-time dynamic graphs (DTDGs).
sentences.zh: 许多演化系统的活动都可以用不同时间间隔下的快照形式的动态图来表示，即离散时间动态图(DTDG)。

sentences.en: Existing methods show impressive advances in capturing historical temporal evolution patterns in DTDGs, but they focus on addressing an offline learning setting, where models are trained using historical snapshots once and then evaluated to all subsequent graph snapshots without further updating.
sentences.zh: 现有方法在捕捉DTDG中的历史时间演化模式方面取得了令人瞩目的进展，但它们侧重于解决离线学习设定，即模型利用历史快照训练一次，然后对所有后续图快照进行评估而不做进一步更新。

sentences.en: This fails to capture 1) the nature of evolving complexities across graph snapshots and 2) the distribution shift in the testing graph snapshots.
sentences.zh: 这既无法捕捉跨图快照不断演化的复杂性，也无法捕捉测试图快照中的分布漂移。

sentences.en: To address these problems, we propose PromptDyG, a novel framework that leverages unsupervised test-time Prompt adaptation for Dynamic Graph learning under a live-update online setting.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出PromptDyG，一个新颖的框架，在实时更新的在线设定下利用无监督的测试时提示适配进行动态图学习。

sentences.en: The key insight is that an expressive dynamic graph prompt can be learned on a frozen backbone via minimization of feature-wise, label-free entropy to efficiently and continuously model the evolving patterns.
sentences.zh: 关键洞见在于，通过最小化逐特征的、无需标签的熵，可以在冻结骨干上学习到富有表现力的动态图提示，从而高效且持续地对演化模式进行建模。

sentences.en: We show theoretically that this unsupervised prompt adaptation can guarantee a larger similarity margin between positive and negative pairs, facilitating more accurate dynamic predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上表明，这种无监督提示适配可以保证正负样本对之间更大的相似度间隔，从而促进更准确的动态预测。

sentences.en: It is further confirmed by our extensive empirical results on six benchmark datasets that show consistent and significant improvements of PromptDyG over state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在六个基准数据集上的大量实证结果进一步证实了这一点，显示PromptDyG相对于最先进基线的一致且显著的改进。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/mala-lab/PromptDyG.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/mala-lab/PromptDyG 获取。

title_en: PromptPilot: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Prompt Optimization for Segment Anything
title_zh: PromptPilot：面向Segment Anything的博弈论多智能体提示优化

sentences.en: Few shot segmentation with vision foundation models relies on high quality prompts to segment unseen categories from limited support annotations.
sentences.zh: 使用视觉基础模型的少样本分割依赖于高质量的提示，以从有限的支撑标注中分割未见过的类别。

sentences.en: Existing prompt construction methods depend on test-time adaptation, fixed heuristic sampling, or monolithic reinforcement learning, making it difficult to balance semantic consistency, spatial coverage, and prompt credit assignment.
sentences.zh: 现有的提示构建方法依赖测试时适配、固定启发式采样或整体式强化学习，难以在语义一致性、空间覆盖与提示信用分配之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, PromptPilot is proposed as a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for point prompt optimization with frozen DINOv2 and SAM.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出PromptPilot，一个使用冻结的DINOv2和SAM进行点提示优化的层次化多智能体强化学习框架。

sentences.en: Prompt construction is formulated as sequential decision making, where feature and physical agents propose complementary prompt modifications, and a manager agent selects actions using SAM feedback and local marginal contribution.
sentences.zh: 提示构建被形式化为序贯决策，其中特征智能体与物理智能体提出互补的提示修改，管理智能体利用SAM反馈与局部边际贡献选择动作。

sentences.en: PromptPilot functions as an inference-time optimization strategy without parameter updates.
sentences.zh: PromptPilot作为一种推理时优化策略发挥作用，无需参数更新。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed game-theoretic approach improves segmentation performance and generalization, offering a principled solution for automated prompt engineering.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，所提出的博弈论方法提升了分割性能与泛化能力，为自动化提示工程提供了原则性解决方案。

sentences.en: The code is available at [https://github.com/L-AILab/PromptPilot](https://github.com/L-AILab/PromptPilot).
sentences.zh: 代码可在 [https://github.com/L-AILab/PromptPilot](https://github.com/L-AILab/PromptPilot) 获取。

authors.name: Mingqiang Wei

title_en: PromptRL: Prompt Matters in RL for Flow-Based Image Generation
title_zh: PromptRL：提示在基于流的图像生成强化学习中至关重要

sentences.en: Flow matching models (FMs) have revolutionized text-to-image (T2I) generation, with reinforcement learning (RL) serving as a critical post-training strategy.
sentences.zh: 流匹配模型(FM)彻底改变了文生图(T2I)生成，而强化学习(RL)则作为关键的训练后策略发挥作用。

sentences.en: We show that current RL pipelines for FMs suffer from two underappreciated limitations: sample inefficiency from collapsed generation diversity, and prompt overfitting, where models memorize training phrasings and collapse on semantically equivalent paraphrases.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当前面向FM的RL流水线存在两个未得到充分重视的局限：由生成多样性坍缩导致的样本效率低下，以及提示过拟合——即模型记忆训练措辞并在语义等价的改写上发生坍缩。

sentences.en: We present **PromptRL** (**P**rompt **M**atters in **RL** for Flow-Based Image Generation), a framework that incorporates language models (LMs) as trainable prompt refinement agents directly within the flow-based RL loop, yielding both a learned prompt rewriter and a synergistic training regime that reshapes optimization dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**PromptRL**（**P**rompt **M**atters in **RL** for Flow-Based Image Generation），一个将语言模型(LM)作为可训练的提示精炼智能体直接纳入基于流的RL循环的框架，同时产生一个学得的提示改写器与一个重塑优化动态的协同训练机制。

sentences.en: PromptRL attains state-of-the-art scores of **0.97** on GenEval, **0.98** on OCR accuracy, and **24.05** on PickScore, and on instructional editing it improves FLUX.1-Kontext from **1.19** to **1.43** EditReward with only **0.06M** rollouts, surpassing Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana, **1.37**) and matching ReasonEdit-Think (**1.44**), which relied on fine-grained data annotations and a multi-stage pipeline.
sentences.zh: PromptRL在GenEval上取得最先进的**0.97**分，OCR准确率**0.98**，PickScore**24.05**；在指令编辑上，仅用**0.06M**次rollout即将FLUX.1-Kontext的EditReward从**1.19**提升至**1.43**，超越了Gemini 2.5 Flash Image（Nano Banana，**1.37**），并匹配了依赖细粒度数据标注与多阶段流水线的ReasonEdit-Think（**1.44**）。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that PromptRL achieves higher performance ceilings with approximately **50% fewer rollouts** than naive flow-only RL.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，与朴素的纯流RL相比，PromptRL能以大约**少50%的rollout**达到更高的性能上限。

sentences.en: Our code is available at [https://github.com/G-U-N/UniRL](https://github.com/G-U-N/UniRL).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 [https://github.com/G-U-N/UniRL](https://github.com/G-U-N/UniRL) 获取。

title_en: ProOPF: Benchmarking and Improving LLMs for Professional-Grade Power Systems Optimization Modeling
title_zh: ProOPF：面向专业级电力系统优化建模的LLM基准与改进

sentences.en: Growing renewable penetration introduces substantial uncertainty into power system operations, necessitating frequent adaptation of dispatch objectives and constraints and challenging expertise-intensive, near-real-time modeling workflows.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源渗透率的不断提高给电力系统运行带来了巨大的不确定性，需要频繁调整调度目标与约束，这对依赖专业知识、近乎实时的建模工作流构成了挑战。

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a promising avenue for automating this process by translating natural-language (NL) operational requirements into executable optimization models via semantic reasoning and code synthesis.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)通过语义推理与代码合成，将自然语言(NL)运行需求转化为可执行的优化模型，为自动化这一过程提供了有前景的途径。

sentences.en: Yet existing LLM datasets and benchmarks for optimization modeling primarily target coarse-grained cross-domain generalization, offering limited, rigorous evaluation in power-system settings, particularly for Optimal Power Flow (OPF).
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的面向优化建模的LLM数据集与基准主要针对粗粒度的跨域泛化，在电力系统环境下（尤其是最优潮流(OPF)）提供的严谨评估有限。

sentences.en: We therefore introduce \textbf{ProOPF-D} and \textbf{ProOPF-B}, a dataset and benchmark for professional-grade OPF modeling: ProOPF-D contains 12K instances pairing NL requests with parameter adjustments and structural extensions to a canonical OPF, together with executable implementations;
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入\textbf{ProOPF-D}和\textbf{ProOPF-B}，一个面向专业级OPF建模的数据集与基准：ProOPF-D包含12K个实例，将NL请求与对规范OPF的参数调整和结构扩展配对，并提供可执行的实现；

sentences.en: ProOPF-B provides 121 expert-annotated test cases with ground-truth code, enabling end-to-end evaluation under both concrete and abstract OPF modeling regimes.
sentences.zh: ProOPF-B提供121个带真值代码的专家标注测试用例，支持在具体与抽象两种OPF建模机制下进行端到端评估。

sentences.en: Our code, dataset, and benchmark are publicly available at \href{https://github.com/shenchao188/ProOPF-Benchamrk-Dataset}{this GitHub repository}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码、数据集与基准已在\href{https://github.com/shenchao188/ProOPF-Benchamrk-Dataset}{this GitHub repository}公开。

title_en: ProphetKV: User-Query-Driven Selective Recomputation for Efficient KV Cache Reuse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: ProphetKV：面向RAG高效KV缓存复用的用户查询驱动选择性重算

sentences.en: The prefill stage of long-context Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is severely bottlenecked by computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 长上下文检索增强生成(RAG)的prefill阶段严重受计算开销的瓶颈制约。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, recent methods assemble pre-calculated KV caches of retrieved RAG documents (by a *user query*) and reprocess selected tokens to recover cross-attention between these pre-calculated KV caches.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，近期方法组装已预计算的（由*用户查询*检索得到的）RAG文档KV缓存，并对选定的词元重新处理，以恢复这些预计算KV缓存之间的交叉注意力。

sentences.en: However, we identify a fundamental ``crowding-out effect'' in current token selection criteria: globally salient but *user-query*-irrelevant tokens saturate the limited recomputation budget, displacing the tokens truly essential for answering the *user query* and degrading inference accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们识别出当前词元选择标准中存在一种基本的“排挤效应”：全局显著但与*用户查询*无关的词元挤占了有限的重算预算，排挤了对回答*用户查询*真正关键的元素，从而降低推理准确率。

sentences.en: We propose ProphetKV, a user-query-driven KV Cache reuse method for RAG scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProphetKV，一种面向RAG场景的用户查询驱动的KV缓存复用方法。

sentences.en: ProphetKV dynamically prioritizes tokens based on their semantic relevance to the *user query* and employs a dual-stage recomputation pipeline to fuse layer-wise attention metrics into a high-utility set.
sentences.zh: ProphetKV根据词元与*用户查询*的语义相关性动态地对其排序，并采用双阶段重算流水线，将逐层注意力指标融合为高价值集合。

sentences.en: By ensuring the recomputation budget is dedicated to bridging the informational gap between retrieved context and the *user query*, ProphetKV achieves high-fidelity attention recovery with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 通过确保重算预算用于弥合检索上下文与*用户查询*之间的信息差距，ProphetKV以极小开销实现高保真度的注意力恢复。

sentences.en: Our extensive evaluation results show that ProphetKV retains 96\%–101\% of full-prefill accuracy with only a 20\% recomputation ratio, while achieving accuracy improvements of 8.8\%–24.9\% on RULER and 18.6\%–50.9\% on LongBench over the state-of-the-art approaches (e.g., CacheBlend, EPIC, and KVShare).
sentences.zh: 我们的大量评估结果表明，ProphetKV仅用20\%的重算比例即可保留full-prefill准确率的96\%–101\%，与最先进方法（如CacheBlend、EPIC和KVShare）相比，在RULER上准确率提升8.8\%–24.9\%，在LongBench上提升18.6\%–50.9\%。

authors.name: Wentao Zhang
authors.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Propose, Solve, Verify: Self-Play Through Formal Verification
title_zh: 提出、求解、验证：通过形式验证实现自对弈

sentences.en: Training models through self-play alone (without any human data) has been a longstanding goal in AI, but its effectiveness for training large language models remains unclear, particularly in code generation where rewards based on unit tests are brittle and prone to error propagation.
sentences.zh: 仅通过自对弈（不使用任何人类数据）训练模型一直是人工智能长期追求的目标，但其对训练大型语言模型的有效性仍不清楚，尤其在代码生成领域，基于单元测试的奖励很脆弱且易于错误传播。

sentences.en: We study self-play in the verified code generation setting, where formal verification provides reliable correctness signals.
sentences.zh: 我们研究验证代码生成设定下的自对弈，在该设定中形式验证提供了可靠的正确性信号。

sentences.en: We introduce Propose, Solve, Verify (PSV) a simple self-play framework where formal verification signals are used to create a proposer capable of generating challenging synthetic problems and a solver trained via expert iteration.
sentences.zh: 我们引入提出、求解、验证(PSV)，一个简单的自对弈框架，其中利用形式验证信号创建能够生成具有挑战性合成问题的提出器，以及通过专家迭代训练求解器。

sentences.en: We use PSV to train PSV-Verus, which across three benchmarks improves pass@1 by up to 9.6x over inference-only and expert-iteration baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们用PSV训练了PSV-Verus，它在三个基准上将pass@1相比仅推理和专家迭代基线最多提升9.6倍。

sentences.en: We show that performance scales with the number of generated questions and training iterations, and through ablations identify formal verification and difficulty-aware proposal as essential ingredients for successful self-play.
sentences.zh: 我们表明性能随生成问题的数量与训练迭代次数而扩展，并通过消融实验确定形式验证与难度感知的提出是成功自对弈的必要成分。

title_en: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
title_zh: ProRL：通过修正的策略梯度估计实现主动推荐的高效强化学习

sentences.en: Proactive Recommender Systems (PRSs) aim to guide user preference shift toward target items by generating paths of intermediate recommendations.
sentences.zh: 主动推荐系统(PRS)旨在通过生成中间推荐的路径来引导用户偏好转向目标物品。

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, as path rewards can naturally capture both short-term acceptance and long-term guidance effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 强化学习(RL)为优化这类序贯决策任务提供了原则性框架，因为路径奖励可以自然地同时捕捉短期接受度与长期引导有效性。

sentences.en: However, naively applying policy gradients to PRS results in deficient gradient estimation.
sentences.zh: 然而，将策略梯度朴素地应用于PRS会导致梯度估计存在缺陷。

sentences.en: We identify two deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a *length-dependent bias* that causes gradients to favor path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by the entire path-level reward ignores the decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出两个缺陷：(1) 路径级奖励分解为具有正均值的步骤级奖励，产生*长度相关偏差*，使梯度偏向于延长路径而非有意义的探索；(2) 将整个路径级奖励分配给每个步骤忽略了分解结构，导致梯度方差较高。

sentences.en: To rectify these two deficiencies, we propose an effective RL framework **ProRL** with two novel mechanisms for proactive recommendation.
sentences.zh: 为修正这两个缺陷，我们提出一个有效的RL框架**ProRL**，包含两种用于主动推荐的新机制。

sentences.en: First, Stepwise Reward Centering subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias, ensuring that path extension yields zero expected gradient signal.
sentences.zh: 首先，逐步奖励居中减去期望奖励以中和长度相关偏差，确保延长路径产生的期望梯度信号为零。

sentences.en: Second, Position-Specific Advantage Estimation leverages the reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance.
sentences.zh: 其次，位置特定优势估计利用奖励分解结构计算依赖于步骤的基线，从而降低梯度方差。

sentences.en: Together, these mechanisms yield policy gradients that precisely target path quality.
sentences.zh: 这些机制共同产生精确针对路径质量的策略梯度。

sentences.en: Our experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art PRSs.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，ProRL显著优于最先进的PRS。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL 获取。

title_en: ProSAR: Prototype-Guided Semantic Augmentation and Refinement for Time Series Contrastive Learning
title_zh: ProSAR：面向时间序列对比学习的原型引导语义增强与精炼

sentences.en: Contrastive learning has advanced the representation learning across domains, yet its success relies on data augmentations that preserve semantic contents while providing the view diversities.
sentences.zh: 对比学习推动了跨域表示学习的进步，但其成功依赖于既能保留语义内容又能提供视图多样性的数据增强。

sentences.en: Multivariate time series, however, are inherently noisy, non-stationary, and lack such intuitive semantic cues.
sentences.zh: 然而，多元时间序列本质上是有噪声、非平稳的，缺乏这种直观的语义线索。

sentences.en: Consequently, standard heuristic augmentations that ignore semantic parts may risk destroying critical temporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: 因此，忽略语义部分的标准启发式增强可能会破坏关键的时间依赖关系。

sentences.en: Though some recent approaches attempt to isolate informative components, they typically rely on an implicit neural mechanism to infer semantics, thus limiting the interpretability and controllability.
sentences.zh: 尽管一些近期方法试图分离信息成分，但它们通常依赖隐式神经机制来推断语义，从而限制了可解释性与可控性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose ProSAR, an information-theoretic framework that leverages the explicit prototype alignment to guide semantic augmentations, and establish a feedback loop between the augmentation, contrastive learning, and prototype updates.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出ProSAR，一个信息论框架，利用显式的原型对齐来引导语义增强，并在增强、对比学习与原型更新之间建立反馈回路。

sentences.en: Specifically, grounded in our proposed Prototype-Conditioned Information Bottleneck principle, we leverage the time-domain prototypes as explicit anchors to localize semantic segments, and develop a time–frequency augmentation strategy that retains prototype-consistent information while discarding noise.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，基于我们提出的原型条件信息瓶颈原理，我们利用时域原型作为定位语义片段的显式锚点，并开发一种保留原型一致信息同时丢弃噪声的时频增强策略。

sentences.en: To promote semantically consistent prototypes for a reliable view generation, we design a dual-prototype loop where the augmented views are encoded into representations and then the learned representations are clustered to update latent prototypes, whose decoded feedback refines the time-domain prototypes for the next round of augmentation.
sentences.zh: 为促进语义一致的原型以生成可靠的视图，我们设计了一个双原型回路，其中增强视图被编码为表示，随后学得的表示被聚簇以更新潜在原型，其解码反馈再精炼时域原型以用于下一轮增强。

sentences.en: Experiments on diverse time-series benchmarks demonstrate that ProSAR outperforms the other contrastive learning methods on downstream forecasting and classification tasks.
sentences.zh: 在多种时间序列基准上的实验表明，ProSAR在下游预测与分类任务上优于其他对比学习方法。
