title_en: ProtDBench: A Unified Benchmark of Protein Binder Design and Evaluation
title_zh: ProtDBench：蛋白质结合物设计与评估的统一基准

sentences.en: Recent advances in $\textit{de novo}$ protein binder design have enabled increasing experimental validation, yet reported $\textit{in silico}$ metrics remain difficult to interpret or compare across studies due to non-standardized evaluation protocols.
sentences.zh: $\textit{de novo}$蛋白质结合物设计方面的近期进展使得越来越多的实验验证成为可能，但由于评估协议不标准化，所报告的$\textit{in silico}$指标仍难以解释或跨研究比较。

sentences.en: We introduce $\textbf{ProtDBench}$, a standardized and throughput-aware evaluation framework for protein binder design.
sentences.zh: 我们引入$\textbf{ProtDBench}$，一个标准化且吞吐量感知的蛋白质结合物设计评估框架。

sentences.en: ProtDBench defines unified benchmark tasks, evaluation protocols, and success criteria, enabling systematic analysis of how evaluation design influences observed performance.
sentences.zh: ProtDBench定义了统一的基准任务、评估协议与成功标准，能够系统分析评估设计如何影响观察到的性能。

sentences.en: Using a large wet-lab annotated dataset, we analyze commonly used structure prediction models as evaluation verifiers, revealing substantial verifier-dependent bias and limited agreement under identical filtering protocols.
sentences.zh: 利用大型湿实验标注数据集，我们分析了常用结构预测模型作为评估验证器的表现，揭示出在相同过滤协议下存在显著的验证器相关偏差以及有限的一致性。

sentences.en: We then benchmark representative open-source generative binder design methods across ten diverse protein targets under a fixed evaluation protocol.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们在固定评估协议下，对十种多样蛋白质靶标的代表性开源生成式结合物设计方法进行了基准测试。

sentences.en: Beyond per-sequence success rates, ProtDBench incorporates throughput-aware metrics based on a fixed 24-hour budget, as well as cluster-level success criteria to account for structural diversity.
sentences.zh: 除逐序列成功率外，ProtDBench还纳入了基于固定24小时预算的吞吐量感知指标，以及用于衡量结构多样性的簇级成功标准。

sentences.en: Together, these results expose systematic differences induced by filtering rules, success definitions, and throughput-aware evaluation between computational efficiency, success rate, and structural diversity.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些结果揭示了由过滤规则、成功定义与吞吐量感知评估在计算效率、成功率与结构多样性之间引起的系统性差异。

sentences.en: Overall, ProtDBench provides a fair and reproducible evaluation pipeline that supports systematic and controlled comparison of protein binder design methods under realistic evaluation settings.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，ProtDBench提供了一个公平且可复现的评估流水线，支持在真实评估环境下对蛋白质结合物设计方法进行系统且受控的比较。

authors.name: Cong Liu
authors.institution: University of Amsterdam, University of Amsterdam

title_en: Protein Autoregressive Modeling via Multiscale Structure Generation
title_zh: 通过多尺度结构生成进行蛋白质自回归建模

sentences.en: We present protein autoregressive modeling (PAR), the first multi-scale autoregressive framework for protein backbone generation via coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出蛋白质自回归建模(PAR)，这是第一个通过由粗到细的下一尺度预测进行蛋白质骨干生成的多尺度自回归框架。

sentences.en: Using the hierarchical nature of proteins, PAR generates structures that mimic sculpting a statue, forming a coarse topology and refining structural details over scales.
sentences.zh: 利用蛋白质的层次化特性，PAR生成的结构类似于雕刻雕像，先形成粗略拓扑，再在各尺度上细化结构细节。

sentences.en: To achieve this, PAR consists of three key components: (i) multi-scale downsampling operations that represent protein structures across multiple scales during training; (ii) an autoregressive transformer that encodes multi-scale information and produces conditional embeddings to guide structure generation; (iii) a flow-based backbone decoder that generates backbone atoms conditioned on these embeddings.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，PAR由三个关键组件构成：(i) 多尺度下采样操作，在训练期间跨多个尺度表示蛋白质结构；(ii) 自回归transformer，编码多尺度信息并产生条件嵌入以引导结构生成；(iii) 基于流的骨干解码器，在这些嵌入的条件下生成骨干原子。

sentences.en: Moreover, autoregressive models suffer from exposure bias, caused by the training and the generation procedure mismatch, and substantially degrades structure generation quality.
sentences.zh: 此外，自回归模型存在暴露偏差，这源于训练与生成过程的不匹配，会大幅降低结构生成质量。

sentences.en: We effectively alleviate this issue by adopting noisy context learning and scheduled sampling, enabling robust backbone generation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过采用噪声上下文学习与计划采样有效缓解了这一问题，从而实现稳健的骨干生成。

sentences.en: Notably, PAR exhibits strong zero-shot generalization, supporting flexible human-prompted conditional generation and motif scaffolding without requiring fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，PAR表现出强大的零样本泛化能力，支持灵活的人类提示条件生成与基序支架搭建，而无需微调。

sentences.en: On the unconditional generation benchmark, PAR effectively learns protein distributions and produces backbones of high design quality, and exhibits favorable scaling behavior.
sentences.zh: 在无条件生成基准上，PAR有效学习了蛋白质分布并产生高质量设计性的骨干，且具有良好的扩展行为。

sentences.en: Together, these properties establish PAR as a promising framework for protein structure generation.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些特性使PAR成为蛋白质结构生成领域一个有前景的框架。

title_en: Protein Circuit Tracing via Cross-layer Transcoders
title_zh: 通过跨层转码器追踪蛋白质回路

sentences.en: Protein language models (pLMs) have emerged as powerful predictors of protein structure and function.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质语言模型(pLM)已成为蛋白质结构与功能的强预测器。

sentences.en: However, the computational circuits underlying their predictions remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，支撑其预测的计算回路仍鲜为人知。

sentences.en: Recent mechanistic interpretability methods decompose pLM representations into interpretable features, but they treat each layer independently and thus fail to capture cross-layer computation, limiting their ability to approximate the full model.
sentences.zh: 近期的机制可解释性方法将pLM表示分解为可解释特征，但它们将每一层独立对待，无法捕捉跨层计算，限制了逼近完整模型的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce ProtoMech, a framework for discovering computational circuits in pLMs using cross-layer transcoders that learn sparse latent representations jointly across layers to capture the model’s full computational circuitry.
sentences.zh: 我们引入ProtoMech，一个使用跨层转码器发现pLM计算回路的框架，它跨层联合学习稀疏潜在表示，以捕捉模型的完整计算回路。

sentences.en: Applied to the pLM ESM2, ProtoMech recovers 82–89\% of the original performance on protein family classification and function prediction tasks.
sentences.zh: 将该框架应用于pLM ESM2，ProtoMech在蛋白质家族分类与功能预测任务上恢复了原性能的82–89\%。

sentences.en: ProtoMech then identifies compressed circuits that use <1\% of the latent space while retaining up to 79\% of model accuracy, revealing correspondence with structural and functional motifs, including binding, signaling, and stability.
sentences.zh: ProtoMech随后识别出仅使用<1\%潜在空间却保留高达79\%模型准确率的压缩回路，揭示了其与结构及功能基序（包括结合、信号传导和稳定性）的对应关系。

sentences.en: Steering along these circuits enables high-fitness protein design, surpassing baseline methods in more than 70\% of cases.
sentences.zh: 沿这些回路进行引导可实现高适应度蛋白质设计，在超过70\%的情形下超越基线方法。

sentences.en: These results establish ProtoMech as a principled framework for protein circuit tracing.
sentences.zh: 这些结果确立了ProtoMech作为蛋白质回路追踪的原则性框架。

title_en: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents
title_zh: 用Agent Rosetta进行蛋白质设计：专化科研智能体的案例研究

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are capable of emulating reasoning and using tools, creating opportunities for autonomous agents that execute complex scientific tasks.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)能够模拟推理并使用工具，这为执行复杂科学任务的自主智能体创造了机会。

sentences.en: Protein design provides a natural testbed: although machine learning (ML) methods achieve strong results, these are largely restricted to canonical amino acids and narrow objectives, leaving unfilled need for a generalist tool for broad design pipelines.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质设计提供了一个天然的测试平台：尽管机器学习(ML)方法取得了强劲的结果，但它们在很大程度上局限于规范氨基酸和狭窄目标，在广泛的设计流水线上仍缺乏通用工具。

sentences.en: We introduce Agent Rosetta, an LLM agent paired with a structured environment for operating Rosetta, the leading physics-based heteropolymer design software, capable of modeling non-canonical building blocks and geometries.
sentences.zh: 我们引入Agent Rosetta，一个与结构化环境配对的LLM智能体，用于操作Rosetta——领先的基于物理学的异聚物设计软件，能够对非规范构造单元和几何结构进行建模。

sentences.en: Agent Rosetta iteratively refines designs to achieve user-defined objectives, combining LLM reasoning with Rosetta's generality.
sentences.zh: Agent Rosetta迭代地精炼设计以实现用户定义的目标，将LLM推理与Rosetta的通用性相结合。

sentences.en: We evaluate Agent Rosetta on design with canonical amino acids, matching specialized models and expert baselines, and with non-canonical residues---where ML approaches fail---achieving comparable performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在规范氨基酸设计上评估了Agent Rosetta，匹配了专化模型与专家基线；在ML方法失败的场景——非规范残基上，也取得了相当的性能。

sentences.en: Critically, prompt engineering alone often fails to generate Rosetta actions, demonstrating that environment design is essential for integrating LLM agents with specialized software.
sentences.zh: 关键是，仅靠提示工程往往无法生成Rosetta动作，这表明环境设计对于将LLM智能体与专化软件集成至关重要。

sentences.en: Our results show that properly designed environments enable LLM agents to make scientific software accessible while matching specialized tools and human experts.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，设计得当的环境能使LLM智能体让科学软件变得易用，同时匹配专化工具与人类专家的水平。

title_en: Protein Fold Classification at Scale: Benchmarking and Pretraining
title_zh: 大规模蛋白质折叠分类：基准测试与预训练

sentences.en: Classifying protein topology is essential for deciphering biological function, but progress is held back by the lack of large-scale benchmarks that avoid duplicates and by models that do not scale well.
sentences.zh: 对蛋白质拓扑进行分类对于破译生物学功能至关重要，但由于缺乏去重的大规模基准，且现有模型的可扩展性不佳，进展受到阻碍。

sentences.en: We introduce TEDBench, a large-scale, non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification constructed from the Encyclopedia of Domains (TED) and Foldseek-clustered AlphaFold structures.
sentences.zh: 我们引入TEDBench，一个基于结构域百科(TED)与Foldseek聚类后的AlphaFold结构构建的大规模、非冗余蛋白质折叠分类基准。

sentences.en: We show that on TEDBench, current protein representation learning methods either require very large models or fail to deliver strong performance.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在TEDBench上，当前的蛋白质表示学习方法要么需要非常大的模型，要么难以提供强劲的性能。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose Masked Invariant Autoencoders (MiAE), a self-supervised framework for protein structure representation learning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出掩码不变自编码器(MiAE)，一个用于蛋白质结构表示学习的自监督框架。

sentences.en: MiAE uses an extremely high masking ratio of up to 90% with an $\mathrm{SE(3)}$-invariant encoder and a lightweight decoder that reconstructs backbone coordinates from the latent representation and mask tokens.
sentences.zh: MiAE采用了高达90%的极高掩码比例，配备$\mathrm{SE(3)}$不变编码器与轻量解码器，从潜在表示和掩码词元重建骨干坐标。

sentences.en: MiAE scales well and outperforms supervised counterparts and state-of-the-art baselines on TEDBench, establishing a strong recipe for protein fold classification.
sentences.zh: MiAE具有良好的可扩展性，在TEDBench上优于监督对应方法与最先进的基线，为蛋白质折叠分类建立了强力配方。

sentences.en: To test transfer beyond AlphaFold structures, we further benchmark on a curated dataset from experimental structures of CATH 4.4. We will release TEDBench and model checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 为测试超越AlphaFold结构的迁移能力，我们进一步在来自CATH 4.4实验结构的精选数据集上进行基准测试。我们将发布TEDBench与模型检查点。

title_en: Protein Language Model Embeddings Improve Generalization of Implicit Transfer Operators
title_zh: 蛋白质语言模型嵌入提升隐式迁移算子的泛化能力

sentences.en: Molecular dynamics (MD) is a central computational tool in physics, chemistry, and biology, enabling quantitative prediction of experimental observables as expectations over high-dimensional molecular distributions such as Boltzmann distributions and transition densities.
sentences.zh: 分子动力学(MD)是物理、化学与生物领域的核心计算工具，能够以高维分子分布（如玻尔兹曼分布和转移密度）上的期望形式对实验可观测量进行定量预测。

sentences.en: However, conventional MD is fundamentally limited by the high computational cost required to generate independent samples.
sentences.zh: 然而，传统MD从根本上受到生成独立样本所需高计算成本的限制。

sentences.en: Generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) has recently emerged as an alternative, learning surrogates of molecular distributions either from data or through interaction with energy models.
sentences.zh: 生成式分子动力学(GenMD)近来作为一种替代方案出现，它从数据出发或通过与能量模型的交互来学习分子分布的代理模型。

sentences.en: While these methods enable efficient sampling, their transferability across molecular systems is often limited.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些方法能够高效采样，但它们在分子系统上的可迁移性往往有限。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that  incorporating auxiliary sources of information can improve the data efficiency and generalization of transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) for molecular dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明，纳入辅助信息来源能够提升用于分子动力学的可迁移隐式迁移算子(TITO)的数据效率与泛化能力。

sentences.en: We find that coarse-grained TITO models are substantially more data-efficient than Boltzmann Emulators, and that incorporating protein language model (pLM) embeddings further improves out-of-distribution generalization.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，粗粒化TITO模型比玻尔兹曼仿真器更具数据效率，而纳入蛋白质语言模型(pLM)嵌入能进一步提升分布外泛化能力。

sentences.en: Our approach, PLaTITO, achieves state-of-the-art performance on equilibrium sampling benchmarks for out-of-distribution protein systems, including fast-folding proteins.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法PLaTITO在分布外蛋白质系统（包括快速折叠蛋白）的平衡采样基准上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: We further study the impact of additional conditioning signals such as structural embeddings, temperature, and large-language-model-derived embeddings on model performance.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步研究了结构嵌入、温度和大语言模型衍生嵌入等额外条件信号对模型性能的影响。

title_en: Proteo-R1: Reasoning Foundation Models for De Novo Protein Design
title_zh: Proteo-R1：面向从头蛋白质设计的推理基础模型

sentences.en: Deep learning in de novo protein design has achieved atomic-level fidelity.
sentences.zh: 从头蛋白质设计中的深度学习已经实现了原子级的保真度。

sentences.en: However, existing models remain largely non-deliberative: they directly synthesize molecular geometries without explicitly reasoning about which residues or interactions are functionally essential.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有模型在很大程度上仍非审慎式：它们直接合成分子几何结构，而不显式推理哪些残基或相互作用在功能上至关重要。

sentences.en: As a result, design decisions are entangled with continuous sampling dynamics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and systematic reuse of biochemical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 因此，设计决策与连续的采样动态纠缠在一起，限制了可解释性、可控性以及生化知识的系统性复用。

sentences.en: We introduce Proteo-R1, a reasoning-guided protein design framework that explicitly decouples molecular understanding from geometric generation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入Proteo-R1，一个推理引导的蛋白质设计框架，显式地将分子理解与几何生成解耦。

sentences.en: Proteo-R1 adopts a dual-expert architecture, where a multimodal large language model (LLM) serves as an understanding expert, analyzes protein sequences, structures, and textual context to identify key functional residues that govern binding and specificity.
sentences.zh: Proteo-R1采用双专家架构，其中多模态大型语言模型(LLM)作为理解专家，分析蛋白质序列、结构与文本上下文，以识别控制结合与特异性的关键功能残基。

sentences.en: These residue-level decisions are then passed to a separate diffusion-based generation expert, which performs conditional co-design while respecting the fixed interaction anchors.
sentences.zh: 这些残基级决策随后被传递给独立的基于扩散的生成专家，后者在尊重固定相互作用锚点的同时执行条件协同设计。

sentences.en: This factorization mirrors how human experts approach molecular engineering: first, reasoning about critical interactions, then optimizing geometry subject to those constraints.
sentences.zh: 这种分解反映了人类专家处理分子工程的方式：首先推理关键相互作用，然后在这些约束下优化几何结构。

sentences.en: By operationalizing reasoning as explicit residue-level commitments rather than latent textual guidance, Proteo-R1 achieves stable, interpretable, and modular integration of LLM reasoning with advanced geometric generative models.
sentences.zh: 通过将推理操作化为显式的残基级承诺而非潜在的文本引导，Proteo-R1实现了LLM推理与先进几何生成模型之间稳定、可解释且模块化的集成。

sentences.en: Code and demos are at https://proteor1.github.io.
sentences.zh: 代码与演示位于 https://proteor1.github.io。

title_en: Proteus: Lookup-Free Trellis-Coded Quantization by Lattice-Breaking Compute Codes for 2-Bit LLMs
title_zh: Proteus：面向2比特LLM的免查找格栅编码量化与破格计算码

sentences.en: Autoregressive decoding of large language models is frequently memory-traffic bound, so ultra-low-bit weight-only PTQ helps only if dequantization avoids irregular codebook or LUT access in the inner loop.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的自回归解码通常受内存流量约束，因此超低比特的仅权重PTQ只有在反量化避免在内循环中访问不规则码本或LUT时才有效。

sentences.en: Under the GPU-friendly bitshift trellis, existing 2-bit trellis-coded quantization (TCQ) pipelines either reintroduce micro-LUTs or suffer overlap-amplified artifacts because incoherence improves global Gaussianity but does not guarantee overlap-local joint geometry.
sentences.zh: 在GPU友好的位移格栅下，现有的2比特格栅编码量化(TCQ)流水线要么重新引入微型LUT，要么遭受重叠放大伪影——因为非相干性改善了全局高斯性，但并不保证重叠局部的联合几何结构。

sentences.en: We introduce Proteus a strictly lookup-free TCQ framework whose computed generator MUL-BAL uses cheap integer mixing plus a per-layer affine Gaussianizer to produce overlap-robust, near-Gaussian code values with zero runtime table loads.
sentences.zh: 我们提出Proteus，一个严格免查找的TCQ框架，其计算式生成器MUL-BAL使用廉价的整数混合外加逐层仿射高斯化，在零运行时表加载的情况下产生对重叠稳健的近似高斯码值。

sentences.en: Proteus instantiates each layer by selecting from a tiny, pre-vetted candidate pool and then applies lightweight channel compensation and optional few-shot distillation that tune only per-layer affine statistics while keeping packed indices and the bitshift-trellis decoder fixed.
sentences.zh: Proteus通过从一个微小的预审候选池中选择来实例化每一层，然后应用轻量通道补偿与可选的少样本蒸馏，这些仅调整逐层仿射统计量，同时保持打包索引与位移格栅解码器固定不变。

sentences.en: On Llama 2 (7B–70B) at 2-bit PTQ, Proteus improves perplexity and zero-shot accuracy over strong TCQ/PTQ baselines and reduces end-to-end decode bandwidth at comparable throughput (e.g., 740 vs. 1020 GB/s on 70B).
sentences.zh: 在Llama 2（7B–70B）的2比特PTQ上，Proteus在困惑度与零样本准确率上优于强TCQ/PTQ基线，并在可比的吞吐量下降低了端到端解码带宽（例如，70B上为740对1020 GB/s）。

title_en: ProtocolBench: Which LLM MultiAgent Protocol to Choose?
title_zh: ProtocolBench：该选择哪种LLM多智能体协议？

sentences.en: As large-scale multi-agent systems evolve, the communication protocol layer has become a critical yet under-evaluated factor shaping performance and reliability.
sentences.zh: 随着大规模多智能体系统的发展，通信协议层已成为影响性能与可靠性的关键但评估不足的因素。

sentences.en: Despite the existence of diverse protocols (A2A, ACP, ANP, Agora, etc.), the selection of them is often intuition-driven and lacks standardized guidance.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在多种协议（A2A、ACP、ANP、Agora等），但对它们的选择往往是直觉驱动的，缺乏标准化指导。

sentences.en: We introduce ProtocolBench, a benchmark that systematically compares agent protocols along four measurable axes: task success, end-to-end latency, message or byte overhead, and robustness under failures.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProtocolBench，一个沿四个可测量轴系统比较智能体协议的基准：任务成功率、端到端延迟、消息或字节开销，以及失败下的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: On ProtocolBench, the choice of protocol significantly influences system behavior.
sentences.zh: 在ProtocolBench上，协议的选择显著影响系统行为。

sentences.en: In the Streaming Queue scenario, overall completion time varies by up to 36.5\% across protocols, and mean end-to-end latency differs by 3.48 s. Under Fail-Storm Recovery, resilience also differs consistently across protocols.
sentences.zh: 在流式队列场景中，不同协议的整体完成时间差异高达36.5\%，平均端到端延迟相差3.48秒。在故障风暴恢复中，各协议的韧性也始终存在差异。

sentences.en: Beyond evaluation, we present ProtocolRouter, a lightweight constraint-aware protocol router that selects per-scenario (or per-module) protocols from requirement and runtime signals.
sentences.zh: 除评估之外，我们提出ProtocolRouter，一个轻量级、约束感知的协议路由器，根据需求与运行时信号为每个场景（或每个模块）选择协议。

sentences.en: ProtocolRouter reduces Fail-Storm recovery time by up to 18.1\% versus the best single-protocol baseline and achieves scenario-specific gains such as higher success in GAIA, while exposing trade-offs across other metrics.
sentences.zh: 与最佳的单协议基线相比，ProtocolRouter将故障风暴恢复时间最多缩短18.1\%，并实现了场景特定的增益（如GAIA上更高的成功率），同时在其它指标上展现出权衡。

sentences.en: We also release ProtocolRouterBench to standardize constrained protocol-selection evaluation and improve reliability at scale.
sentences.zh: 我们还发布了ProtocolRouterBench，以标准化受约束的协议选择评估并提高大规模下的可靠性。

title_en: ProtoKV: Streaming Video Understanding under Delayed Query with Summary-State Memory
title_zh: ProtoKV：带摘要状态记忆的延迟查询流式视频理解

sentences.en: Streaming video understanding (SVU) must answer queries that arrive asynchronously while visual tokens stream continuously under strict GPU-memory and query-time latency budgets.
sentences.zh: 流式视频理解(SVU)必须在视觉词元在严格GPU内存与查询时延预算下持续流入的同时，回答异步到达的查询。

sentences.en: A key challenge is delayed query: decisive cues may appear briefly, yet many subsequent updates occur before the query arrives, increasing the risk that those cues are evicted or diluted under bounded memory.
sentences.zh: 一个关键挑战是延迟查询：决定性线索可能短暂出现，但在查询到达之前会发生许多后续更新，这增加了在有限记忆下这些线索被逐出或稀释的风险。

sentences.en: We propose ProtoKV, a constant-footprint SVU memory that represents far history as a fixed-capacity summary state rather than retaining token instances.
sentences.zh: 我们提出ProtoKV，一种恒占用的SVU记忆，将远距离历史表示为一个固定容量的摘要状态，而非保留词元实例。

sentences.en: ProtoKV keeps an exact near-window KV cache and aggregates older content into a semantic–spatial prototype bank with residual statistics.
sentences.zh: ProtoKV保留一个精确的近窗口KV缓存，并将较旧内容聚合到一个带有残差统计的语义-空间原型库中。

sentences.en: At query time, each prototype is exposed through a bounded pseudo-token interface that is drop-in compatible with standard attention.
sentences.zh: 在查询时，每个原型通过一个与标准注意力即插即用的有界伪词元接口暴露出来。

sentences.en: Under matched budgets and comparable query-time cost, ProtoKV improves accuracy by up to 12.5 points over token-retention baselines on SVU benchmarks in the long-delay regime, with gains that grow as query delay increases.
sentences.zh: 在匹配的预算与相当的查询时成本下，ProtoKV在长延迟场景下的SVU基准上，与词元保留基线相比准确率最多提升12.5个点，且增益随查询延迟增加而增大。

title_en: Prototype Transformer: Towards Language Model Architectures Interpretable by Design
title_zh: 原型Transformer：迈向设计上可解释的语言模型架构

sentences.en: While state-of-the-art language models (LMs) surpass the vast majority of humans in certain domains, their reasoning remains largely opaque, reducing trust and risking deception and hallucination.
sentences.zh: 尽管最先进的语言模型(LM)在某些领域超越了绝大多数人类，但它们的推理在很大程度上仍不透明，降低了信任度，并带来欺骗与幻觉的风险。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce the Prototype Transformer (ProtoT)—an autoregressive LM architecture that replaces the quadratic-cost self-attention in the transformer with a linear-cost module based on prototypes (parameter vectors).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入原型transformer(ProtoT)——一种自回归LM架构，用基于原型（参数向量）的线性成本模块取代transformer中二次成本的自我注意力。

sentences.en: In ProtoT, the prototypes create communication channels aggregating contextual information at different time scales.
sentences.zh: 在ProtoT中，原型创建了在不同时间尺度上聚合上下文信息的通信通道。

sentences.en: We show that this leads to the prototypes automatically capturing nameable concepts (e.g. “woman”) during training, and it provides the potential to interpret the model’s reasoning and do targeted edits of its behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这使原型在训练过程中自动捕捉可命名的概念（如“woman”），并为解释模型的推理以及对其行为进行定向编辑提供了可能。

sentences.en: Compared to baselines, ProtoT scales well with model and data size, shows robustness to input perturbations, and performs well on text generation and downstream tasks (GLUE).
sentences.zh: 与基线相比，ProtoT随模型与数据规模的扩展表现良好，对输入扰动具有鲁棒性，并在文本生成与下游任务(GLUE)上表现优异。

sentences.en: These results suggest that ProtoT is a promising step toward autoregressive language models that are more interpretable by design.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，ProtoT是迈向设计上更可解释的自回归语言模型的有前景一步。

title_en: Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉语言模型基于原型的测试时适配

sentences.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for vision–language models (VLMs) to bridge the distribution gap between pre-training and test data.
sentences.zh: 测试时适配(TTA)已成为视觉语言模型(VLM)弥合预训练与测试数据之间分布差距的有前景范式。

sentences.en: Recent works have focused on backpropagation-free TTA methods that rely on cache-based designs, but these introduce two key limitations.
sentences.zh: 近期的研究聚焦于依赖缓存的免反向传播TTA方法，但这些方法引入了两个关键局限。

sentences.en: First, inference latency increases as the cache grows with the number of classes, leading to inefficiencies in large-scale settings.
sentences.zh: 首先，随着缓存随类别数量增长，推理延迟增加，导致在大规模场景下效率低下。

sentences.en: Second, suboptimal performance occurs when the cache contains insufficient or incorrect samples.
sentences.zh: 其次，当缓存包含不足或不正确的样本时，会出现次优性能。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation (PTA), an efficient and effective TTA paradigm that uses a set of class-specific knowledge prototypes to accumulate knowledge from test samples.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出原型测试时适配(PTA)，一种高效且有效的TTA范式，利用一组类别特定的知识原型来从测试样本中积累知识。

sentences.en: Particularly, knowledge prototypes are adaptively weighted based on the zero-shot class confidence of each test sample, incorporating the sample's visual features into the corresponding class-specific prototype.
sentences.zh: 特别地，知识原型根据每个测试样本的零样本类别置信度被自适应加权，将样本的视觉特征纳入相应的类别特定原型。

sentences.en: It is worth highlighting that the knowledge from past test samples is integrated and utilized solely in the prototypes, eliminating the overhead of cache population and retrieval that hinders the efficiency of existing TTA methods.
sentences.zh: 值得强调的是，过去测试样本的知识仅在原型中进行整合与利用，消除了妨碍现有TTA方法效率的缓存填充与检索开销。

sentences.en: This endows PTA with extremely high efficiency while achieving state-of-the-art performance on 15 image recognition benchmarks and 4 robust point cloud analysis benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这使得PTA具有极高的效率，同时在15个图像识别基准和4个稳健点云分析基准上取得最先进的性能。

sentences.en: For example, PTA improves CLIP’s accuracy from 65.64\% to 69.38\% on 10 cross-domain benchmarks, while retaining 92\% of CLIP’s inference speed on large-scale ImageNet-1K.
sentences.zh: 例如，在10个跨域基准上，PTA将CLIP的准确率从65.64\%提升至69.38\%，同时在大规模ImageNet-1K上保持CLIP 92\%的推理速度。

sentences.en: In contrast, the cache-based TDA achieves a lower accuracy of 67.97\% and operates at only 50\% of CLIP’s inference speed.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，基于缓存的TDA准确率较低，为67.97\%，且运行速度仅为CLIP推理速度的50\%。

title_en: Prototype-Grounded Concept Models for Verifiable Concept Alignment
title_zh: 用于可验证概念对齐的原型接地概念模型

sentences.en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) aim to improve interpretability in Deep Learning by structuring predictions through human-understandable concepts, but they provide no way to verify whether learned concepts align with the human's intended meaning, hurting interpretability.
sentences.zh: 概念瓶颈模型(CBM)旨在通过以人类可理解的概念来结构化预测，从而提高深度学习中的可解释性，但它们无法验证学得的概念是否与人类预期的含义一致，这损害了可解释性。

sentences.en: We introduce Prototype-Grounded Concept Models (PGCMs), which ground concepts in learned visual prototypes: image parts that serve as explicit evidence for the concepts.
sentences.zh: 我们引入原型接地概念模型(PGCM)，它将概念植根于学得的视觉原型：作为概念显式证据的图像部分。

sentences.en: This grounding enables direct inspection of concept semantics and supports targeted human intervention at the prototype level to correct misalignments.
sentences.zh: 这种接地使得能够直接检查概念语义，并支持在原型层面进行针对性的人类干预以纠正错位。

sentences.en: Empirically, PGCMs achieve similar predictive performance as state-of-the-art CBMs while substantially improving transparency, interpretability, and intervenability.
sentences.zh: 实验上，PGCM取得了与最先进CBM相当的预测性能，同时显著提升了透明度、可解释性与可干预性。

title_en: Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment Multimodal Federated Learning
title_zh: 原型引导的双边对齐多模态联邦学习

sentences.en: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for leveraging distributed data to enhance model performance.
sentences.zh: 多模态联邦学习(MFL)已成为利用分布式数据提升模型性能的关键范式。

sentences.en: However, existing methods  predominantly rely on idealized assumptions of model homogeneity and balanced modality distributions, rendering them ill-suited for practical scenarios characterized by heterogeneous client architectures and severe modality imbalance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要依赖模型同质性与均衡模态分布的理想化假设，使其难以适用于以异质客户端架构和严重模态失衡为特征的实际场景。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a \textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{Fed}erated learning Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment (MFedPBA) framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出\textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{Fed}erated-learning原型引导双边对齐(MFedPBA)框架。

sentences.en: MFedPBA facilitates robust knowledge synergy through a dual alignment mechanism: (i) at the feature level, it aligns heterogeneous feature spaces via a projection encoder optimized by contrastive learning and the Gromov-Wasserstein distance; (ii) at the decision level, it employs an entropy-weighted aggregation of naturally aligned logit prototypes.
sentences.zh: MFedPBA通过双重对齐机制促进稳健的知识协同：(i) 在特征层面，它通过投影编码器对齐异质特征空间，该编码器由对比学习与Gromov-Wasserstein距离优化；(ii) 在决策层面，它采用自然对齐logit原型的熵加权聚合。

sentences.en: This novel design achieves robust MFL by jointly tackling heterogeneous feature spaces and collectively aggregating decisions.
sentences.zh: 这一新颖设计通过联合处理异质特征空间并集体聚合决策，实现了稳健的MFL。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under conditions of model heterogeneity and modality imbalance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在模型异质性与模态失衡条件下，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线方法。

title_en: ProtoVAR: Efficient Dataset Distillation via Prototype-Guided Visual Autoregressive Modeling
title_zh: ProtoVAR：通过原型引导的视觉自回归建模实现高效数据集蒸馏

sentences.en: Recent advances in generative distillation have shown strong potential in constructing high quality surrogate datasets within a fraction of the time required by optimization-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 生成式蒸馏的近期进展显示出构建高质量代理数据集的强大潜力，且所需时间仅为基于优化方法的一小部分。

sentences.en: However, most existing generative solutions rely on diffusion models, which suffer from two limitations.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有生成式解决方案依赖扩散模型，而这类模型存在两个局限。

sentences.en: (i) Indirect matching objectives.
sentences.zh: (i) 间接的匹配目标。

sentences.en: Their sequential denoising process makes it difficult to directly match representative prototypes.
sentences.zh: 其序贯去噪过程使其难以直接匹配代表性的原型。

sentences.en: (ii) Target-agnostic generation.
sentences.zh: (ii) 与目标无关的生成。

sentences.en: The generation process is often decoupled from the target task, causing the synthesized samples to drift from the desired distribution.
sentences.zh: 生成过程往往与目标任务解耦，导致合成样本偏离期望分布。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, We propose ProtoVAR, a prototype-guided visual autoregressive framework.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出ProtoVAR，一个原型引导的视觉自回归框架。

sentences.en: Instead of relying on latent space, ProtoVAR uses the coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction of Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) modeling to maintain semantic consistency during generation.
sentences.zh: ProtoVAR不依赖潜在空间，而是利用视觉自回归(VAR)建模由粗到细的下一尺度预测，在生成过程中保持语义一致性。

sentences.en: By injecting multi-scale class prototypes, ProtoVAR enforces clear representativeness constraints while preserving diversity.
sentences.zh: 通过注入多尺度类别原型，ProtoVAR在保持多样性的同时施加清晰的代表性约束。

sentences.en: A pool-based selector further distills the prototype-guided outputs into a compact, task-aligned surrogate dataset.
sentences.zh: 基于池的选择器进一步将原型引导的输出蒸馏为紧凑、与任务对齐的代理数据集。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that ProtoVAR achieves state-of-the-art performance with comparable or lower computational cost than diffusion-based distillation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，ProtoVAR在计算成本与基于扩散的蒸馏相当或更低的情况下取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: Provable Accuracy Collapse of Embedding-Based Representations under Dimensionality Mismatch
title_zh: 维度不匹配下基于嵌入表示的准确性可证明坍缩

sentences.en: Embedding-based representations in Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$ are a cornerstone of modern machine learning, where a major goal is to use the \emph{smallest dimension} that faithfully captures data relations.
sentences.zh: 欧几里得空间$\mathbb{R}^d$中基于嵌入的表示是现代机器学习的基石，其中一个主要目标是使用\emph{忠实捕捉数据关系的最小维度}。

sentences.en: In this work, we prove sharp dimension--accuracy tradeoffs and identify a fundamental information-theoretic limitation: unless the embedding dimension $d$ is chosen close to the ground-truth dimension $D$,  accuracy undergoes a sudden collapse.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们证明了尖锐的维度-准确性权衡，并识别出一个基本的信息论限制：除非嵌入维度$d$被选择得接近真实维度$D$，否则准确性会发生突然坍缩。

sentences.en: Our main result shows that this phenomenon arises even in standard contrastive learning settings, where supervision is limited to a set of $m$ anchor--positive--negative triplets $(i,j,k)$ encoding distance comparisons $\mathrm{dist}(i,j)
sentences.zh: 我们的主要结果表明，即使在标准对比学习设定中也会出现这一现象，其中监督仅限于一组$m$个锚-正-负三元组$(i,j,k)$，编码距离比较$\mathrm{dist}(i,j)

sentences.en: < \mathrm{dist}(i,k)$.
sentences.zh: < \mathrm{dist}(i,k)$。

sentences.en: Specifically, given triplets realizable by an unknown ground-truth embedding in $D$ dimensions, we prove that there exists constant $c < 1$, such that \emph{every embedding of dimension at most $cD$  violates half of the triplets}, yielding accuracy as low as a trivial one-dimensional solution that ignores the input.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，给定可由$D$维未知真实嵌入实现的三元组，我们证明存在常数$c < 1$，使得\emph{每一个维度至多为$cD$的嵌入都会违反一半的三元组}，从而产生与忽略输入的平凡一维解一样低的准确性。

sentences.en: We complement our information-theoretic bounds with strong computational hardness results: under the Unique Games Conjecture, even if the given triplets are nearly realizable in $D=1$ dimension, no polynomial-time algorithm---\textit{regardless of its dimension}---can achieve accuracy above the trivial 50% baseline.
sentences.zh: 我们用强大的计算困难结果补充信息论界：在唯一游戏猜想下，即使给定的三元组在$D=1$维下近乎可实现，也没有任何多项式时间算法——\textit{无论其维度如何}——能够达到高于平凡50%基线的准确性。

title_en: Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently
title_zh: 推理模型中RLVR相对SFT的可证明优势：学习高效回溯

sentences.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that reinforcement fine-tuning of pretrained base models can lead to significant gains in reasoning performance at inference time.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)的近期进展表明，对预训练的基础模型进行强化微调能在推理时带来显著的推理性能提升。

sentences.en: In this work, we theoretically analyze why reinforcement fine-tuning induces better reasoning ability than purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从理论上分析为何强化微调比纯监督微调(SFT)方法能诱导出更好的推理能力。

sentences.en: We model chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning as a pathfinding problem on graphs and compare the popular method of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) against traditional SFT.
sentences.zh: 我们将思维链(CoT)推理建模为图上的寻路问题，并将流行的可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)方法与传统的SFT进行比较。

sentences.en: We prove that SFT, when trained on golden shortest paths without negative examples, fails to learn how to efficiently backtrack.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，SFT在仅基于无负例的黄金最短路径训练时，无法学会如何高效回溯。

sentences.en: In contrast, an RLVR-trained model can learn how to efficiently backtrack from dead ends using only outcome reward.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，RLVR训练的模型仅利用结果奖励就能学会如何从死胡同高效回溯。

sentences.en: This leads to a provable inference-time compute separation between the two methods, and demonstrates that RLVR allows the model to learn the location of difficult decisions in a reasoning chain, ultimately allowing for better allocation of inference-time compute.
sentences.zh: 这导致两种方法之间存在可证明的推理时计算分离，并表明RLVR使模型能够学习推理链中困难决策的位置，最终实现推理时计算的更好分配。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that the reasoning traces of an RLVR model can be distilled to train a base model to backtrack efficiently as well.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明RLVR模型的推理轨迹可以被蒸馏，以训练基础模型同样高效回溯。

title_en: Provable Bounds for the Learnability of Sample-Compressible Families from Noisy Samples
title_zh: 噪声样本下样本可压缩族可学性的可证明界

sentences.en: Learning distribution families over $\mathbb{R}^d$ is a fundamental problem in unsupervised learning and statistics.
sentences.zh: 学习$\mathbb{R}^d$上的分布族是无监督学习与统计中的一个基本问题。

sentences.en: A central question in this setting is whether a given family of distributions possesses sufficient structure to be (at least) information-theoretically learnable and, if so, to characterize its sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 在该设定中，一个核心问题是给定分布族是否拥有足够的结构以（至少）在信息论意义上可学，如果是，则刻画其样本复杂度。

sentences.en: In 2018, Ashtiani et al. (2018) reformulated sample compressibility as a structural property of distribution classes, proving that it guarantees PAC-learnability.
sentences.zh: 2018年，Ashtiani等人(2018)将样本可压缩性重新表述为分布类的结构性质，证明它能保证PAC可学性。

sentences.en: This discovery subsequently enabled a series of recent advancements in deriving nearly tight sample complexity bounds for various high-dimensional open problems.
sentences.zh: 这一发现随后促成了一系列近期进展，为各种高维开放问题推导出近乎紧致的样本复杂度界。

sentences.en: It has been further conjectured that the converse also holds: every learnable class admits a sample compression scheme, making the two notions to be equivalent.
sentences.zh: 人们进一步猜想其逆向亦成立：每一个可学的类都承认一个样本压缩方案，从而使这两种概念等价。

sentences.en: In this work, we establish that sample compressible families remain learnable even from perturbed samples, subject to a set of minimax-necessary and sufficient conditions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们证明样本可压缩族即使在扰动样本下也可学，但需满足一组极小极大且必要充分的条件。

sentences.en: In particular, we assume samples are corrupted by an additive independent noise model, and theoretically derive sample complexity bounds for general sample compressible classes in arbitrary dimensions with respect to both $\ell_2$-norm and total variation distance.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们假设样本被加法独立噪声模型污染，并从理论上为任意维度下的一般样本可压缩类分别关于$\ell_2$范数和总变差距离推导样本复杂度界。

title_en: Provable Sample Efficiency of Curriculum Post-Training for Transformer Reasoning
title_zh: Transformer推理的课程训练后可证明样本效率

sentences.en: Recent curriculum techniques in the post-training stage of LLMs have been empirically observed to outperform non-curriculum approaches in improving reasoning performance, yet a principled understanding of their effectiveness and limitations remains incomplete.
sentences.zh: 在LLM训练后阶段的近期课程技术已被实验观察到，在提升推理性能方面优于非课程方法，但对其有效性与局限性的原理性理解仍不完整。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we develop an abstract theoretical framework and identify sufficient conditions under which curriculum post-training yields exponential improvements in sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们发展了一个抽象的理论框架，并识别出课程训练后产生样本复杂度指数级改进的充分条件。

sentences.en: To substantiate this framework, we model the base model’s Chain-of-Thought generation as a state-conditioned autoregressive reasoning tree, and formalize curriculum subtasks as either depth-increasing curricula that progressively extend reasoning horizons or hint-decreasing curricula that gradually remove partial hints.
sentences.zh: 为证实这一框架，我们将基础模型的思维链生成建模为状态条件化的自回归推理树，并将课程子任务形式化为深度递增课程（逐步延伸推理视界）或提示递减课程（逐步移除部分提示）。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that reinforcement learning finetuning with both curriculum strategies achieves high accuracy with polynomial sample complexity, whereas non-curriculum counterpart encounters an exponential complexity bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，使用两种课程策略的强化学习微调都能以多项式样本复杂度实现高准确率，而非课程对应方法则会遭遇指数级的复杂度瓶颈。

sentences.en: We further establish analogous guarantees for test-time scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步为测试时扩展建立了类似的保证。

sentences.en: Empirical simulations support our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 经验性模拟支持我们的理论发现。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/DakeBU/Curriculum-Post-training.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/DakeBU/Curriculum-Post-training 获取。

title_en: Provable Training Data Identification for Large Language Models
title_zh: 大型语言模型可证明的训练数据识别

sentences.en: Identifying training data of large-scale models is critical for copyright litigation, privacy auditing, and ensuring fair evaluation.
sentences.zh: 识别大规模模型的训练数据对版权诉讼、隐私审计以及确保公平评估至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing works typically treat this task as an instance-wise identification without controlling the error rate of the identified set, which cannot provide statistically reliable evidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有工作通常将该任务视为逐实例识别，而不对被识别集合的错误率加以控制，因此无法提供统计上可靠的证据。

sentences.en: In this work, we formalize training data identification as a set-level inference problem and propose Provable Training Data Identification (PTDI), a distribution-free approach that enables provable and strict false identification rate control.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们将训练数据识别形式化为集合级推断问题，并提出可证明的训练数据识别(PTDI)，一种无分布方法，能够对错误识别率实现可证明且严格的控制。

sentences.en: Specifically, our method computes conformal p-values for each data point using a set of known unseen data and then develops a novel Jackknife-corrected Beta boundary (JKBB) estimator to estimate the training-data proportion of the test set, which allows us to scale these p-values.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的方法利用一组已知的未见数据为每个数据点计算共形p值，然后开发一种新的Jackknife修正Beta边界(JKBB)估计器来估计测试集的训练数据占比，从而允许我们缩放这些p值。

sentences.en: By applying the Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) procedure to the scaled p-values, we select a subset of data points with provable and strict false identification control.
sentences.zh: 通过将Benjamini–Hochberg(BH)过程应用于缩放后的p值，我们选择一个数据点子集，并实现可证明且严格的错误识别控制。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across various models and datasets demonstrate that PTDI achieves higher power than prior methods while strictly controlling the FIR.
sentences.zh: 在不同模型与数据集上的大量实验表明，PTDI在严格控制FIR的同时，实现了比先前方法更高的功效。

title_en: Provably Convergent Actor-Critic in Risk-averse MARL
title_zh: 风险规避MARL中可证明收敛的行动者-评论家算法

sentences.en: Learning stationary policies in infinite-horizon general-sum Markov games (MGs) remains a fundamental open problem in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL).
sentences.zh: 学习无限时域一般收益马尔可夫博弈(MG)中的平稳策略，仍是多智能体强化学习(MARL)中的一个基本开放问题。

sentences.en: While stationary strategies are preferred for their practicality, computing stationary forms of classic game-theoretic equilibria is computationally intractable—a stark contrast to the comparative ease of solving single-agent RL or zero-sum games.
sentences.zh: 尽管平稳策略因其实用性而备受青睐，但计算经典博弈论均衡的平稳形式在计算上是棘手的——这与求解单智能体RL或零和博弈的相对轻松形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we study Risk-averse Quantal response Equilibria (RQE), a solution concept rooted in behavioral game theory that incorporates risk aversion and bounded rationality.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们研究风险规避的量子响应均衡(RQE)，一个植根于行为博弈论、融合了风险规避与有限理性的解概念。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that RQE possesses strong regularity conditions that make it uniquely amenable to learning in MGs.
sentences.zh: 我们证明RQE具有强正则条件，使其在MG中尤其适合学习。

sentences.en: We propose a novel two-timescale Actor-Critic algorithm characterized by a fast-timescale actor and a slow-timescale critic.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新颖的双时间尺度行动者-评论家算法，其特征为快时间尺度行动者与慢时间尺度评论家。

sentences.en: Leveraging the regularity of RQE, we prove that this approach achieves global convergence with finite-sample guarantees.
sentences.zh: 利用RQE的正则性，我们证明该方法在有限样本保证下实现全局收敛。

sentences.en: We empirically validate our algorithm in several environments to demonstrate superior convergence properties compared to risk-neutral baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个环境中实证验证了我们的算法，与风险中性基线相比展现出优越的收敛性质。

title_en: Provably Data-driven Lagrangian Relaxation for Mixed Integer Linear Programming
title_zh: 混合整数线性规划的可证明数据驱动拉格朗日松弛

sentences.en: Lagrangian Relaxation (LR) is a powerful technique for solving large-scale mixed-integer linear programs, particularly those with decomposable structures, such as vehicle routing or unit commitment problems.
sentences.zh: 拉格朗日松弛(LR)是求解大规模混合整数线性规划的强大技术，尤其适用于具有可分解结构的问题，如车辆路径规划或机组组合问题。

sentences.en: By relaxing the coupling constraints, LR enables parallel subproblem solving and often yields tighter dual bounds than standard linear programming relaxations, which is crucial for efficient branch-and-bound pruning.
sentences.zh: 通过松弛耦合约束，LR能够实现并行子问题求解，并且往往比标准线性规划松弛产生更紧的对偶界，这对高效的分支定界剪枝至关重要。

sentences.en: While recent empirical work has shown promising results using machine learning to predict these multipliers, a theoretical understanding of such methods remains an open question.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期的经验性工作表明，使用机器学习来预测这些乘子取得有前景的结果，但对此类方法的理论理解仍是开放问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we bridge this gap by analyzing the problem of learning LR through the lens of data-driven algorithm design, i.e., a statistical learning problem over a distribution of problem instances.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过从数据驱动算法设计的视角分析LR学习问题来弥合这一差距，即将其看作一个在问题实例分布上的统计学习问题。

sentences.en: Our contributions are as follows: first, we derive a generalization bound of $\mathcal{O}(s^{1.5}/\sqrt{N})$ for the learned multipliers, where $s$ is the number of coupling constraints and $N$ is the sample size.
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献如下：首先，我们为学得的乘子推导出$\mathcal{O}(s^{1.5}/\sqrt{N})$的泛化界，其中$s$是耦合约束数量，$N$是样本规模。

sentences.en: Second, we provide a minimax lower-bound of $\Omega(s/\sqrt{N})$, proving that a linear dependency is unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提供$\Omega(s/\sqrt{N})$的极小极大下界，证明线性依赖是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Third, we constructively close this theoretical gap by proving that stochastic gradient ascent with averaging achieves the minimax optimal rate $\Theta(s/\sqrt{N})$.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们通过证明带平均的随机梯度上升达到极小极大最优速率$\Theta(s/\sqrt{N})$，构造性地弥合了这一理论差距。

sentences.en: Finally, we extend our framework to the learning-to-warm-start setting, proving that it achieves a fast, minimax-optimal rate of $\Theta(s/N)$ and establishing a theoretical advantage over direct multiplier prediction.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将框架扩展到学习热启动设定，证明它达到快速、极小极大最优的$\Theta(s/N)$速率，并确立了相较于直接乘子预测的理论优势。

title_en: Provably Data-driven Multiple Hyper-parameter Tuning with Structured Loss Function
title_zh: 具有结构化损失函数的可证明数据驱动多超参数调优

sentences.en: Data-driven algorithm design automates hyperparameter tuning, but its statistical foundations remain limited because model performance can depend on hyperparameters in implicit and highly non-smooth ways.
sentences.zh: 数据驱动算法设计可自动化超参数调优，但其统计基础仍然有限，因为模型性能可能以隐性且高度非光滑的方式依赖超参数。

sentences.en: Existing guarantees focus on the simple case of a one-dimensional (scalar) hyperparameter.
sentences.zh: 现有保证集中在超参数为一维（标量）的简单情形。

sentences.en: This leaves the practically important, multi-dimensional hyperparameter tuning setting unresolved.
sentences.zh: 这使实践上重要的多维超参数调优设定仍未得到解决。

sentences.en: We address this open question by establishing the first general framework for establishing generalization guarantees for tuning multi-dimensional hyperparameters in data-driven settings.
sentences.zh: 我们通过建立首个用于在数据驱动设定中为多维超参数调优提供泛化保证的一般框架，来解决这一开放问题。

sentences.en: Our approach strengthens the generalization guarantee framework for semi-algebraic function classes by exploiting tools from real algebraic geometry, yielding sharper, more broadly applicable guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过利用实代数几何工具来加强半代数函数类的泛化保证框架，从而得到更尖锐、应用更广泛的保证。

sentences.en: We then extend the analysis to hyperparameter tuning using the validation loss under minimal assumptions, and derive improved bounds when additional structure is available.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们将分析扩展到在极少假设下使用验证损失的超参数调优，并在存在额外结构时导出改进的界。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate the scope of the framework with new learnability results, including data-driven weighted group lasso and weighted fused lasso.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们以新的可学性结果展示该框架的适用范围，包括数据驱动加权组lasso和加权融合lasso。

title_en: Provably Efficient Policy-Reward Co-Pretraining for Adversarial Imitation Learning
title_zh: 对抗模仿学习的可证明高效策略-奖励协同预训练

sentences.en: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation compared to behavioral cloning (BC), but demands substantial online environment interaction.
sentences.zh: 与行为克隆(BC)相比，对抗模仿学习(AIL)实现了高质量的模仿，但需要大量在线环境交互。

sentences.en: Recent empirical work has explored initializing AIL algorithms with BC-pretrained policies to address this limitation, yet a rigorous theoretical understanding of pretraining's role in AIL remains elusive.
sentences.zh: 近期的经验性工作尝试用BC预训练的策略初始化AIL算法以应对这一局限，但对预训练在AIL中作用的严格理论理解仍然难以捉摸。

sentences.en: This paper provides a systematic theoretical analysis and introduces principled pretraining algorithms for accelerating AIL.
sentences.zh: 本文提供了系统性的理论分析，并引入了用于加速AIL的原理性预训练算法。

sentences.en: We begin by analyzing AIL with policy pretraining alone, identifying reward error as the dominant source of suboptimality.
sentences.zh: 我们首先分析仅带策略预训练的AIL，识别出奖励误差是次优性的主导来源。

sentences.en: This reveals a critical and previously overlooked gap: the absence of reward pretraining.
sentences.zh: 这揭示了一个关键且此前被忽视的差距：缺少奖励预训练。

sentences.en: Motivated by this finding, we develop a principled policy–reward co-pretraining approach grounded in a reward-shaping analysis.
sentences.zh: 受这一发现的启发，我们基于奖励塑形分析开发了一种原理性的策略-奖励协同预训练方法。

sentences.en: Our analysis uncovers a fundamental connection between expert policies and shaping rewards, which naturally gives rise to CoPT-AIL, an approach that jointly pretrains both policy and reward through a single BC procedure.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示了专家策略与塑形奖励之间的根本联系，自然产生了CoPT-AIL，一种通过单一BC过程联合预训练策略与奖励的方法。

sentences.en: We prove that CoPT-AIL achieves an improved imitation gap bound over standard AIL, establishing the first theoretical guarantee for the benefits of pretraining in AIL.
sentences.zh: 我们证明CoPT-AIL相较于标准AIL实现了更优的模仿差距界，为AIL中预训练的益处建立了首个理论保证。

sentences.en: Experimental results confirm CoPT-AIL's superior performance over existing AIL methods.
sentences.zh: 实验结果证实CoPT-AIL优于现有AIL方法。

title_en: Provably Label-Efficient Conformal Prediction
title_zh: 可证明标签高效的共形预测

sentences.en: Conformal prediction converts any black-box predictor into one with finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees, outputting prediction sets $T(x)$ that contain the true label with probability at least $1-\alpha$.
sentences.zh: 共形预测能将任何黑盒预测器转化为具有有限样本、无分布覆盖保证的预测器，输出以至少$1-\alpha$概率包含真实标签的预测集$T(x)$。

sentences.en: To construct these prediction sets, conformal prediction relies on a randomly sampled ``calibration set'' of labeled examples.
sentences.zh: 为构造这些预测集，共形预测依赖于随机采样的“标定集”，即一组带标签的示例。

sentences.en: In many applications, however, this labeled calibration set is costly to collect, creating a tradeoff between upfront labeling cost and downstream utility of the conformal predictor.
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多应用中，收集这种带标签的标定集代价高昂，从而在前期标注成本与共形预测器的下游效用之间产生权衡。

sentences.en: In this work, we study *conformal prediction with costly label queries*, where unlabeled examples arrive i.i.d. and labels can be queried one at a time.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究*带昂贵标签查询的共形预测*，其中未标注示例按i.i.d.到达，且标签可以一次查询一个。

sentences.en: After $m$ queries, we form a conformal predictor; the upfront cost of this predictor is the calibration set size $m$, and its efficiency is the expected prediction set size $\mathbb{E}|T_m(X)|$.
sentences.zh: 经过$m$次查询后，我们形成一个共形预测器；该预测器的前期成本是标定集规模$m$，其效率是期望预测集大小$\mathbb{E}|T_m(X)|$。

sentences.en: We design an online stopping rule $\hat{m}$ that automatically balances the upfront cost against conformal efficiency *while preserving the original conformal guarantee*.
sentences.zh: 我们设计了一个在线停止规则$\hat{m}$，在保持原共形保证的同时，自动平衡前期成本与共形效率。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that under mild regularity assumptions, the expected total cost of our stopping rule matches the best fixed calibration size in hindsight.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们表明在温和的正则性假设下，我们停止规则的期望总成本与事后最优的固定标定规模相匹配。

sentences.en: Experimentally, we find that our stopping rule reduces cost compared to standard choices of $m$ from the literature by 40.6% $\pm$ 2.3%.
sentences.zh: 实验上，我们发现与文献中的标准$m$选择相比，我们的停止规则将成本降低了40.6% $\pm$ 2.3%。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate a reduction from the probably approximately correct labeling problem of Candès et al. (2025) to CP, under which our stopping rule minimizes the total labeling cost.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明了从Candès等人(2025)的概率近似正确标注问题到CP的归约，在该归约下我们的停止规则最小化总标注成本。

title_en: Provably Learning Attention with Queries
title_zh: 可证明地利用查询学习注意力

sentences.en: We study the problem of learning Transformer-based sequence models with black-box access to their outputs.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在只能黑盒访问输出的情况下学习基于transformer的序列模型的问题。

sentences.en: In this setting, a learner may adaptively query the oracle with any sequence of vectors and observe the output of the target function.
sentences.zh: 在该设定中，学习者可以用任意向量序列自适应地查询预言机，并观察目标函数的输出。

sentences.en: We begin with studying the learnability of the simplest formulation, that is, learning a single-head attention-based regressor with queries.
sentences.zh: 我们首先研究最简单形式化的可学性，即用查询学习单头注意力回归器。

sentences.en: We show that for a model with width $d$, there is an elementary algorithm to learn the parameters of single-head attention with $O(d^2)$ queries.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对于宽度为$d$的模型，存在一个基础算法可以用$O(d^2)$次查询学习单头注意力的参数。

sentences.en: Further, we show that if there exists an algorithm to learn ReLU feedforward networks (FFNs), then the single-head algorithm can be easily adapted to learn one-layer Transformers with single-head attention.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，如果存在学习ReLU前馈网络(FFN)的算法，那么单头算法可以很容易地适配为学习带单头注意力的一层transformer。

sentences.en: Next, we show that, in the common regime where the head dimension $r \ll d$, single-head attention-based models can be learned with $O(rd)$ queries via compressed sensing arguments.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们表明，在头维度$r \ll d$的常见情形中，单头注意力模型可以通过压缩感知的论证用$O(rd)$次查询学得。

sentences.en: We also study robustness to noisy oracle access, proving that under mild norm and margin conditions, the parameters can be estimated to $\varepsilon$ accuracy with a polynomial number of queries even when outputs are only provided up to additive tolerance.
sentences.zh: 我们还研究了对带噪声预言机访问的鲁棒性，证明在温和的范数与间隔条件下，即使输出仅以达到可加容差的方式给出，也能用多项式次查询将参数估计到$\varepsilon$精度。

sentences.en: Finally, we consider the learnability of multi-head attention and show that they are not identifiable from queries, and hence, learnability in the same sense is not feasible without additional assumptions.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们考虑多头注意力的可学性，表明它们无法从查询中识别，因此在没有额外假设的情况下，同一意义上的可学性不可行。

sentences.en: We discuss potential approaches to learn multi-head attention-based models under certain structural assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论在某些结构假设下学习多头注意力模型的潜在方法。

title_en: Provably Protecting Fine-Tuned LLMs from Training Data Extraction while Preserving Utility
title_zh: 在保持效用下可证明地保护微调LLM免受训练数据提取

sentences.en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on sensitive datasets raises privacy concerns, as training data extraction (TDE) attacks can expose highly confidential information.
sentences.zh: 在敏感数据集上微调大型语言模型(LLM)引发了隐私担忧，因为训练数据提取(TDE)攻击可能暴露高度机密的信息。

sentences.en: Existing defenses against such attacks either lack formal privacy guarantees or incur substantial utility degradation.
sentences.zh: 针对此类攻击的现有防御要么缺乏正式隐私保证，要么造成显著的效用退化。

sentences.en: We observe that fine-tuning induces widespread probability shifts, yet preserving only a small subset of influential token-level deviations is sufficient; the remaining shifts can be aggressively smoothed with minimal impact on utility.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，微调会引发广泛的概率偏移，但仅保留一小部分有影响力的词元级偏差就足够了；其余偏移可以在对效用影响最小的情况下被激进地平滑。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose SCP-$\Delta_r$, a Near Access Freeness (NAF)-based algorithm that operates on relative probabilities and explicitly smooths low-impact tokens using a base model.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞见的启发，我们提出SCP-$\Delta_r$，一种基于近访问自由(NAF)的算法，作用于相对概率，并利用基础模型显式地平滑低影响词元。

sentences.en: SCP-$\Delta_r$ achieves orders-of-magnitude better theoretical bounds than existing NAF based methods and provides strong empirical protection against TDE attacks with minimal performance loss.
sentences.zh: SCP-$\Delta_r$在理论上比现有基于NAF的方法取得数量级更好的界，并提供对TDE攻击的强经验保护，而性能损失极小。

authors.name: Tom Segal
authors.institution: Ben Gurion University of the Negev

authors.name: Yuval Elovici
authors.institution: Ben Gurion University of the Negev, Technion

title_en: Proximal Splitting Methods for Hybrid Differentiable Models
title_zh: 用于混合可微分模型的近端分裂方法

sentences.en: Operator splitting methods are at the foundation of many numerical solvers for partial differential equations.
sentences.zh: 算子分裂方法是许多偏微分方程数值求解器的基础。

sentences.en: In parallel, unrolled and hybrid learning-based architectures have been introduced to enhance classical solvers, but their design is rarely linked to the underlying problem structure.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人们引入了展开式与基于学习的混合架构来增强经典求解器，但这些架构的设计很少与底层问题结构相关联。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a unifying framework that explicitly links operator splitting algorithms from optimization with unrolled hybrid architectures.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个统一框架，将优化中的算子分裂算法与展开式混合架构显式地联系起来。

sentences.en: We show that each operator splitting scheme naturally defines an unrolled architecture, which recovers a wide range of existing plug-and-play and hybrid models as special cases.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，每一种算子分裂方案都自然地定义了一种展开式架构，它涵盖了大量现有的即插即用与混合模型作为特例。

sentences.en: Using this framework, we design new unrolled hybrid architectures and validate them on benchmark fluid dynamics simulations, where they achieve improved accuracy and stability.
sentences.zh: 利用这一框架，我们设计了新的展开式混合架构，并在基准流体动力学模拟上进行了验证，在这些模拟中它们取得了更高的准确率与稳定性。

authors.name: Amaury Habrard
authors.institution: University of Saint-Etienne, Hubert Curien Lab.

title_en: Proximal-Based Generative Modeling for Bayesian Inverse Problems
title_zh: 面向贝叶斯逆问题的基于近端的生成建模

sentences.en: Score-based diffusion models demonstrate superior performance in generative tasks but encounter fundamental bottlenecks in inverse problems due to the analytical intractability of the time-dependent likelihood score.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的扩散模型在生成任务中表现出卓越的性能，但由于时间相关似然分数在解析上的不可处理性，在逆问题中遭遇根本性瓶颈。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose a novel proximal-based generative modeling (PGM) framework that rigorously circumvents explicit likelihood evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种新颖的基于近端的生成建模(PGM)框架，严格规避了显式似然评估。

sentences.en: Our framework is built upon a theoretical equivalence between Gaussian convolution in diffusion processes and Moreau-Yosida regularization in nonsmooth optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架建立在扩散过程中的高斯卷积与非光滑优化中的Moreau-Yosida正则化之间的理论等价性之上。

sentences.en: This enables a new sampling mechanism driven by the proposed Moreau score, which admits a closed-form expression via proximal operators.
sentences.zh: 这催生了由所提出的Moreau分数驱动的新采样机制，且该分数通过近端算子具有闭式表达式。

sentences.en: Moreover, we introduce Moreau score matching to learn the proximal operators that rely solely on samples drawn from the prior distribution.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入Moreau分数匹配来学习仅依赖于从先验分布采样的近端算子。

sentences.en: Theoretically, PGM eliminates the early-stopping bias inherent in the score-based diffusion model and achieves non-asymptotic convergence.
sentences.zh: 理论上，PGM消除了基于分数的扩散模型固有的早停偏差，并实现非渐近收敛。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that PGM significantly surpasses state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality and sampling time.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，PGM在重建质量与采样时间上显著超越最先进的方法。

authors.name: Boyang Zhang
authors.institution: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Proximal-IMH: Proximal Posterior Proposals for Independent Metropolis–Hastings with Approximate Operators
title_zh: Proximal-IMH：带近似算子独立Metropolis–Hastings的近端后验提案

sentences.en: We are considering the problem of sampling from a posterior distribution related to Bayesian inverse problems arising in science, engineering, and imaging.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑的问题是，从与科学、工程和成像中出现的贝叶斯逆问题相关的后验分布中进行采样。

sentences.en: Our method belongs to the family of  independence Metropolis--Hastings (IMH) sampling algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法属于独立Metropolis–Hastings(IMH)采样算法一族。

sentences.en: These are quite common in Bayesian inference.
sentences.zh: 这类算法在贝叶斯推断中非常常见。

sentences.en: Relying on the existence of an approximate posterior distribution that is cheaper to  sample from but can have significant bias, we introduce Proximal-IMH, a scheme that removes this bias: it corrects samples from the approximate posterior   solving an auxiliary optimization problem, yielding a local adjustment that trades off adherence to the exact model against stability around the approximate reference point.
sentences.zh: 依托于存在一个采样成本更低但可能具有显著偏差的近似后验分布，我们引入Proximal-IMH，一种消除这一偏差的方案：它通过求解一个辅助优化问题来校正来自近似后验的样本，产生一种局部调整，在贴近精确模型与围绕近似参考点的稳定性之间进行权衡。

sentences.en: For idealized settings, we prove  that  the proximal correction tightens the match between approximate and exact posteriors, and thereby improves acceptance rates and mixing.
sentences.zh: 对于理想化设定，我们证明近端校正能够使近似后验与精确后验之间的匹配更紧密，从而提升接受率与混合效率。

sentences.en: The new method works with both linear and nonlinear input-output operators and is especially suitable for inverse problems where exact posterior sampling is too expensive.
sentences.zh: 这一新方法适用于线性和非线性输入-输出算子，尤其适合精确后验采样成本过高的逆问题。

sentences.en: We perform several numerical experiments that include multimodal and data-driven priors and  nonlinear input-output operators.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了多项数值实验，包括多模态与数据驱动的先验，以及非线性输入-输出算子。

sentences.en: The results show that Proximal-IMH reliably outperforms existing IMH variants.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，Proximal-IMH可靠地优于现有的IMH变体。

authors.name: George Biros
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Austin

title_en: Proxy Compression for Language Modeling
title_zh: 用于语言建模的代理压缩

sentences.en: Modern language models are trained almost exclusively on token sequences produced by a fixed tokenizer, an external lossless compressor often over UTF‑8 byte sequences, thereby coupling the model to that compressor.
sentences.zh: 现代语言模型几乎完全在由固定分词器产生的词元序列上训练，该分词器通常是一种对UTF‑8字节序列进行运算的外部无损压缩器，从而将模型与该压缩器耦合在一起。

sentences.en: This work introduces proxy compression, an alternative training scheme that preserves the efficiency benefits of compressed inputs while providing an end-to-end, raw-byte interface at inference time.
sentences.zh: 本工作引入代理压缩，一种替代训练方案，在保留压缩输入效率优势的同时，在推理时提供端到端的原始字节接口。

sentences.en: During training, one language model is jointly trained on raw byte sequences and compressed views generated by external compressors; through the process, the model learns to internally align compressed sequences and raw bytes.
sentences.zh: 在训练期间，一个语言模型在原始字节序列和由外部压缩器生成的压缩视图上联合训练；在此过程中，模型学会在内部对齐压缩序列与原始字节。

sentences.en: This alignment enables strong transfer between the two formats, even when training predominantly on compressed inputs which are discarded at inference.
sentences.zh: 这种对齐使得两种格式之间能够强迁移，即使主要在被压缩输入上训练并在推理时丢弃这些输入也是如此。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on code language modeling demonstrate that proxy compression substantially improves training efficiency and significantly outperforms pure byte-level baselines given fixed compute budgets.
sentences.zh: 在代码语言建模上的大量实验表明，代理压缩显著提升了训练效率，并在固定计算预算下大幅优于纯字节级基线。

sentences.en: As model scale increases, these gains become more pronounced, and proxy-trained models eventually match or rival tokenizer approaches, all while operating solely on raw bytes and retaining the inherent robustness of byte-level modeling.
sentences.zh: 随着模型规模的增大，这些收益变得更加显著，代理训练模型最终匹配或媲美分词器方法，同时仅基于原始字节运行并保留字节级建模的固有鲁棒性。
